name: Accordion
description: Vertically stacked optical crystal headers that expand or collapse to reveal detailed specifications while conserving vertical viewport space.

bestPractices.description: Use allowMultiple when users frequently compare adjacent sections such as FAQs or token specs.
Keep trigger titles scannable and self-explanatory.
Hide critical error messages inside collapsed accordion panels.

accessibility.name: Disclosure pattern
accessibility.requirement: aria-expanded, aria-controls, and labelled region panel
accessibility.description: Each header renders a native button exposing aria-expanded and aria-controls linked to its role="region" content panel.

props.name: items
props.description: Ordered array of collapsible section definitions.

props.name: allowMultiple
props.description: Permits multiple panels to remain expanded at the same time.

props.name: xstyle
props.description: Typed CSS custom properties and style overrides.

name: ActiveSessionsList
description: Optical-glass account security panel listing signed-in desktop, mobile, tablet, and CLI sessions with tabular active count badge, prototype-safe ID deduplication, emerald current-session indicator, optional monospace IP readouts, individual session revocation, bulk "Sign out all others" action, and polite live status announcements.

bestPractices.description: Mark the active browser session with current: true so users can audit their device clearly without accidentally revoking the session they are currently using.
Use controlled sessions + onSessionsChange alongside onSignOutSession and onSignOutAllOthers when synchronizing session revocation with backend auth APIs.
Expose raw session tokens or cookies inside browserOrClient or ipAddress fields; keep session metadata limited to safe audit attributes.

accessibility.name: Named Region Landmark & Unique Per-Row Action Labels
accessibility.requirement: role="region" linked to heading, list semantics, and device-specific aria-label on each Sign out button
accessibility.description: Associates the session list with its visible heading and labels every row-level Sign out button with its target deviceName so assistive technology users can distinguish revocation controls unambiguously.

accessibility.name: Live Revocation Feedback & Disabled Bulk Guard
accessibility.requirement: role="status" aria-live="polite" announcements, prism-focus-ring, and disabled:cursor-not-allowed
accessibility.description: Announces single and bulk session sign-out actions politely without moving focus and disables "Sign out all others" whenever zero non-current sessions exist.

props.name: sessions
props.description: Controlled array of active session items (deduplicated safely by id).

props.name: defaultSessions
props.description: Initial array of active sessions for uncontrolled mode.

props.name: onSessionsChange
props.description: Callback invoked with the updated session list after individual or bulk sign-out.

props.name: onSignOutSession
props.description: Callback invoked with the revoked session ID when a row Sign out button is clicked.

props.name: onSignOutAllOthers
props.description: Callback invoked when "Sign out all others" is activated.

props.name: title
props.description: Heading rendered in the optical slab header alongside the tabular session count.

props.name: xstyle
props.description: Typed CSS custom properties and style overrides.

name: AdvancedDataGrid
description: Enterprise optical glass data grid featuring inline IME-safe cell editing, pointer and keyboard column resizing, drag-and-drop plus button column reordering, sticky left/right pinned columns, prototype-safe ES Map row grouping, column sorting, and formula-safe RFC 4180 CSV export.

bestPractices.description: Provide stable row IDs and column keys so inline edits, column order, and collapsed group states persist across re-renders.
Use onExportCsv to capture sanitized RFC 4180 CSV output or omit it to trigger a browser file download automatically.
Use raw unescaped string concatenation for CSV export or plain objects keyed by untrusted row values.

accessibility.name: Table semantics, keyboard resize & reorder parity
accessibility.requirement: thead/tbody sections, aria-sort, role="separator" resize handles, button reorder controls
accessibility.description: Every column header exposes scope="col", aria-sort, keyboard-accessible Move Left/Right and Pin toggles, and a focusable separator handle supporting ArrowLeft/ArrowRight/Home/End width adjustments.

props.name: columns
props.description: Column configurations including key, header, width, minWidth, editable, pinned, align, and sortable.

props.name: rows
props.description: Typed dataset rows with unique id and typed values record.

props.name: onCellEdit
props.type: (rowId: string, columnKey: string, nextValue: GridCellValue) => void
props.description: Called when an inline edit is committed via Enter or Save.

props.name: groupBy
props.description: Controlled grouping column key (null for flat ungrouped rows).

props.name: defaultGroupBy
props.description: Initial uncontrolled grouping column key.

props.name: onGroupByChange
props.description: Called when the user selects or clears row grouping.

props.name: onExportCsv
props.description: Receives formula-safe RFC 4180 CSV output and filename; omits auto-download when supplied.

props.name: exportFilename
props.description: Filename for CSV export callback and download.

props.name: emptyMessage
props.description: Message rendered when rows or columns are empty.

name: AgentControlBar
description: Compact optical-glass slab steering toolbar for autonomous AI agent execution featuring a controllable lifecycle status badge (idle, running pulse, paused, stopped), optional active step readout, contextual Pause/Resume/Stop controls, and an inline IME-safe mid-flight Redirect input and submission button.

bestPractices.description: Pass a concise currentStepLabel (such as "Running unit tests (3/5)") so operators know what the agent is doing before pausing or redirecting.
Use controlled status and onStatusChange when synchronizing agent lifecycle state with a streaming backend or worker queue.
Allow steering submissions after an execution has already terminated; AgentControlBar disables mid-flight redirects automatically when status is "stopped".

accessibility.name: Toolbar Landmark & Live Status Announcements
accessibility.requirement: role="toolbar" with accessible label and role="status" aria-live="polite" state badge
accessibility.description: Groups steering controls inside a semantic toolbar and announces lifecycle transitions politely via the status indicator badge.

accessibility.name: IME-Safe Steering Input & Disabled Guards
accessibility.requirement: Guards Enter with !e.nativeEvent.isComposing, disabled:cursor-not-allowed, and prism-focus-ring
accessibility.description: Preserves CJK/IME composition commits in the mid-flight redirect input while disabling submission cleanly when stopped or disabled.

props.name: status
props.description: Controlled agent execution state.

props.name: defaultStatus
props.description: Initial execution state when operating in uncontrolled mode.

props.name: onStatusChange
props.description: Callback invoked whenever execution status transitions via Pause, Resume, or Stop.

props.name: currentStepLabel
props.description: Optional readout describing the active step or tool call.

props.name: onPause
props.description: Callback invoked when Pause is clicked while running.

props.name: onResume
props.description: Callback invoked when Resume is clicked while paused.

props.name: onStop
props.description: Callback invoked when Stop is clicked while running or paused.

props.name: onRedirect
props.description: Callback invoked with the trimmed steering instruction when Redirect is submitted.

props.name: redirectPlaceholder
props.description: Placeholder text rendered inside the inline redirect input well.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables all lifecycle buttons and mid-flight redirect controls.

props.name: xstyle
props.description: Typed CSS custom properties and style overrides.

name: AgentExecutionTrace
description: Optical-glass execution waterfall inspector for multi-agent runs featuring sanitized timeline horizon math, tabular total duration and token readouts, kind filter pills (All, LLM, Tool, Handoff, Retrieval), proportional offset/width optical bars inside recessed prism-well tracks, semantic status badges (ok, running, error), and a controllable recessed detail drawer.

bestPractices.description: Record span startMs relative to the root orchestration timestamp (0ms) so concurrent LLM, tool, retrieval, and handoff bars align proportionally on the shared horizon.
Pair AgentExecutionTrace with AgentRosterRail to let operators filter and inspect spans emitted by each participating agent.
Pass raw unredacted secrets or unsanitized HTML inside span detail strings; AgentExecutionTrace renders all span fields strictly as literal text.

accessibility.name: Filter Toggle Group & Span Selection Semantics
accessibility.requirement: role="group" with aria-pressed filter buttons and aria-pressed span rows linked to a named detail region
accessibility.description: Communicates active filter and selected span states to assistive technologies while keeping keyboard-only focus rings visible across every interactive row.

accessibility.name: Numeric Stability & High-Contrast Semantic Indicators
accessibility.criterion: 1.4.1 Use of Color & 1.3.1 Info and Relationships
accessibility.requirement: Textual kind/status pills paired with iconography and tabular numeric readouts
accessibility.description: Pairs color-coded waterfall bars with explicit kind labels, status text pills, and monospace tabular durations so timing and error states never rely on color alone.

props.name: spans
props.description: Array of execution trace spans rendered along the proportional waterfall timeline.

props.name: title
props.description: Heading displayed in the optical slab header.

props.name: onSelectSpan
props.description: Callback invoked whenever a waterfall span row is selected.

props.name: selectedSpanId
props.description: Controlled span ID highlighted and displayed in the recessed detail drawer.

props.name: defaultSelectedSpanId
props.description: Initial selected span ID when operating in uncontrolled mode.

props.name: xstyle
props.description: Typed CSS custom properties and style overrides.

name: AgentPlanList
description: Interactive optical-glass execution plan card for AI agents displaying a tabular completion counter, optical progress bar, semantic status iconography across five execution states (pending, active, done, skipped, failed), step selection callbacks, and optional editable controls for toggling, removing, and adding steps with IME-safe keyboard entry.

bestPractices.description: Provide onSelectStep so users can inspect tool traces, diffs, or reasoning details associated with any individual plan step.
Set editable={false} when presenting finalized audit trails or read-only historical agent runs.
Inject raw HTML strings inside step titles or details; AgentPlanList renders all step copy strictly as literal text.

accessibility.name: Progress Semantics & Region Landmark
accessibility.criterion: 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value & 1.3.1 Info and Relationships
accessibility.requirement: role="region" linked to heading and role="progressbar" with aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax, and aria-valuetext
accessibility.description: Exposes the plan as a named region landmark and communicates exact completion progress numerically and semantically through the optical progress bar.

accessibility.name: IME-Safe Inline Step Entry & Keyboard Controls
accessibility.requirement: IME-guarded Enter key submission, aria-pressed status toggles, explicit remove labels, and keyboard-only focus rings
accessibility.description: Prevents premature step creation during CJK/IME composition, announces toggle states via aria-pressed, and provides descriptive aria-label text on remove controls.

props.name: steps
props.description: Controlled array of execution plan steps.

props.name: defaultSteps
props.description: Initial execution plan steps when used in uncontrolled mode.

props.name: onStepsChange
props.description: Callback invoked whenever a step is toggled, removed, or added.

props.name: title
props.description: Heading displayed in the optical slab header.

props.name: editable
props.description: Enables status toggling, step removal, and the inline Add step input.

props.name: onSelectStep
props.description: Callback invoked when a step title or detail area is activated.

props.name: xstyle
props.description: Typed CSS custom properties and style overrides.

name: AgentRosterRail
description: Optical-glass multi-agent roster strip displaying participating agents in a horizontal scrollable rail or vertical stack, with live active/total telemetry counts, initials orbs, semantic five-state status pills (idle, thinking, tool, waiting, done), optional current task summaries, controllable selection, and IME-safe roving keyboard navigation.

bestPractices.description: Use orientation="horizontal" above chat or artifact canvases and orientation="vertical" inside sidebars or multi-pane orchestration consoles.
Bind activeAgentId and onSelectAgent to synchronize the selected agent with an AgentExecutionTrace waterfall or transcript inspector.
Inject raw HTML strings into agent names, roles, or currentTask values; AgentRosterRail renders all member fields strictly as literal text.

accessibility.name: Named Region & Current Selection Semantics
accessibility.criterion: 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value & 1.3.1 Info and Relationships
accessibility.requirement: role="region" linked via aria-labelledby and aria-current="true" on the active agent button
accessibility.description: Identifies the roster as a landmark region and announces the currently inspected agent via aria-current without relying solely on border highlight color.

accessibility.name: Axis-Aware IME-Safe Keyboard Navigation
accessibility.requirement: ArrowRight/ArrowLeft (horizontal), ArrowDown/ArrowUp (vertical), Home/End with isComposing guard and focus-visible rings
accessibility.description: Supports roving keyboard selection along the active rail axis while ignoring IME composition keystrokes and preserving keyboard-only focus indicators.

props.name: agents
props.description: Ordered array of agent members displayed in the roster rail.

props.name: activeAgentId
props.description: Controlled active agent ID highlighted with the primary optical ring.

props.name: defaultActiveAgentId
props.description: Initial selected agent ID when operating in uncontrolled mode.

props.name: onSelectAgent
props.description: Callback invoked when an agent card is activated by pointer or keyboard.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Renders either a horizontal scrollable flex strip or a vertical stack.

props.name: title
props.description: Heading rendered in the optical slab header.

props.name: xstyle
props.description: Typed CSS custom properties and style overrides.

name: AlertBanner
description: Prominent persistent optical slab communicating system updates, warnings, successes, or errors with explicit icon and text semantics.

bestPractices.description: Pair semantic icons with explicit titles and actionable remediation copy.
Provide an action button when users can resolve the banner condition in one click.
Rely on color alone to convey severity; always describe the state clearly in copy.

accessibility.name: Immediate alert landmark
accessibility.requirement: role="alert" with descriptive icon + text pairing
accessibility.description: Icons are marked aria-hidden="true" so screen readers announce the title, message, and optional actions cleanly.

props.name: severity
props.description: Semantic severity controlling ring tint and icon.

props.name: title
props.description: Bold banner headline.

props.name: message
props.description: Supporting explanation text.

props.name: actionLabel
props.description: Label for the optional action button (requires onAction).

props.name: onAction
props.description: Callback invoked when the action button is clicked.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Callback invoked when the dismiss icon button is clicked.

props.name: xstyle
props.description: Typed CSS custom properties and style overrides.

name: AlignmentToolbar
description: Compact sculpted prism-slab optical-glass alignment and distribution toolbar grouping horizontal align (Left, Center H, Right), vertical align (Top, Middle V, Bottom), and distribution (Distribute H, Distribute V) controls alongside a Selection vs. Artboard anchor scope toggle, live selection counter pill, IME-safe roving keyboard navigation, polite aria-live feedback, and an optional interactive 3-object mini-stage demonstrating real geometric snapping and even spacing.

bestPractices.description: Pass the live canvas selection count via selectedCount so AlignmentToolbar automatically disables distribution below 3 objects and disables selection-relative alignment below 2 objects while allowing single-object alignment in Artboard mode.
Enable showMiniStage in documentation sandboxes, onboarding tours, or inspector previews to demonstrate exact edge snapping and equal-gap distribution without requiring an external canvas engine.

Override alignment button styles with raw hex or rgba color literals; compose with --prism-* optical tokens via xstyle or theme.components.AlignmentToolbar so surfaces adapt cleanly across all Refractor themes.

accessibility.name: WAI-ARIA Horizontal Toolbar with IME-Safe Roving Tabindex
accessibility.requirement: Exposes role="toolbar" with aria-orientation="horizontal", grouped role="group" sections, roving ArrowLeft/ArrowRight/Home/End keyboard focus skipping disabled controls, IME composition guards, and keyboard-only .prism-focus-ring outlines
accessibility.description: Ensures a single Tab stop enters the alignment toolbar and arrow keys move smoothly across enabled alignment, distribution, anchor-scope, and stage-reset controls without hijacking IME composition or browser modifier shortcuts.

accessibility.name: Anchor Toggle State & Polite Live Action Confirmation
accessibility.requirement: Exposes aria-pressed on Selection and Artboard scope toggles, descriptive aria-label names on every icon-only action button, and a role="status" aria-live="polite" region announcing the last applied operation
accessibility.description: Guarantees screen-reader users receive immediate confirmation of applied alignment or distribution commands and current anchor-scope constraints.

props.name: selectedCount
props.description: Number of currently selected objects. Automatically disables distribute actions when < 3 and disables align actions when < 1 (or < 2 when anchorMode is "selection").

props.name: anchorMode
props.description: Controlled alignment anchor scope ("selection" | "artboard").

props.name: defaultAnchorMode
props.description: Initial alignment anchor scope when using AlignmentToolbar in uncontrolled mode.

props.name: onAnchorModeChange
props.description: Callback invoked when the user switches between Selection and Artboard anchor scope.

props.name: onAlign
props.description: Callback invoked with the clicked alignment or distribution action ID and active anchor mode.

props.name: showMiniStage
props.description: Renders an interactive 3-object preview stage inside the slab that visibly snaps and evenly distributes boxes when toolbar actions are clicked.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables all alignment, distribution, anchor-scope, and mini-stage controls and ignores toolbar keyboard navigation.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible label applied to the root role="toolbar" element.

props.name: xstyle
props.description: Typed --prism-* CSS custom property and inline optical style overrides.

name: AnomalyForecastChart
description: Optical-glass anomaly detection and forecasting chart inside a sculpted prism-slab card with an automatic Anomaly Count status pill (N Anomalies in --prism-error-main or Nominal in --prism-success-main), a Show Forecast Horizon toggle, a responsive 460x220 SVG inside a recessed prism-well rendering a translucent [lower, upper] confidence corridor polygon, dashed expected baseline, vertical "Now" divider separating historical observations from future forecast intervals (actual === null), crisp actual polyline, glowing out-of-band breach rings, keyboard-navigable checkpoints, a Detected Anomalies pill jump bar, and a recessed aria-live="polite" telemetry readout powered exclusively by --prism-* CSS custom properties.

bestPractices.description: Represent future forecast intervals by setting actual: null after the latest historical observation so the vertical "Now" boundary, translucent forecast zone, and Show Forecast Horizon toggle align automatically.

Provide stable checkpoint IDs, concise timestamp labels (e.g. "09:00"), and a clear measurement unit ("req/s", "ms", or "err/m") so Detected Anomalies jump pills and the recessed telemetry readout stay compact on narrow viewports.

Pre-sort or drop reversed confidence intervals or non-finite numeric fields manually; AnomalyForecastChart normalizes [lower, upper] ordering and sanitizes non-finite inputs automatically without emitting NaN SVG coordinates.

accessibility.name: Keyboard-Navigable Checkpoints & Anomaly Jump Pills
accessibility.requirement: Every SVG checkpoint exposes role="button", tabIndex={0}, descriptive aria-label, keyboard-only prism-focus-ring styling, IME-safe Enter/Space activation, and ArrowLeft/ArrowRight/Home/End traversal; header toggle and Detected Anomalies jump pills expose aria-pressed
accessibility.description: Keyboard and assistive-technology users can step across historical and forecast checkpoints or jump straight to out-of-band breaches while hearing Timestamp, Actual vs Expected, Confidence Band, Deviation, and Status updates in the aria-live="polite" readout.

accessibility.name: Non-Color Anomaly Classification & Empty Status Region
accessibility.requirement: Pairs semantic --prism-* tokens with explicit Nominal / Upper Breach / Lower Breach / Forecast text labels, directional arrows (↑ / ↓), and a clean role="status" empty state when data is []
accessibility.description: Ensures upper and lower confidence corridor breaches remain unambiguous across all Refractor themes and color-vision profiles.

props.name: data
props.defaultValue: DEFAULT_ANOMALY_FORECAST_DATA (16 checkpoints: 12 historical with 2 upper/lower anomalies + 4 forecast intervals)
props.description: Ordered time-series checkpoints ({ id, label, actual, expected, lower, upper }) where actual === null marks future forecast horizon intervals. Pass [] to display the role="status" empty state.

props.name: unit
props.description: Unit suffix appended to formatted telemetry readouts, anomaly jump pills, and accessible labels.

props.name: title
props.description: Heading displayed in the sculpted prism-slab header and linked to the chart region.

props.name: onSelectPoint
props.description: Callback invoked with { point, index, direction, deviation } whenever a checkpoint marker or Detected Anomalies jump pill is activated.

props.name: xstyle
props.description: Typed --prism-* CSS custom property and inline optical style overrides.

name: ApiRequestBuilder
group: Enterprise Workflows, Data Ops & API Tooling
description: Embedded HTTP API request console inside a sculpted prism-slab optical-glass card with semantic method styling, sanitizeUrl protocol validation, IME-safe Ctrl/Cmd+Enter execution, roving-tabindex Params/Headers/Body inspector, safe JSON.parse formatting, deterministic optical mock responder, and a literal-text live response viewer with header inspection and clipboard copy.

bestPractices.description: Provide a typed async onSend handler to proxy requests through your authenticated backend or API gateway while preserving automatic loading states and 500 error snapshot recovery.
Use defaultParams and defaultHeaders to pre-seed common query filters and content-type headers without mutating consumer arrays.
Render unescaped HTML from API responses or bypass sanitizeUrl validation; ApiRequestBuilder blocks javascript:, data:, and vbscript: URLs and always renders response bodies as literal text.

accessibility.name: Roving tablist, polite status announcements, and IME-safe keyboard shortcuts
accessibility.requirement: role="tablist", role="tab", aria-selected, ArrowLeft/ArrowRight/Home/End roving navigation, role="alert" URL validation banner, role="status" aria-live="polite" copy & response announcements, and keyboard-only prism-focus-ring
accessibility.description: Every form input, select, checkbox, and action button exposes explicit aria-label text; keyboard shortcuts guard against IME composition via isComposing; and copy/response events announce state transitions to screen readers.

props.name: title
props.description: Heading rendered in the top optical glass console header.

props.name: defaultMethod
props.description: Initial HTTP verb ('GET' | 'POST' | 'PUT' | 'PATCH' | 'DELETE').

props.name: defaultUrl
props.description: Initial endpoint URL validated through sanitizeUrl before sending.

props.name: defaultParams
props.description: Initial query parameter rows displayed in the Params tab.

props.name: defaultHeaders
props.description: Initial HTTP header rows displayed in the Headers tab.

props.name: defaultBody
props.description: Initial request JSON body text displayed in the Body tab.

props.name: onSend
props.description: Custom sync or async request handler. When omitted, a deterministic built-in optical mock responder fulfills requests immediately.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables editing and request submission across all controls.

name: AppDockBar
description: Floating optical-glass desktop application dock built on a sculpted prism-slab tray with smooth hover and keyboard-focus neighbor magnification scaling (1.0x, 1.12x, 1.28x), glowing --prism-primary-main running-app indicator dots, clamped numeric badge pills (99+ via --prism-error-main), attention bounce indicators (data-attention="true"), edge-aware floating tooltips, controlled/uncontrolled active selection, and IME-safe roving-tabindex toolbar navigation.

bestPractices.description: Pin 4–8 high-frequency workspace applications with concise 1–2 word labels and distinct semantic tones so the floating tooltip and optical magnification wave read effortlessly.

Choose position="bottom" for standard horizontal desktop shells, or position="left" / position="right" for widescreen vertical workspace rails—arrow keys automatically adapt between ArrowLeft/ArrowRight and ArrowUp/ArrowDown.

Use attention={true} simultaneously across every pinned icon; reserve attention bounce indicators for urgent unread notifications or completed background builds, and respect users with prefers-reduced-motion.

accessibility.name: ARIA Toolbar Landmark & Roving Tabindex Navigation
accessibility.requirement: role="toolbar" with aria-orientation, roving tabIndex across enabled apps, ArrowLeft/ArrowRight (or ArrowUp/ArrowDown when vertical), Home/End, Enter/Space launch, and IME composition guard
accessibility.description: Exposes the dock as a single keyboard tab stop with wrapping directional arrow traversal that skips disabled apps, ignores IME composing events, and exposes active, running, badge, and attention state via aria-label and aria-pressed.

accessibility.name: Hover & Focus Tooltip Ergonomics & Reduced Motion
accessibility.criterion: 1.4.13 Content on Hover or Focus, 2.3.3 Animation from Interactions & 2.4.7 Focus Visible
accessibility.requirement: Floating role="tooltip" linked via aria-describedby, Escape dismissal, keyboard-only prism-focus-ring, and prefers-reduced-motion animation pause
accessibility.description: Displays the app title above or beside the hovered/focused icon without clipping, dismisses cleanly on Escape or blur, avoids mouse-click focus rings via :focus-visible, and disables bounce/scale transitions when prefers-reduced-motion: reduce is active.

props.name: items
props.defaultValue: 6 iconic studio apps (Finder, Code IDE, Prism Studio, Terminal, Messages, Settings)
props.description: Ordered array of dock application entries ({ id, label, icon?, running?, badgeCount?, attention?, tone?, disabled? }). Pass [] to render an accessible role="status" empty state.

props.name: activeId
props.description: Controlled active application identifier (null indicates no active app).

props.name: defaultActiveId
props.description: Initial active application identifier when operating in uncontrolled mode.

props.name: position
props.description: Edge placement and orientation of the floating dock bar, controlling layout direction, running dot alignment, tooltip anchor, and arrow key axis.

props.name: magnification
props.description: Enables smooth hover and keyboard-focus magnification scaling (1.28x spotlight, 1.12x immediate neighbors, 1.0x rest).

props.name: onLaunch
props.description: Callback fired with the launched AppDockItem when an enabled dock icon is clicked or activated via Enter/Space.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible landmark label applied to the root toolbar element.

props.name: xstyle
props.description: Typed --prism-* CSS custom property and inline optical style overrides.

name: AppLauncherMenu
description: Categorized optical-glass Application Launcher / Start Menu overlay housed inside a sculpted `prism-slab` surface. Combines a linear-time ReDoS-safe search bar (with IME-safe `Escape` clearing), category filter pills (`Pinned`, `All Apps`, `Design`, `Engineering`, `Utilities` with `aria-pressed`), a responsive `grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4` installed-applications grid with `--prism-*` tinted optical icon glyphs, edition badges, click/Enter launching, and adjacent `Pin <name>` / `Unpin <name>` toggle buttons, a compact Recent Documents feed, and a responsive `flex-wrap` user profile & tactile power control footer (`Lock`, `Sleep`, `Restart`, `Shut Down`) paired with a polite `aria-live="polite"` status banner.

bestPractices.description: Default to the `Pinned` view with 4–8 high-frequency applications distributed across `design`, `engineering`, and `utilities` so repeat launches require a single click or keystroke.
Provide controlled `apps` paired with `onTogglePin` when persisting user pin customizations to workspace preferences or cloud profiles, or pass `defaultApps` for standalone uncontrolled shells.
Use `AppLauncherMenu` for single-application dropdown commands like File/Edit/View menus; use `AppMenuBar` or `ContextMenuDropdown` for in-app menu hierarchies.

accessibility.name: Linear Search, Pressed Category Pills & Distinct Tile Controls
accessibility.requirement: Exposes `<input type="search" aria-label="Search applications and recent files">`, category buttons with `aria-pressed`, non-nested sibling `Launch <name>` and `Pin <name>` / `Unpin <name>` buttons (`aria-pressed={app.pinned}`), and keyboard-only `.prism-focus-ring` focus indicators
accessibility.description: Separates app launching from pinning into distinct accessible sibling controls so keyboard and screen reader users can launch or pin applications reliably without nested interactive elements.

accessibility.name: IME-Safe Shortcuts, Empty State & Polite Status Announcements
accessibility.requirement: Guards search `Escape` clear and tile/document `Enter`/`Space` activation with `!event.nativeEvent.isComposing`, renders a `role="status"` empty state when filters match 0 apps, and broadcasts launch, pin, recent-file, and power actions through an `aria-live="polite"` footer banner
accessibility.description: Prevents active CJK/IME composition commits from clearing search text or launching apps prematurely while keeping assistive technology synchronized with every state change.

props.name: userName
props.description: Profile display name shown in the footer along with derived optical initials.

props.name: userRole
props.description: User role or workspace subtitle rendered below `userName` in the footer.

props.name: apps
props.description: Controlled list of installed applications (`{ id, name, category, pinned, badge?, tone? }`). Duplicate IDs are safely deduplicated.

props.name: defaultApps
props.defaultValue: 8 realistic studio apps (4 pinned across design, engineering, utilities)
props.description: Initial uncontrolled list of installed applications when `apps` is not supplied.

props.name: recentDocs
props.description: Recent document entries (`{ id, title, appName, openedAt }`) filtered live by the top search input.

props.name: onLaunchApp
props.description: Callback invoked when an enabled application tile is launched via click or keyboard Enter/Space.

props.name: onTogglePin
props.description: Callback invoked with the application ID and next pinned boolean when the adjacent Pin/Unpin toggle is clicked.

props.name: onOpenRecent
props.description: Callback invoked when a recent document row is opened via click or keyboard Enter/Space.

props.name: onPowerAction
props.description: Callback invoked when one of the footer power controls (`Lock`, `Sleep`, `Restart`, `Shut Down`) is clicked.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables search, category filtering, app launching, pinning, recent document opening, and power actions.

props.name: xstyle
props.description: Typed `--prism-*` CSS custom property and optical inline style overrides.

name: AppMenuBar
description: Persistent top-edge optical-glass desktop application menu bar built on a refractive prism-slab strip featuring an optional brand identity badge, canonical File/Edit/View/Window/Help menus, hover-to-switch active menu transitions, viewport-clamped dropdowns and cascading nested submenus, toggleable checkbox items, separators, right-aligned monospace shortcut hints, full IME-safe WAI-ARIA menubar keyboard navigation, outside-click dismissal, and a compact polite live status pill.

bestPractices.description: Use AppMenuBar at the top edge of desktop-class creative tools, IDEs, and studio workspaces to expose organized command hierarchies with discoverable keyboard shortcuts.
Group related commands with separator entries and surface view/preference flags using kind: "checkbox" items so users can inspect and toggle state directly inside menus.
Use AppMenuBar for marketing site navigation or deeply nested multi-page links; prefer TopNavBar or SidebarDrawer instead.

accessibility.name: WAI-ARIA Menubar, Menu & Checkbox Semantics

description: Semantic optical-glass documentation callout and admonition box built on a sculpted prism-slab surface with a left vertical luminous accent stripe, tinted icon medallion, crisp kind badge, optional trailing header actionSlot, and controlled or uncontrolled collapsible body disclosure powered strictly by semantic --prism-* tokens.

bestPractices.description: Match the semantic kind to reader urgency: use note for neutral context, tip for productivity guidance, warning for migration caveats, danger for irreversible or security-critical alerts (emits role="alert"), and abstract for TL;DR document summaries.

Enable collapsible for lengthy supplementary callouts such as migration checklists or architectural digests so readers can collapse details while keeping the header, kind badge, and actionSlot visible.
Overuse danger admonitions for routine tips or informational notices; reserving danger for genuinely destructive or critical warnings preserves visual hierarchy and avoids alert fatigue.

accessibility.name: Semantic Landmark & Alert Roles
accessibility.requirement: Renders <aside role="note"> for note, tip, warning, and abstract kinds and upgrades to <aside role="alert"> for danger admonitions, linked via aria-labelledby unless caller provides aria-label
accessibility.description: Communicates supplemental documentation structure cleanly to assistive technologies and elevates critical danger warnings to live alert announcements without extra wrapper markup.

accessibility.name: WAI-ARIA Disclosure Header & Non-Nested Actions
accessibility.requirement: Collapsible mode renders a native <button type="button"> with aria-expanded, aria-controls linked to the body region, keyboard-only prism-focus-ring styling, and keeps actionSlot outside the button
accessibility.description: Guarantees full Enter/Space keyboard operability, prevents invalid nested interactive elements when actionSlot contains links or buttons, and hides collapsed body content from tab order via the HTML hidden attribute.

props.name: onOpenChange

name: CandlestickOhlcChart
description: Optical-glass financial price-action chart inside a sculpted prism-slab card with Candlestick and OHLC bar rendering toggles, latest session price and signed percentage pill, recessed prism-well 460x220 responsive SVG with tabular Y-axis price gridlines, semantic --prism-success-main bullish and --prism-error-main bearish wicks/bodies/ticks, optional lower translucent volume histogram, keyboard-steppable crosshair hit zones, and a live OHLC inspector strip.

bestPractices.description: Provide chronological OhlcCandlePoint sessions with optional volume values so traders can switch seamlessly between filled/hollow Candlestick bodies and left-open / right-close OHLC ticks while inspecting exact Session, O, H, L, C, delta percentage, and Vol readouts.
Set currencyPrefix (e.g. "$", "€", "£", or "" for index points) and bind mode/onModeChange when synchronizing chart style across linked trading workspace panels.

Pass raw unvalidated feeds without trusting sanitization; CandlestickOhlcChart safely normalizes non-finite OHLC inputs, enforces high >= max(open, close) and low <= min(open, close), clamps negative volumes to 0, and renders a clean role="status" empty state when data is [].

accessibility.name: Interactive Candle Hit Zones & Keyboard Stepping
accessibility.requirement: Each session hit zone exposes role="button", tabIndex={0}, aria-pressed, descriptive OHLC + delta + volume aria-label, IME-safe Enter/Space activation, ArrowLeft/ArrowRight session stepping with focus tracking, and keyboard-only prism-focus-ring outlines
accessibility.description: Enables full keyboard-only inspection across every trading session without requiring pointer hover.

accessibility.name: Mode Toggle Semantics, Live Inspector & Empty State
accessibility.requirement: Candlestick/OHLC toggle pills expose aria-pressed inside a role="group", SVG declares role="img", the recessed inspector strip uses aria-live="polite", and empty datasets render a role="status" notice
accessibility.description: Ensures assistive technologies announce active mode switches, inspected OHLC session figures, and empty market states clearly.

props.description: Callback fired with the selected OhlcCandlePoint and its zero-based index on click or keyboard activation/stepping.

name: CanvasZoomSafeAreaBar
description: Optical-glass broadcast canvas viewport and zoom/safe-area bar inside a prism-slab shell featuring a live 16:9 preview viewport with scaled media stage (Fit, 50%, 100%, 200%), token-driven Rule-of-Thirds SVG guides (--prism-text-secondary), Action-Safe 90% (--prism-info-main) and Title-Safe 80% (--prism-warning-main) dashed boxes with corner labels, translucent aspect-ratio letterbox/pillarbox matte overlays (Off, 16:9 HD, 2.39:1 Scope, 9:16 Vertical, 1:1 Square), a floating prism-crystal control bar with IME-safe 0/1/2 zoom shortcuts, and a recessed aria-live="polite" telemetry status bar.

bestPractices.description: Use CanvasZoomSafeAreaBar in video editors, motion graphics canvases, and broadcast review tools where creators verify framing across cinema, HD, square, and vertical social delivery specs.
Bind controlled value and onChange when synchronizing canvas magnification, aspect ratio crop mattes, or safe-area guide overlays with external WebGL/Canvas preview engines.

Hardcode raw hex or rgba colors inside custom children overlays; compose with --prism-* semantic tokens so guides remain legible across Alabaster, Obsidian, Amethyst, Emerald Tide, and Solar Prism themes.

accessibility.name: Segmented Zoom & Safe-Area Toggle Controls with IME-Safe Shortcuts
accessibility.requirement: Exposes role="toolbar" with grouped aria-pressed zoom presets (Fit, 50%, 100%, 200%), aria-pressed guide toggles (Thirds, Title Safe, Action Safe), an aria-label="Aspect ratio mask" select control, and IME-safe 0/1/2 keyboard shortcuts
accessibility.description: Ignores shortcut keys while IME composition is active, when modifier keys are held, or when focus is inside the native select control, while keeping keyboard-only focus outlines via .prism-focus-ring.

accessibility.name: Polite Live Viewport Telemetry & Decorative Broadcast Overlays
accessibility.criterion: 1.1.1 Non-text Content, 2.4.7 Focus Visible & 4.1.3 Status Messages
accessibility.requirement: Marks all SVG/CSS guide lines and aspect matte bars aria-hidden="true" while announcing canvasLabel, active zoom, active aspect mask, and enabled guide count in a role="status" aria-live="polite" bar
accessibility.description: Prevents visual framing guides from cluttering screen reader trees while guaranteeing real-time spoken confirmation on every magnification, guide, or matte update.

name: CapacityAllocationStrip
description: Sculpted optical-glass prism-slab storage and resource quota visualizer featuring a header with live formatted usage telemetry and semantic --prism-* quota health badge (Healthy, Near Capacity, Critical Quota), a segmented horizontal optical bar with proportional clickable category slices, hatched Free Space remainder, and a crisp vertical dashed Warning Threshold Marker, interactive category breakdown pills synchronized with the bar via click and IME-safe keyboard activation, a recessed aria-live="polite" telemetry footer, and a clean role="status" empty state.

bestPractices.description: Provide distinct semantic tones (primary, secondary, emerald, info, amber, rose) and concise descriptions per CapacitySegment so operators can immediately correlate bar slices, breakdown pills, and footer inspection readouts.

Align warningThresholdPct and criticalThresholdPct with cluster alerting policies (such as 80% warning and 92% critical) so the dashed threshold marker and semantic badge match PagerDuty/Prometheus alerts.

Pass raw hex or rgb colors or unvalidated division denominators; CapacityAllocationStrip resolves all tones through --prism-* CSS variables, clamps thresholds cleanly, and falls back to a role="status" empty state when no positive quota or segments exist.

accessibility.name: Synchronized Interactive Bar Slices & Category Pills
accessibility.requirement: Native button controls with aria-pressed state, descriptive aria-labels, keyboard-only .prism-focus-ring outlines, IME-safe Enter/Space activation (!e.nativeEvent.isComposing), and Escape/Clear deselection
accessibility.description: Allows keyboard and pointer users to inspect individual storage categories from either the segmented optical bar or the wrapped breakdown pills without losing context.

accessibility.name: Progress Semantics, Non-Color Quota Status & Live Footer Readout
accessibility.requirement: role="region" linked via aria-labelledby, role="progressbar" with aria-valuemin/max/now/valuetext, icon + text quota alert badge, role="status" empty state, and aria-live="polite" telemetry footer
accessibility.description: Communicates storage utilization, warning/critical threshold crossings, and selected category breakdowns clearly to screen readers without relying on color alone.

props.name: segments
props.defaultValue: 5 cluster storage segments (Postgres Volumes, Vector Index, Media Assets, Container Layers, Logs & Traces)
props.description: Categorized capacity allocations rendered as proportional horizontal bar slices and interactive breakdown pills.

props.name: total
props.description: Total capacity quota in the configured unit; triggers a clean role="status" empty state when segments is [] and total <= 0.

props.name: criticalThresholdPct
props.description: Utilization percentage (clamped warningThresholdPct..100) at which the Critical Quota badge activates.

props.description: Visible heading rendered in the prism-slab header and linked via aria-labelledby.

name: CarouselSlider
description: Horizontal optical media showcase with crystal navigation buttons, high-contrast scrim captions, resilient broken-image fallback, keyboard arrow support, and slide indicator dots.

bestPractices.description: Provide descriptive titles and concise captions so text stays legible over the bottom contrast scrim.
Supply stable unique slide IDs and safe image URLs.
Auto-advance slides without offering explicit pause controls.

accessibility.name: Carousel landmark & keyboard navigation
accessibility.requirement: role="region", aria-roledescription="carousel", and Left/Right arrow navigation
accessibility.description: Previous/Next buttons, slide indicator dots, and ArrowLeft/ArrowRight keys allow complete keyboard operation with keyboard-only focus rings.

name: CascadingSelect
description: A multi-level hierarchical selector featuring an optical prism-crystal breadcrumb trigger with inline clear action and a floating prism-slab popover rendering side-by-side level columns (Level 1, Level 2, ...) for drilling down to leaf nodes.

bestPractices.description: Use CascadingSelect for structured 2-to-4 level taxonomies such as Region / Country / City or Product Category / Subcategory / SKU.
Customize the separator prop (e.g. " › " or " / ") to match your application breadcrumb convention.
Nest more than 4–5 deep columns inside a narrow layout without horizontal scrolling consideration; keep branch labels concise.

accessibility.name: Menu Trigger & Popover Semantics
accessibility.requirement: aria-expanded, aria-haspopup="menu", aria-controls, role="menu", role="menuitem"
accessibility.description: Exposes trigger expansion state and links the floating column menu via aria-controls, while rendering the inline Clear (×) action as a distinct sibling button rather than a nested interactive element.

accessibility.name: Keyboard Dismissal & Disabled Node Enforcement
accessibility.requirement: IME-safe Escape closes and returns focus to trigger; ArrowDown opens; disabled trigger and nodes expose aria-disabled
accessibility.description: Closes cleanly on Escape or outside pointer click, returns focus to the trigger button on selection or Escape, and guards disabled nodes from expanding or committing.

name: CascadingSubmenu
description: Multi-level cascading nested optical submenu inside a refractive prism-slab shell featuring directional safe-triangle hover deferral (pure 2D cross-product point-in-triangle geometry via isPointInSafeTriangle), responsive horizontally scrollable side-by-side role="menu" panes so deep 3-level hierarchies never overflow narrow mobile viewports, checkmark and shortcut indicators, full IME-safe WAI-ARIA keyboard traversal (ArrowDown/ArrowUp skipping disabled entries, ArrowRight to open and focus child panes, ArrowLeft/Escape to close and restore parent focus, Enter/Space to activate), and a polite aria-live="polite" status strip announcing opened levels and selected commands.

bestPractices.description: Keep nested command hierarchies to 2 or 3 focused levels with concise labels and optional monospace shortcut badges so diagonal safe-triangle hover traversal stays effortless.
Tune hoverDelayMs (default 160ms, clamped 0..1000ms) to balance forgiving diagonal pointer travel toward open child panes against snappy sibling switching.
Hide essential top-level actions four or more levels deep or rely exclusively on hover without keyboard support; CascadingSubmenu exposes full Arrow/Enter/Space/Escape parity out of the box.

accessibility.name: WAI-ARIA Multi-Level Menu & Submenu Semantics
accessibility.requirement: Adjacent role="menu" panes with role="menuitem" triggers carrying aria-haspopup="menu", aria-expanded, aria-controls, and aria-disabled="true" for disabled items
accessibility.description: Links each expanded parent trigger cleanly to its adjacent child submenu column via aria-controls and exposes disabled states without blocking traversal of enabled siblings.

accessibility.name: IME-Safe Cascading Keyboard Navigation & Polite Announcements
accessibility.requirement: ArrowDown/ArrowUp/Home/End skip disabled items, ArrowRight opens and focuses the first enabled child, ArrowLeft/Escape close the active level and restore parent focus, Enter/Space select or expand, guarded by !e.nativeEvent.isComposing, with .prism-focus-ring and role="status" aria-live="polite"
accessibility.description: Ensures complete keyboard operability across all nesting depths while announcing opened levels and selected command paths inside a non-intrusive polite live region.

props.description: Safe-triangle hover deferral delay in milliseconds (clamped 0..1000). Defers closing or switching an open child submenu while the pointer travels diagonally inside the safe triangle toward that child pane.

name: ChannelStripFader

bestPractices.description: Use controlled valueDb/onChange and muted/onMutedChange when binding multiple ChannelStripFader instances to a Web Audio GainNode mixer rack or DAW automation lane.

Keep the default studio-db scaleMode for mixing desks so engineers can read headroom boosts (+6.0 dB), unity gain (0.0 dB), and floor attenuation (-∞ dB) directly alongside the calibrated rail markings.
Use ChannelStripFader for arbitrary horizontal text-entry ranges or non-audio percentages; prefer RangeSlider or ScrubbableNumberField for generic numeric inputs.

accessibility.name: Vertical WAI-ARIA Slider Semantics & Fine Keyboard Stepping
accessibility.requirement: Exposes role="slider" with aria-orientation="vertical", aria-label="${label} fader level", aria-valuemin/max/now/valuetext, Arrow (±1 dB), Shift+Arrow (±0.5 dB), PageUp/PageDown (±6 dB), Home (minDb), End (maxDb), and 0 (unityDb)
accessibility.description: Guards IME composition on every keydown event, reflects muted status in aria-valuetext, and excludes disabled faders from tab order.

accessibility.name: Tactile Mute Toggle & Keyboard-Only Focus Rings
accessibility.requirement: Pairs prism-focus-ring (:focus-visible) outlines with aria-pressed on the Mute button, Unity snap button, double-click unity reset, and window pointermove/pointerup/pointercancel cleanup
accessibility.description: Guarantees complete single-pointer and keyboard parity without scroll hijacking or leaked window listeners on release, disable, or unmount.

Use controlled activeIndex alongside onActiveIndexChange to synchronize crosshair inspection across sibling dashboard panels or telemetry tables.
Assume every series array contains clean finite numbers; ChartCrosshairTooltip automatically renders a status empty state when no finite values exist and sanitizes isolated non-finite points safely.

accessibility.name: Live Multi-Series Readout & Empty Status
accessibility.requirement: Floating tooltip card announces active multi-series snapshots via role="status" and aria-live="polite", and empty/non-finite datasets render a role="status" fallback message
accessibility.description: Assistive technologies receive concise live updates for the active timestamp, series values, units, and signed deltas without stealing keyboard focus.

Stack dozens of overlapping threshold lines without toggling layers; keep reference lines focused on actionable SLA, SLO, or budget boundaries and rely on the built-in Bands, Thresholds, and Events toggles to isolate layers.

accessibility.description: Every threshold pill and event flag declares role="button", tabIndex={0}, aria-pressed, and a descriptive aria-label announcing exact values, breach counts, or event details while ignoring IME composition commits.

accessibility.name: Polite Live Annotation Inspector & Accessible Empty Region
accessibility.requirement: aria-live="polite" prism-well readout with Clear reset button plus role="status" empty state and aria-pressed layer toggle pills
accessibility.description: Clicking or keyboard-activating any threshold badge or event flag announces breach summaries or event details in a polite live region, while empty or non-finite datasets render a clean role="status" message.

name: CheckpointRollbackStrip

Offer Fork Conversation alongside Rollback so developers can explore an alternate prompt trajectory without discarding the current branch.
Pass negative or non-finite file counts without sanitization; CheckpointRollbackStrip clamps turn and filesChanged counts to non-negative integers.

name: ChordDiagram
description: Optical-glass bi-directional chord diagram arranging entity arc segments around a circular perimeter with subtle angular gaps and proportional curved quadratic-bezier SVG chord ribbons connecting source and target entities, with interactive focus highlighting, unrelated-chord dimming (opacity 0.14), recessed prism-well outbound/inbound telemetry, and --prism-* semantic token styling.

bestPractices.description: Provide 3–8 entities with concise labels and distinct ChordTone assignments so perimeter arcs and intersecting chord ribbons remain visually scannable.
Supply a concise valueUnit (such as "req/s", "MB", or "k") so outbound, inbound, and aggregate flow telemetry readouts remain self-explanatory across themes.

Pass non-positive, NaN, or dangling source/target flow references expecting placeholder chords; invalid records are filtered via prototype-safe Maps and datasets with fewer than two unique entities or zero positive flows automatically render a polite status fallback.

accessibility.name: Interactive Perimeter Arcs & Legend Pills
accessibility.requirement: Every entity SVG arc and synchronized legend pill exposes aria-pressed, descriptive outbound/inbound aria-label, IME-safe Enter/Space toggle activation, and keyboard-only prism-focus-ring outlines
accessibility.description: Selecting an entity highlights connected chords, dims unrelated flows to 0.14 opacity, announces exact outbound and inbound totals inside the aria-live="polite" prism-well telemetry strip, and clears focus cleanly when re-activated or dismissed via Clear Focus.

accessibility.name: Accessible SVG Labeling & Semantic Token Contrast
accessibility.requirement: SVG declares role="img" reflecting active focus state, chord ribbons include native <title> summaries, and entity colors resolve strictly from --prism-* CSS custom properties
accessibility.description: Guarantees relational flow insights remain readable across light, dark, and custom Refractor themes without relying on hardcoded colors or hue alone.

name: ChoroplethMap
description: Accessible optical-glass regional choropleth map featuring built-in stylized vector macro-region world geometry (na, sa, eu, af, me, as, oc) inside a 640×320 SVG viewBox, sanitized custom pathD support with crisp hexagon badge fallbacks, linear --prism-* fillOpacity shading (0.16..0.90), 5-step Low-to-High ramp legend, synchronized regional pills, and a recessed prism-well aria-live readout.

bestPractices.description: Use built-in macro-region IDs (na, sa, eu, af, me, as, oc) for instant world-scale shading, or supply sanitized SVG pathD geometry with optional labelX and labelY anchors for custom territories.

Provide a concise valueUnit (such as "%", "k", or "ms") and short regional detail notes so the header range ramp and recessed selection readout communicate complete context without cluttering the map canvas.

Pass negative, NaN, Infinity, or unsanitized path strings expecting raw passthrough; non-finite and negative regions are filtered automatically, and unsafe pathD strings fall back safely to built-in or hexagonal badge geometry.

accessibility.name: Synchronized Map Polygons & Regional Pill Controls

accessibility.description: Users can inspect any region via pointer or keyboard from either the vector canvas or the regional pill strip, with non-selected regions subtly dimmed while focus is active.

accessibility.name: Polite Live Readout & Semantic Optical Tokens
accessibility.requirement: Recessed prism-well readout uses aria-live="polite" to announce "{name} · {value}{unit} · {sharePct}% of total" plus optional detail, while all fills and strokes derive strictly from --prism-* CSS custom properties
accessibility.description: Ensures regional values, percentage shares, and intensity ranges remain legible across light, dark, and custom Refractor themes without relying on color alone.

Pair a short scannable label on the chip with a richer title and quoted snippet inside the popover.
Trust raw model-generated URLs without sanitization; CitationChip automatically strips unsafe schemes such as javascript:, vbscript:, and data:.

name: ClipTrimHandle
description: Optical-glass timeline clip trim, fade-ramp, and razor-split inspector inside a prism-slab card. Features dimmed source head/tail handles, an active prism-crystal clip body with live SVG quadratic fade-in/fade-out overlay curves, four independent WAI-ARIA slider handles (In-Point, Out-Point, Fade-In, Fade-Out) with window pointer dragging and keyboard stepping, Select/Razor Split mode toggling with midpoint slicing, and a recessed prism-well telemetry bar.

bestPractices.description: Use ClipTrimHandle in NLE video editors, DAW clip inspectors, and timeline sequencers where users trim media in/out boundaries, sculpt fade-in/fade-out envelopes, and slice clips into segments.
Set minClipSec to protect minimum playable frame durations and subscribe to both onChange and onSplit to persist non-destructive edit decision lists (EDLs).
Use ClipTrimHandle for generic numeric range filtering without fade ramps or razor splits; use DualThumbSlider or BrushRangeScrubber instead.

accessibility.name: Quad WAI-ARIA Slider Handles & Keyboard Parity
accessibility.requirement: Exposes four independent role="slider" controls ("Trim clip start", "Trim clip end", "Adjust fade in", "Adjust fade out") with live aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax, aria-valuenow, aria-valuetext, and Arrow (0.5s), Shift+Arrow (0.1s), PageUp/PageDown (2s), and Home/End stepping
accessibility.description: Gives keyboard-only editors full precision over trim boundaries and fade curves while keeping fadeIn + fadeOut <= outSec - inSec and guarding against active IME composition.

accessibility.criterion: 2.4.7 Focus Visible, 2.5.1 Pointer Gestures & 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value
accessibility.requirement: Uses aria-pressed on the Select/Razor Split tool toggle, prism-focus-ring keyboard-only outlines, tabIndex=-1 when disabled, and guaranteed window pointer listener cleanup on pointerup, pointercancel, disable, and unmount
accessibility.description: Prevents leaked window drag listeners across unmounts, suppresses focus rings during pointer interaction, and exposes Split at Midpoint as a keyboard-accessible alternative to canvas clicking.

name: ClockCalendarPopover
description: Optical-glass system clock anchor and popover combining a deterministic UTC 42-day monthly calendar grid, selected-day agenda list, and secondary world-clock timezone readouts inside a `prism-slab` container. Features a responsive `flex-wrap` clock trigger pill (`aria-haspopup="dialog"`, `aria-expanded`) displaying a host-timezone-independent day and UTC time readout, Previous/Next month navigation across year boundaries, a Today reset shortcut, event indicator dots, IME-safe Arrow key date traversal, world-clock offset arithmetic with `Today`/`+1d`/`-1d` rollover badges and `UTC±HH:MM` pills, IME-safe `Escape` dismissal with focus restoration, and polite `aria-live="polite"` announcements.

bestPractices.description: Use `ClockCalendarPopover` in desktop-style system bars, control centers, and global operations consoles where users inspect dates, daily agendas, and distributed team timezones simultaneously.
Pass a deterministic UTC ISO timestamp via `referenceUtcIso` in SSR, snapshots, and multi-region dashboards to eliminate host-timezone rendering drift.
Do not rely on local host `Date` formatting when supplying `agendaItems` — always provide canonical `YYYY-MM-DD` `dateIso` keys so calendar dots and agenda panels remain aligned across timezones.

accessibility.name: Dialog Trigger, Pressed Day Buttons & Empty Agenda Status
accessibility.requirement: Exposes `aria-haspopup="dialog"`, `aria-expanded`, and `aria-controls` on the system clock trigger button, renders calendar dates as `<button>` elements with `aria-pressed`, `aria-current="date"` on today, descriptive `aria-label` values, and uses `role="status"` for empty-agenda feedback
accessibility.description: Ensures screen-reader and keyboard users understand popover state, active date selection, today indicator, event counts per date, and empty-day agenda state.

accessibility.name: IME-Safe Arrow Traversal, Escape Focus Restoration & Live Announcements
accessibility.requirement: Guards Arrow key calendar navigation and `Escape` dismissal against IME composition (`isComposing`), restores focus to the clock trigger button on `Escape`, applies `.prism-focus-ring` (`:focus-visible`) to every interactive control, and announces month/date/popover updates via `aria-live="polite"`
accessibility.description: Prevents accidental dismissal or navigation during IME input while maintaining predictable keyboard focus and screen-reader feedback.

props.name: worldClocks
props.description: Secondary world-clock zones formatted strictly via UTC offset arithmetic with local `HH:MM`, day delta (`Today`, `+1d`, `-1d`), and `UTC±HH:MM` offset pills.

props.description: Scheduled events matched by `dateIso` (`YYYY-MM-DD`) to render calendar dot indicators and the selected-day agenda list.

bestPractices.description: Provide explicit language ("typescript", "json", or "css") and a descriptive label prop so syntax highlighting and assistive technology labels match the edited file.
Pass 1-based line numbers in diagnostics so gutter indicators and the live diagnostic panel jump accurately to offending lines.
Use dangerouslySetInnerHTML for syntax highlighting; CodeEditor renders every token strictly as escaped React <span> text nodes.

accessibility.description: Enter auto-indentation ignores IME composition events, gutter line buttons and diagnostic items provide explicit line/severity aria-labels, and focus outlines appear only on keyboard navigation.

name: CohortRetentionGrid
description: Accessible optical-glass triangular SaaS cohort retention matrix wrapped in an overflow-x-auto prism-well scroll container. Features a sculpted prism-slab header with total cohort users badge, M1/M3 weighted average retention pills, a 5-step 0%..100% --prism-* intensity scale legend, interactive proportionally shaded period cells with muted unelapsed future period dashes, an optional <tfoot> Weighted Avg footer row, and a recessed aria-live="polite" cell inspector.

bestPractices.description: Pass null for future unelapsed retention periods to form a crisp triangular retention staircase while automatically excluding unelapsed cohorts from period weighted averages.
Match periodPrefix ("M" for months, "W" for weeks, "Q" for quarters) to your reporting cadence and pair onSelectCell with downstream drill-down charts or user segment lists.
Rely on unvalidated retention percentages outside 0..100 or non-finite user counts; CohortRetentionGrid sanitizes sizes, clamps retention percentages, and treats non-finite periods as unelapsed.

accessibility.name: Semantic Cohort Table & Responsive Horizontal Scroll Container
accessibility.requirement: Semantic <table> with <thead> column headers (scope="col"), <tbody> cohort row headers (scope="row"), optional <tfoot> Weighted Avg summary row, and direct overflow-x-auto prism-well scroll container
accessibility.description: Preserves screen-reader row/column header associations while allowing dense multi-period retention matrices to scroll horizontally on mobile and tablet viewports without page overflow.

accessibility.description: Clicking or keyboard-activating any elapsed period cell highlights it and announces the exact cohort, period, retention percentage, and retained user count.

Hardcode raw hex or rgb colors into stop definitions; GradientStopEditor binds every stop to semantic optical palette tokens (primary, secondary, emerald, amber, rose, info) via color-mix(in srgb, var(--prism-...) <opacity>%, transparent) so gradients adapt live across Refractor themes.

name: HardwareOsdHud
description: Centered, non-interactive translucent optical Hardware HUD (OSD) housed inside a `prism-slab` stage that appears briefly and fades out when adjusting system volume, screen brightness, media playback, or Caps Lock. The floating `prism-crystal` OSD capsule uses `pointer-events-none`, `role="status"`, `aria-live="polite"`, `aria-atomic="true"`, and `data-visible` transitions to present a 16-segment optical level bar and clamped `0..100%` tabular readout for Volume (`--prism-primary-main` or muted dimmed) and Brightness (`--prism-warning-main`), or semantic optical state pills for Media Playback (`Playing` `--prism-success-main` / `Paused` `--prism-info-main`) and Caps Lock (`ON` `--prism-primary-main` / `OFF` `--prism-text-secondary`). Supports optional `autoHideMs` timed fadeout with automatic timer reset on re-trigger and strict cleanup on hide/unmount, plus an optional interactive Hardware Key Simulator strip (`showDemoTriggers`) for immediately testing all 4 HUD kinds.

bestPractices.description: Keep the centered OSD capsule strictly non-interactive (`pointer-events-none`) so transient volume, brightness, media, or Caps Lock overlays never intercept clicks or drag gestures on underlying windows.

Use `autoHideMs` (for example `1500` to `2500` ms) with controlled `payload` and `visible` / `onVisibleChange` when binding `HardwareOsdHud` to real OS media keys or hardware shortcut listeners, and pass `showDemoTriggers={false}` in production overlays.

Do not pass unvalidated `NaN`, `Infinity`, or out-of-bounds percentages expecting bar overflow; `HardwareOsdHud` strictly clamps level values to `[0..100]` and sanitizes invalid `autoHideMs` durations safely.

accessibility.name: Non-Intrusive Polite Live Status Region
accessibility.requirement: Renders the centered HUD capsule with `role="status"`, `aria-live="polite"`, `aria-atomic="true"`, `pointer-events-none`, and reflected `data-visible="true" | "false"` state
accessibility.description: Announces hardware volume, mute, brightness, playback, and Caps Lock updates politely to assistive technologies without stealing keyboard focus from active user workflows.

accessibility.name: IME-Safe Simulator Controls & Keyboard-Only Focus Rings
accessibility.requirement: Guards simulator keydown events against active IME composition (`event.nativeEvent.isComposing`), applies keyboard-only `.prism-focus-ring`, and reflects pressed state via `aria-pressed` on toggle keys (`Mute`, `Media Play/Pause`, `Caps Lock`)
accessibility.description: Ensures interactive hardware key simulator buttons are fully keyboard operable without showing focus outlines on mouse click or interfering with CJK/IME input.

name: HardwarePortStrip
description: Realistic 1U optical-glass network switch and hardware patch bay inside a prism-slab featuring a top chassis header with live Up/Warning/Down counters, active PoE wattage load, and status filters; a mobile-safe horizontally scrollable 1U faceplate with sculpted rack ears and accessible port bays displaying authentic RJ45, PoE, USB-C, and SFP+ SVG socket glyphs (`viewBox="0 0 28 22"`) and semantic status LED dots; plus an aria-live recessed port diagnostic inspector with interactive administrative Enable/Disable port toggling.

bestPractices.description: Use HardwarePortStrip for switchport management, studio patch bays, PoE budget inspection, and edge IoT gateway diagnostics where physical port placement and instant status LED visibility matter.
Bind controlled ports, selectedPortId, onSelectPort, and onTogglePortAdmin props when synchronizing faceplate telemetry and switchport admin state with SNMP, NETCONF, or REST management backends.
Encode link states solely with color without pairing the semantic status badge and accessible port labels; HardwarePortStrip pairs every LED dot with explicit text readouts and aria-label metadata.

accessibility.requirement: Implements roving tabindex across visible faceplate port buttons with IME-safe ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, Home, and End navigation plus keyboard-only .prism-focus-ring outlines

accessibility.name: Live Diagnostic Readouts & Semantic Controls
accessibility.requirement: Uses role="region" labeled by the chassis heading, aria-pressed on status filters, port tiles, and admin toggle controls, role="status" empty states, and an aria-live="polite" diagnostic inspector
accessibility.description: Communicates locked selection, hover/focus previews, empty filter results, and administrative Enable/Disable state changes cleanly to screen readers.

name: HexbinDensityPlot
description: Optical-glass bivariate hexagonal binning density plot that aggregates dense 2D scatter datasets into a responsive staggered honeycomb SVG lattice (440×250) using axial cube-rounded nearest-hex assignment. Features a sculpted prism-slab header with total points & populated bin telemetry pill, a 5-step Low..Peak --prism-* intensity scale legend, interactive count-shaded hexagon cells with keyboard stepping (Enter/Space/ArrowLeft/ArrowRight), and a recessed aria-live="polite" cluster inspector.

bestPractices.description: Use HexbinDensityPlot instead of raw scatter plots whenever overplotting obscures dense clusters; tune columns (5..16) to balance spatial resolution against per-bin sample counts.
Provide descriptive unit-bearing xLabel and yLabel strings (such as "Request Size (KB)" and "Response Time (ms)") and pair onSelectHex with downstream trace or record drill-down views.

Pre-filter NaN or Infinity coordinates manually or supply hardcoded hex colors; HexbinDensityPlot drops non-finite points safely, handles degenerate single-value domains, and derives all honeycomb shading from --prism-* CSS custom properties.

accessibility.description: Keyboard and assistive-technology users can step sequentially across populated hexagons, hear exact bin coordinates, centroid values, point counts, and share percentages, and inspect dense hotspots without requiring a pointer.

name: LiveLogStreamer
description: Optical-glass real-time log tailing viewport featuring a prism-slab filter header with case-insensitive message/source/timestamp search, toggleable severity pills with live per-level counts, Follow/Paused tailing controls, Jump-to-Bottom recovery when paused, optional Clear action, and a recessed monospace log well with tabular timestamps.

bestPractices.description: Assign stable, unique id values to each LogEntry so React reconciles streaming additions without losing scroll position.
Provide concise source tags (e.g. "api", "worker", "bundler") so operators can quickly narrow multi-service streams via search.
Inject raw ANSI or HTML markup expecting innerHTML parsing; LiveLogStreamer renders every message strictly as literal text for XSS safety.

accessibility.name: Adaptive Live Log Region
accessibility.requirement: role="log" with aria-live="polite" when following and aria-live="off" when paused
accessibility.description: Pauses assistive-technology announcements automatically when operators pause tailing to inspect historical output, preventing speech queue floods.

accessibility.name: Toggle Press State & IME-Safe Filtering
accessibility.requirement: aria-pressed on severity/follow toggles, prism-focus-ring, IME-guarded search key handling
accessibility.description: Exposes pressed state on severity pills and Follow/Paused controls while guarding Escape search clearing against active IME composition.

name: LivePresenceIndicator
description: Optical glass multiplayer presence bar featuring an overlapping prism-crystal avatar stack with live status indicators, sanitized portrait fallback initials, an interactive collaborator detail pill, a +N prism-slab overflow popover, live active/editing counters, and an optional studio-grid live cursor stage.

bestPractices.description: Use LivePresenceIndicator in collaborative editors, canvases, and dashboards to communicate active participants without obstructing content.
Set maxVisible between 3 and 5 in compact toolbars so remaining collaborators collapse cleanly into the keyboard-accessible +N overflow popover.
Pass unsanitized javascript: avatar URLs or unvalidated CSS strings into user.color; both are sanitized automatically with safe fallbacks.

accessibility.name: Interactive Collaborator Controls & Disclosure
accessibility.requirement: aria-pressed avatar buttons, aria-expanded +N overflow trigger, Escape dismissal
accessibility.description: Each collaborator avatar exposes name and status via aria-label with keyboard-only prism-focus-ring styling, while the overflow popover closes on Escape, outside click, or trigger re-click.

accessibility.name: Live Status Announcements & Contrast Safety
accessibility.requirement: aria-live="polite" collaborator detail pill and WCAG contrast text selection on cursor labels
accessibility.description: Selecting a collaborator announces their role, status, and live activity in a polite status region, and live cursor label pills automatically choose high-contrast foreground ink.

name: LiveTelemetryChart
description: Optical-glass real-time streaming telemetry chart with a LIVE/PAUSED status header, selectable rolling window pills (20, 40, 60), controlled or uncontrolled pause snapshots with buffered-sample tracking, optional interval streaming and deterministic Step trigger, 4-stat Current/Min/Avg/Max strip, warning threshold line, linear-gradient area fill, keyboard-inspectable SVG points, and a recessed prism-well inspector bar powered exclusively by --prism-* tokens.

bestPractices.description: Configure warningThreshold to highlight SLA or latency breaches directly on the chart canvas, Current stat tile, and sample inspector using --prism-error-main without hardcoding colors.
Provide onGenerateSample alongside streamingIntervalMs for autonomous live telemetry polling, or leave streamingIntervalMs at 0 to allow deterministic manual stepping via the Step button.
Mutate the samples array in place or rely on raw unguarded NaN values; pass immutable sample updates so React detects changes and LiveTelemetryChart filters out non-finite readings safely.

accessibility.name: Interactive Controls & Keyboard Point Inspection
accessibility.requirement: Window size pills and Pause/Resume controls expose aria-pressed with keyboard-only prism-focus-ring; SVG sample points expose role="button", tabIndex={0}, IME-safe Enter/Space activation, and descriptive aria-labels
accessibility.description: Keyboard and assistive-technology users can switch rolling window lengths, pause or resume live streaming, step deterministic samples, inspect individual data points, and hear readout updates via aria-live="polite".

accessibility.name: Non-Color Threshold & Stream State Indicators
accessibility.requirement: Pairs color tokens with explicit LIVE/PAUSED text badges, buffered sample counters, dashed WARN threshold labels, and textual Warning pills
accessibility.description: Ensures streaming status, buffered backlog, and threshold breaches remain legible across all optical glass themes and color-vision profiles.

name: LockScreenOverlay
description: Frosted-glass OS lock screen barrier rendered inside a sculpted `prism-slab` surface. Displays a large tabular clock and date header, an accessible user avatar switcher (`role="radiogroup"` with circular `--prism-primary-main` active halos), an authentication form with Show/Hide password visibility toggle, IME-safe `Enter` submission, and passwordless `Enter Guest Session` support, plus bottom quick power controls (`Sleep`, `Restart`, `Shut Down`) and polite `aria-live="polite"` status announcements. In `mode="inline"`, unlocking reveals a clean confirmation bar with a `Lock Screen` button to re-lock interactively; in `mode="fullscreen"`, unlocking returns `null` to clear the viewport barrier.

bestPractices.description: Use `mode="fullscreen"` paired with controlled `locked` and `onLockChange` for full-viewport OS or kiosk session barriers, and `mode="inline"` for embedded security previews, demos, or workspace lock cards.

Validate submitted credentials inside `onUnlock(user, credential)` and return `false` to reject invalid credentials without unlocking; `LockScreenOverlay` keeps credentials strictly in ephemeral component memory and clears them immediately on account switch or successful unlock.
Persist or log raw passwords from `onUnlock` in client-side storage or console output; hand credentials directly to your authentication transport and clear references promptly.

accessibility.name: User Account Radiogroup, Password Input & Modal Barrier Semantics
accessibility.criterion: 1.3.1 Info and Relationships & 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value
accessibility.requirement: Uses `role="radiogroup"` (`aria-label="Select user account"`) with roving-tabindex `role="radio"` avatar buttons reflecting `aria-checked`, an explicitly labeled `<input type="password" aria-label="Password or PIN">` paired with `aria-invalid`/`aria-describedby` and a `role="alert"` error message, and wraps `mode="fullscreen"` inside `role="dialog" aria-modal="true"`
accessibility.description: Allows assistive technologies to identify active accounts, navigate user avatars via arrow keys, read inline validation errors, and understand fullscreen modal scope.

accessibility.name: IME-Safe Submission, Keyboard-Only Focus Rings & Polite Status Updates
accessibility.requirement: Guards keyboard `Enter` unlock and radiogroup arrow navigation with `!event.nativeEvent.isComposing`, applies `.prism-focus-ring` (`:focus-visible`) to all interactive controls, and broadcasts account switches, failed unlock attempts, unlock/re-lock transitions, and power requests to an `aria-live="polite"` status region
accessibility.description: Prevents CJK/IME composition commits from accidentally submitting partial passwords while delivering concise screen-reader confirmation for every security and power action.

props.name: mode
props.description: Presentation mode: `inline` embeds the lock screen and unlocked confirmation bar inside a `prism-slab`; `fullscreen` mounts a fixed frosted backdrop dialog when locked and returns `null` when unlocked.

props.name: locked
props.description: Controlled lock state. Pair with `onLockChange` to drive session lock state externally.

props.description: Initial lock state when running in uncontrolled mode.

props.description: Large tabular clock readout rendered in the lock screen header.
