props.name: defaultSelectedUserId
props.description: Initial active user account ID selected on mount; falls back to the first account if not found.

props.name: onUnlock
props.description: Invoked on unlock submission with the active user and entered credential (`""` for passwordless accounts). Return `false` to reject unlock and display an inline error.

props.name: onLockChange
props.description: Invoked whenever the lock screen transitions between locked (`true`) and unlocked (`false`) states.

props.name: onPowerAction
props.description: Invoked when the user triggers Sleep, Restart, or Shut Down from the quick power cluster.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables account switching, password entry, visibility toggling, unlock/re-lock buttons, and power controls.

props.name: xstyle
props.description: Typed `--prism-*` CSS custom property and optical inline style overrides.

name: LollipopChart
description: Low-ink optical-glass Lollipop ranking chart inside a sculpted prism-slab card featuring interactive Horizontal/Vertical orientation switching, High→Low / Low→High / A→Z sort pills, a responsive 460×230 SVG inside a recessed prism-well rendering thin 2.5px stems capped with 6.5px sculpted optical terminal circles, an optional dashed reference or auto-computed average line, keyboard-navigable stems, and a recessed aria-live="polite" readout displaying Rank #N · Label · Value · Delta vs Reference/Average powered exclusively by --prism-* CSS custom properties.

bestPractices.description: Use LollipopChart instead of dense bar charts when ranking 5 to 12 categories where high data-ink efficiency and clear visual separation around a mean or target reference line improve executive scanning.

Supply explicit valuePrefix (e.g. "$") and unit (e.g. "k", "%", "ms") tokens alongside an optional referenceValue target so tabular value labels, dashed threshold annotations, and delta readouts stay consistent across orientations.

Hardcode raw hex or rgb colors or pass unsorted duplicate keys without stable ids; LollipopChart maps every stem and optical terminal circle exclusively to semantic --prism-* CSS variables and safely deduplicates keys and non-finite inputs.

accessibility.name: Keyboard-Navigable Stems & Interactive Mode Controls
accessibility.requirement: Header Horizontal/Vertical orientation and High→Low / Low→High / A→Z sort pills declare native button aria-pressed states, while every SVG stem group exposes role="button", tabIndex={0}, aria-pressed, and a descriptive aria-label with IME-safe Enter/Space activation, ArrowUp/ArrowDown/ArrowLeft/ArrowRight cyclic focus traversal, and keyboard-only prism-focus-ring outlines
accessibility.description: Allows full keyboard exploration of ranked items in both horizontal and vertical layouts while cleanly highlighting the focused stem and softening inactive stems.

accessibility.name: Polite Live Ranking Readout & Non-Color Redundancy
accessibility.criterion: 1.1.1 Non-text Content, 1.4.1 Use of Color & 4.1.3 Status Messages
accessibility.requirement: SVG declares role="img" with active orientation and item count, empty datasets render a clean role="status" message, and the recessed aria-live="polite" prism-well readout announces Rank #N · Label · Value · signed Delta vs Reference/Average
accessibility.description: Ensures ranked comparisons and variance against target or average benchmarks remain legible across light, dark, and custom Refractor themes without relying solely on color.

name: MarimekkoChart
description: Optical-glass 2D proportional Marimekko (mosaic) chart inside a sculpted prism-slab card with a grand total telemetry pill, interactive legend pills cycling semantic --prism-* tones (--prism-primary-main, --prism-secondary-main, --prism-success-main, --prism-warning-main, --prism-info-main), a responsive 460×220 SVG inside a recessed prism-well where column widths scale proportionally to column totals and vertical stacked segments sum to 100% column height, 2D keyboard navigation across focusable SVG rects, and an aria-live="polite" recessed inspector strip.

bestPractices.description: Use consistent segment labels across columns (such as product lines across regions) so interactive legend pills automatically group series and cross-highlight matching segments across every column.
Pair valuePrefix (e.g. "$", "€") and valueUnit (e.g. "M", "B", "k") so grand total badges, column footers, and the live inspector strip stay compact across mobile and desktop viewports.

Pass zero, negative, or non-finite segment values expecting empty bars; non-positive and non-finite segments are sanitized out automatically, and datasets with total value <= 0 display a clean role="status" empty state.

accessibility.name: 2D Keyboard-Focusable SVG Mosaic Segments & IME Safety
accessibility.requirement: Every segment <rect> exposes role="button", tabIndex={0}, aria-pressed, and a complete aria-label with IME-safe Enter/Space selection plus ArrowLeft/ArrowRight/ArrowUp/ArrowDown 2D traversal and keyboard-only prism-focus-ring outlines
accessibility.description: Enables full keyboard navigation between stacked segments and neighboring columns while visually highlighting the active segment and softly dimming unrelated segments.

accessibility.name: Interactive Series Legend & Live Telemetry Inspector
accessibility.requirement: Legend pills expose native <button> semantics with aria-pressed and numeric global share percentages, paired with an aria-live="polite" prism-well inspector announcing Column · Segment · Value · Column Share % · Global Share %
accessibility.description: Ensures screen-reader and keyboard users receive complete quantitative market-share context without relying solely on color or visual area estimation.

name: MarqueeSelectionBox
description: Interactive translucent optical lasso marquee selection surface over a responsive file grid housed inside a sculpted `prism-slab` container. Supports real-time pointer rubber-band dragging in any direction with live AABB bounding-box intersection against every tile, additive `Shift`/`Ctrl`/`Meta` marquee dragging and click toggling, `Select All` and `Clear` header actions, full IME-safe keyboard grid traversal (`Arrow` keys, `Home`/`End`, `Space`/`Enter`, `Ctrl+A`/`Meta+A`, `Escape`), leak-free window pointer cleanup, and an `aria-live="polite"` selection summary.

bestPractices.description: Use `MarqueeSelectionBox` for desktop-grade file explorers, asset libraries, shader banks, and media bins where users routinely batch-select items via pointer rubber-band drag or keyboard multi-select.

Supply stable unique `id` values on every `MarqueeSelectableItem` and pair controlled `selectedIds` with `onSelectionChange` when synchronizing selection with bulk action toolbars or detail inspectors.

Rely on raw pointer dragging alone without keyboard alternatives or pass raw HTML inside item names; `MarqueeSelectionBox` renders every `name` and `sizeLabel` safely as literal text and provides full keyboard selection parity.

accessibility.name: WAI-ARIA Multiselectable Listbox Grid with Roving Focus & IME Guard
accessibility.requirement: Exposes role="region" linked via aria-labelledby, role="listbox" with aria-multiselectable="true", role="option" tiles with aria-selected, Arrow/Home/End focus movement, Space/Enter toggle, Ctrl/Meta+A select-all, and Escape clear guarded by !e.nativeEvent.isComposing
accessibility.description: Guarantees full keyboard parity with pointer lasso selection, preserves keyboard-only .prism-focus-ring focus indicators, and removes disabled tiles from tab order.

accessibility.name: Leak-Free Window Pointer Lifecycle & Polite Live Selection Announcements
accessibility.criterion: 2.4.7 Focus Visible, 2.5.1 Pointer Gestures & 4.1.3 Status Messages
accessibility.requirement: Detaches window pointermove/pointerup/pointercancel listeners on pointer release, pointercancel, disable, empty items, or unmount while announcing live selection counts and names in an aria-live="polite" summary and role="status" empty state
accessibility.description: Prevents dangling global listeners during mid-drag interruptions and keeps screen reader users informed as batch selections change.

name: MarqueeTicker
description: Sculpted optical-glass horizontal prism-slab ticker ribbon featuring a tactile WCAG 2.2.2 Pause / Play toggle button with controlled/uncontrolled state, a live/paused semantic indicator dot (--prism-success-main / --prism-warning-main), token-driven edge fade masks, hover/focus pause support, interactive IME-safe primary ticker pills, and an aria-hidden duplicate strip for seamless infinite looping.

bestPractices.description: Keep pauseOnHover enabled (default true) and retain the built-in Pause / Play toggle button so readers and assistive technology users can inspect moving metrics comfortably under WCAG 2.2.2.

Provide concise label, value, and delta strings alongside semantic tone tokens (neutral, primary, emerald, amber, rose) so every pill scans cleanly at high velocity across light and dark optical themes.
Rely on color alone to communicate positive or negative changes; pair semantic tones with explicit sign prefixes (such as "+2.4%" or "-1.2ms") and concise metric labels.

accessibility.name: WCAG 2.2.2 Pause, Stop, Hide & Reduced Motion
accessibility.criterion: 2.2.2 Pause, Stop, Hide & 2.3.3 Animation from Interactions
accessibility.requirement: Built-in tactile Pause / Play toggle button with aria-pressed, hover/focus auto-pause (pauseOnHover), and prefers-reduced-motion CSS pause guard
accessibility.description: Users can explicitly pause or resume continuous ticker motion via pointer or keyboard, hovering or tabbing onto items pauses playback automatically, and prefers-reduced-motion: reduce halts animation immediately.

accessibility.name: Deduplicated Screen-Reader Tree & IME-Safe Pill Activation
accessibility.requirement: Primary strip renders semantic list items with keyboard-only prism-focus-ring buttons and IME-safe Enter/Space handling; duplicate loop strip is marked aria-hidden="true" with non-focusable spans
accessibility.description: Screen readers announce each live metric exactly once while keyboard users navigate primary pills smoothly without trapping focus or hijacking IME composition.

name: MaskedPatternInput

Inspect meta.complete and meta.unmasked from onChange before enabling form submission so partial codes are never dispatched as valid identifiers.
Strip separators with ad-hoc regular expressions after receiving input; consume meta.unmasked directly from applyPatternMask() or the onChange callback.

accessibility.description: Keeps the masked monospace input clearly identified and notifies assistive technologies as the user transitions between Incomplete and Complete states.

accessibility.name: Keyboard-Only Focus Rings & Disabled Affordances
accessibility.requirement: Uses prism-focus-ring keyboard focus indicators and pairs disabled with disabled:cursor-not-allowed across both the input and Clear button
accessibility.description: Preserves crisp keyboard navigation while preventing pointer hover promises or mutations when disabled.

name: MasonryGrid

Use renderItem when cards require bespoke interactive media, badges, or action footers while retaining semantic listitem wrappers.
Use MasonryGrid for tabular financial comparisons where strict row alignment matters; use DataTable instead.

name: MasterDetailView
description: Unified optical glass split workspace pairing a searchable crystal master list pane and emerald active row indicator with a responsive detail canvas and mobile back-to-list trigger.

bestPractices.description: Provide stable unique item IDs and concise titles/subtitles so records scan cleanly inside the master pane.
Use controlled `selectedId` + `onSelectItem` when synchronizing selection with URL routes or external state.
Nest heavy multi-pane layouts inside `renderDetail`; keep the detail surface focused on the active record.

accessibility.name: Listbox selection and keyboard navigation
accessibility.requirement: role="listbox", role="option", aria-selected, ArrowUp/ArrowDown/Home/End
accessibility.description: Master items expose listbox/option semantics with aria-selected, full Arrow/Home/End keyboard traversal across filtered entries, keyboard-only focus rings, and IME-safe search input.

name: MatrixHeatmap
description: Accessible optical-glass intensity heatmap table backed by a prototype-safe Map<string, number> coordinate store, normalized --prism-* tone opacity ramp (0.10..0.90), 5-step Low-to-High header legend, and a recessed prism-well selection readout strip.

bestPractices.description: Supply concise rowLabels and colLabels alongside finite HeatmapCell coordinates so every matrix cell fits comfortably without cramped wrapping.
Choose a semantic MatrixHeatmapTone (primary, secondary, emerald, rose) and toggle showValues={false} on dense matrices where the recessed readout strip provides exact inspection.
Rely on unvalidated out-of-bounds indices or NaN/Infinity values; out-of-bounds and non-finite cells are safely filtered before computing the intensity ramp.

accessibility.name: Semantic Table Sections & Axis Headers
accessibility.requirement: Semantic <table> with <thead> column headers (scope="col"), <tbody> row headers (scope="row"), and aria-labelledby heading binding
accessibility.description: Hydration-safe table markup associates every matrix cell button with both its row and column labels.

accessibility.name: Interactive Matrix Cells & Live Readout
accessibility.criterion: 2.1.1 Keyboard, 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value & 4.1.3 Status Messages
accessibility.requirement: Native cell buttons with aria-pressed, descriptive "${rowLabel} × ${colLabel}: ${value}" aria-label, IME-safe Enter/Space activation, keyboard-only prism-focus-ring, and polite aria-live readout
accessibility.description: Clicking, focusing, or activating any populated cell highlights it and announces the exact coordinate value in the recessed prism-well readout.

props.description: Ordered labels for each matrix row rendered as scope="row" headers.

props.name: colLabels
props.description: Ordered labels for each matrix column rendered inside <thead>.

props.name: cells
props.description: Array of { row, col, value } coordinates stored in a prototype-safe Map<string, number>.

props.name: tone
props.description: Semantic --prism-* optical tone used for the 0.10..0.90 opacity intensity ramp.

props.name: title
props.description: Heading displayed alongside the 5-step Low-to-High legend in the slab header.

props.name: valueUnit
props.description: Optional unit suffix appended to cell labels, legend range, and active readout.

props.name: showValues
props.description: Controls whether formatted numeric values render directly inside each matrix cell.

props.name: onSelectCell
props.type: (cell: HeatmapCell, rowLabel: string, colLabel: string) => void
props.description: Callback fired whenever a populated cell is clicked, focused, or activated via keyboard.

props.name: xstyle
props.description: Typed CSS custom properties and optical style overrides.

name: MeasurementUnitInput
description: Unified optical-glass compound input joining a recessed numeric prism-well spinbutton (with ArrowUp/ArrowDown stepping and blur/Enter clamping) seamlessly with an attached prism-crystal unit switcher, optional proportional unit conversion via factorToBase, and a live tabular summary badge.

bestPractices.description: Supply finite positive factorToBase multipliers on comparable units (such as px = 1 and rem = 16, or ms = 1 and s = 1000) and enable convertOnUnitChange when users expect values to rescale automatically.
Keep convertOnUnitChange={false} when mixing incomparable units like px, %, and ms so switching units preserves the entered numeric scalar.
Provide zero or negative factorToBase values; MeasurementUnitInput safely ignores non-positive or non-finite conversion factors instead of dividing by zero.

accessibility.name: Spinbutton Semantics & Attached Unit Switcher
accessibility.criterion: 1.3.1 Info and Relationships & 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value
accessibility.requirement: role="spinbutton" with aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax, aria-valuenow, aria-valuetext, explicit label linkage, and aria-label="Unit"
accessibility.description: Exposes numeric range metadata and unit-qualified valuetext to assistive technology while pairing an accessible native unit selector and polite role="status" summary badge.

accessibility.name: Keyboard Stepping, IME Safety & Focus Visibility
accessibility.requirement: ArrowUp/ArrowDown stepping by step, IME-guarded Enter commits, and keyboard-only prism-focus-ring outlines
accessibility.description: Supports incremental keyboard adjustments clamped to min..max while ignoring keys during IME composition.

props.description: When true and both old and new units specify finite factorToBase > 0, converts amount * oldFactor / newFactor rounded to 3 decimals and clamped to min..max.

props.description: Typed CSS custom properties and inline optical style overrides.

name: MediaLightbox
description: Dark optical-glass media viewer supporting both fullscreen overlay and embedded inline slab modes, 100%–300% stepped zoom with pointer drag-to-pan, circular previous/next navigation, keyboard shortcuts, clickable thumbnail filmstrip, and strict URL protocol sanitization for images and videos.

bestPractices.description: Provide descriptive item titles and optional captions so screen readers and header bars clearly identify each inspected asset.
Use mode="inline" inside documentation studios or split inspection panes, and mode="overlay" with controlled open/onOpenChange for modal gallery launches.
Bypass URL sanitization by embedding raw data:text/html or javascript: URIs; MediaLightbox blocks untrusted protocols and displays a safe notice automatically.

accessibility.description: Exposes role="dialog" with aria-modal="true" in overlay mode and role="region" in inline mode, with labeled controls and keyboard-only focus rings.

accessibility.name: Safe Media Fallback & Filmstrip State
accessibility.requirement: Blocked URLs announce via role="status"; active filmstrip thumbnail exposes aria-pressed and aria-current
accessibility.description: Never renders unsafe media elements and communicates the active slide index via a tabular X / Y counter and explicit filmstrip selection attributes.

name: MemoryPersonaInspector
description: Optical-glass inline panel or slide-over drawer for inspecting, filtering, adding, inline-editing, and forgetting persistent AI agent memories categorized into Facts, Preferences, and Rules.

bestPractices.description: Surface stored agent memories transparently so users can inspect, edit, or forget individual facts, preferences, and standing rules at any time.
Use mode="drawer" with controlled open/onOpenChange when launching the inspector from a chat header or settings button, and mode="inline" inside dedicated settings pages.
Persist blank memory edits or expose raw HTML inside memory content; MemoryPersonaInspector renders all memory text literally and ignores whitespace-only edits or additions.

accessibility.requirement: role="region" in inline mode, role="dialog" aria-modal="true" in drawer mode with Escape/backdrop/Close dismissal
accessibility.description: Provides clear landmark semantics in both embedded and drawer presentations while protecting in-progress inline edits when Escape is pressed.

accessibility.name: Filter Toggle Pills & IME-Safe Inline Editing
accessibility.requirement: aria-pressed on category filter pills, unique Edit/Forget button labels per memory, and !e.nativeEvent.isComposing guards on Enter
accessibility.description: Announces active filter state and per-item actions clearly for assistive technologies and prevents CJK/IME composition commits from triggering premature saves.

name: MergedWindowTabBar
description: Browser-style merged window tab strip integrated directly into an optical-glass window titlebar inside a sculpted `prism-slab` frame. Combines semantic window chrome controls (`--prism-error-main`, `--prism-warning-main`, `--prism-success-main`), a horizontally scrollable `role="tablist"` with unsaved dirty indicators (`--prism-primary-main`), per-tab detach and close actions, collision-safe `+ New Tab` creation, HTML5 drag-and-drop and `Alt+ArrowLeft`/`Alt+ArrowRight` keyboard reordering, IME-safe roving tab switching (`ArrowLeft`/`ArrowRight`/`Home`/`End`), an interactive `Detached Windows` tear-off/merge-back shelf, a compact active tab preview pane (or `role="status"` empty state), and an `aria-live="polite"` status bar.

bestPractices.description: Use `MergedWindowTabBar` for multi-document optical workspaces, studio editors, and desktop-class shells where users merge documents into a single titlebar and tear tabs off into standalone windows.

Wire `onTabsChange`, `onSelectTab`, and `onTearOffTab` in controlled workspaces so detached tabs can spawn native floating windows or sync across split panes while preserving clean keyboard reordering.
Do not rely solely on pointer drag-and-drop for tab ordering; keep tabs focusable so keyboard users can always reorder tabs with `Alt+ArrowLeft` / `Alt+ArrowRight` and switch tabs with arrow keys.

accessibility.name: ARIA Tablist, Roving Tabindex & Keyboard Reordering
accessibility.requirement: role="tablist" with aria-label="Merged window tabs", role="tab" with aria-selected and aria-controls linked to role="tabpanel", roving tabIndex, IME-safe ArrowLeft/ArrowRight/Home/End navigation, and Alt+ArrowLeft/Alt+ArrowRight keyboard reordering
accessibility.description: Provides full keyboard parity with pointer dragging and tab switching while guarding against IME composition commits and separating detach/close action buttons cleanly from tab buttons.

accessibility.name: Live Status Telemetry & Keyboard-Only Optical Focus Rings
accessibility.requirement: All interactive controls use :focus-visible (`prism-focus-ring`), semantic --prism-* tokens, disabled cursor/hover guards, an aria-live="polite" status bar for tear-off/merge/reorder updates, and a role="status" empty state when all tabs are closed
accessibility.description: Ensures screen-reader users receive polite confirmation when detaching, merging back, reordering, opening, or closing tabs without flashing focus outlines on pointer clicks.

props.description: Controlled ordered list of merged window tabs (`{ id, title, subtitle?, dirty?, closable? }`). Pass `[]` to display the `role="status"` empty state.

props.defaultValue: 3 default studio tabs (DesignSystem.fig dirty, TokenEngine.ts, ReleaseNotes.md)

name: MillerColumnsBrowser
description: Desktop-OS optical-glass cascading Miller columns explorer built on a sculpted `prism-slab` header with a clickable breadcrumb path trail (`packages / core / PrimaryButton.tsx`), live item counter pill, and a horizontally swipeable `prism-well` multi-column viewport. Selecting folders opens children in the adjacent right column (bounded at `MAX_DEPTH = 10` against adversarial cyclic trees), while selecting files opens a rich right-hand File Preview Pane with semantic kind icons, badges, metadata, and literal monospace or prose preview text.

bestPractices.description: Assign distinct node IDs within each folder level and provide concise `sizeLabel`, `modifiedAt`, and `previewText` fields so the File Preview Pane conveys immediate context on selection.
Use `defaultSelectedPath` to deep-link users directly to a relevant source file or directory while preserving interactive breadcrumb back-navigation and full keyboard arrow traversal.

Expect recursive column expansion past 10 levels or pass untrusted HTML expecting markup rendering; `MillerColumnsBrowser` caps column depth at `MAX_DEPTH = 10` and renders every name and `previewText` strictly as literal text.

accessibility.name: Cascading Listbox Columns & Breadcrumb Navigation Landmark

accessibility.requirement: role="region" linked via aria-labelledby, <nav aria-label="Breadcrumb path"> with aria-current="location", role="listbox" columns with role="option" and aria-selected, and role="status" empty states
accessibility.description: Exposes each Miller column as a labeled listbox with selectable options and provides semantic breadcrumb and preview landmarks for assistive technologies.

accessibility.name: Full Directional Keyboard Navigation & IME Safety
accessibility.requirement: ArrowUp/ArrowDown within column, ArrowRight into folder children, ArrowLeft back to parent column, IME-safe Enter/Space (!e.nativeEvent.isComposing), and keyboard-only .prism-focus-ring outlines
accessibility.description: Supports fluid keyboard-only directory traversal across columns with managed focus restoration while ignoring keys during active IME composition.

name: MinimizedWindowTray
description: Dedicated optical-glass dock/taskbar shelf housed inside a sculpted `prism-slab` container that holds minimized workspace windows either as live miniature optical window preview thumbnails (with miniature titlebar chrome, semantic `--prism-*` skeleton viewport, app label, title, timestamp, and close trigger) or as sleek refractive glass capsule pills (`prism-crystal rounded-full`) until restored. Includes a live minimized count badge, `Thumbnails` / `Glass Pills` display switcher (`aria-pressed`), `Restore All` action, IME-safe roving `ArrowLeft`/`ArrowRight`/`Home`/`End` + `Enter`/`Space` keyboard navigation, a `role="status"` empty state, and polite `aria-live="polite"` announcements.

bestPractices.description: Use `thumbnails` mode when users minimize visually distinct canvases, documents, or terminals and benefit from miniature optical window previews with timestamps; switch to `pills` mode for high-density taskbars and compact horizontal docks.
Pass controlled `items` together with `onRestoreWindow`, `onRestoreAll`, and `onCloseWindow` when synchronizing minimized state with a desktop tiling window manager or multi-pane studio shell.

Do not nest the per-window close button inside the restore trigger button; `MinimizedWindowTray` keeps each restore trigger and `Close <title>` button as clean sibling controls to preserve valid interactive semantics.

accessibility.name: Roving Keyboard Navigation & IME-Safe Restoration
accessibility.requirement: Horizontally scrollable `role="list"` shelf with roving `tabIndex`, wrapping `ArrowLeft`/`ArrowRight`, `Home`/`End` navigation, `Enter`/`Space` restoration guarded against `isComposing`, and `aria-pressed` display mode toggles
accessibility.description: Allows keyboard users to traverse minimized windows in both Thumbnails and Glass Pills modes with a single tab stop, restore any window with Enter or Space without hijacking IME composition commits, and dismiss individual windows via explicit `Close <title>` buttons.

accessibility.name: Polite Live Announcements & Empty Tray Status
accessibility.requirement: Keyboard-only `:focus-visible` (`prism-focus-ring`) outlines, semantic `--prism-*` color tokens, a `role="status"` empty tray placeholder when no windows remain, and an `aria-live="polite"` status bar announcing restore, close, and view switches
accessibility.description: Ensures screen-reader users receive immediate polite confirmation whenever windows are restored individually, restored all at once, closed, or toggled between Thumbnails and Glass Pills.

name: ModelParameterSwitcher

Use formatPeriodValue(period) alongside controlled value/onChange props to keep chart headers, export filenames, and URL query summaries in sync with the picker readout.
Allow unconstrained historical or future years in fiscal filters; pass tight minYear and maxYear bounds so out-of-range years are clearly disabled in decade navigation.

accessibility.description: Announces the full reporting period context (such as "Nov 2026" or "Q4 2026 (Oct–Dec)") and exposes active selection state reliably to assistive technologies.

accessibility.requirement: Native button focus order with :focus-visible rings and disabled state on out-of-bounds navigation or years
accessibility.description: Enables full keyboard navigation across granularity switches, year/decade steppers, and period grids without leaking focus outlines on pointer clicks.

name: MountedVolumesSidebar
description: Categorized optical-glass Places & Mounted Volumes navigation rail inside a prism-slab featuring four collapsible sections (Favorites, Smart Folders, Local Drives, and Network & Cloud Mounts). Displays active optical location highlighting (`aria-current="location"`), optional item count badges, sanitized token-driven semantic capacity progress bars (`< 75%` `--prism-info-main`, `75–89%` `--prism-warning-main`, `>= 90%` `--prism-error-main`), accessible `Eject <name>` buttons that safely transition volumes into unmounted recovery chips with `Mount` triggers, safe active-selection fallback on ejection, and a polite `aria-live="polite"` status footer.

bestPractices.description: Pair `activeId` and `onSelectLocation` with your file explorer viewport or breadcrumb header so clicking Favorites, Smart Folders, Local Drives, or Network & Cloud Mounts synchronizes directory state cleanly.

Hook `onEjectVolume` and `onRemountVolume` into native filesystem or virtual mount backends; when an active volume is ejected, `MountedVolumesSidebar` automatically resets focusable selection to a safe fallback location.

Pass unsanitized HTML expecting rich formatting or rely solely on bar color to communicate storage pressure; every label is rendered as literal text and each capacity bar exposes numeric GB/percentage readouts plus `role="progressbar"` metadata.

accessibility.name: Collapsible Disclosure Sections & Location Landmarks
accessibility.criterion: 1.3.1 Info and Relationships & 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value
accessibility.requirement: Uses role="region" linked via aria-labelledby, semantic <nav> and <section> landmarks, aria-expanded disclosure headers with aria-controls, aria-current="location" on the active destination, and role="progressbar" capacity meters
accessibility.description: Allows assistive technologies to navigate directly to Favorites, Smart Folders, Local Drives, or Network & Cloud Mounts while clearly announcing expanded state and current directory selection.

Keep showStepDots enabled when cycling through 3 or more modes so users can immediately see their position in the sequence.
Use MultiStateCycleButton for long lists of 6+ options; choose DropdownSelect or SegmentedControl instead.

name: MultiTrackTimeline
description: Optical-glass prism-slab multi-track timeline workspace featuring a synchronized header timecode readout, track and clip counter, 1×/2×/4× zoom controls, responsive track label rail with kind indicator dots and Mute (M)/Lock (L) toggles, scrollable clickable and keyboard-scrubbable time ruler with a full-height tangerine playhead indicator, positioned interactive optical clip pills, and a recessed aria-live="polite" inspector.

bestPractices.description: Bind currentTimeSec and onTimeChange in controlled mode when synchronizing the timeline playhead with sibling TransportControlBar, TimecodeScrubber, or media playback engines.
Categorize lanes with kind ("video" | "audio" | "effect" | "subtitle") so indicator dots and optical clip pills automatically cascade through semantic --prism-* theme tokens.
Allow edits or selection callbacks on locked tracks; set locked: true on protected lanes so clips render disabled styling and ignore selection activation.

accessibility.name: Keyboard-Scrubbable Time Ruler & IME-Safe Clip Activation
accessibility.requirement: Ruler exposes role="slider" with ArrowLeft/ArrowRight (±1s, Shift ±5s), Home/End jumps; clips render as native buttons with aria-pressed, disabled state on locked tracks, and IME-guarded Enter/Space activation
accessibility.description: Enables full non-pointer timeline scrubbing and clip inspection while protecting CJK/IME composition sessions and surfacing keyboard-only prism-focus-ring outlines.

accessibility.name: Polite Live Inspector & Empty State Status
accessibility.requirement: Recessed inspector exposes aria-live="polite" for active clip details or playhead summaries; empty tracks render a role="status" message
accessibility.description: Keeps assistive technologies informed as users select clips or scrub across sequence boundaries without interrupting ongoing narration.

name: NetworkForceGraph
description: Optical-glass deterministic force-directed network topology diagram featuring seeded circular initialization, 40 bounded Coulomb-repulsion / Hooke-spring / center-gravity relaxation iterations inside a 600×H viewport, cluster group filter pills, zoom controls (0.75x..2x), interactive direct-neighbor & incident-edge highlighting, and a recessed prism-well node inspector powered exclusively by --prism-* tokens.

bestPractices.description: Assign meaningful group names and semantic NetworkNodeTone values to separate service clusters, enabling interactive header filter pills and clear neighborhood inspection.
Provide positive finite node and edge weights when relative importance or traffic volume should scale node radii and link stroke widths; otherwise node degree automatically scales circle sizes.

Depend on non-deterministic layouts or raw hex colors; NetworkForceGraph computes a 100% deterministic relaxation from node IDs without Math.random() and reads every color from --prism-* CSS custom properties.

accessibility.name: Keyboard Node Inspection & Cluster Filtering
accessibility.requirement: Cluster filter pills expose aria-pressed, zoom controls enforce disabled boundaries, and every SVG node exposes role="button", tabIndex={0}, IME-safe Enter/Space selection, Escape clearing, and descriptive degree/group aria-labels
accessibility.description: Keyboard and screen-reader users can toggle clusters, zoom or reset the canvas, inspect any node, navigate directly to connected neighbors, and hear updates through the aria-live="polite" inspector.

accessibility.name: Non-Color Neighborhood Emphasis
accessibility.requirement: Combines --prism-* stroke/fill tokens with outer active rings, increased edge stroke widths, non-neighbor opacity dimming, bold active labels, and a textual neighbor list in the recessed inspector
accessibility.description: Ensures selected nodes, incident edges, and connected neighbors remain clearly distinguishable across color-vision profiles and light/dark Refractor optical themes.

props.name: edges
props.description: Topology links ({ id, source, target, label?, weight? }) connecting visible nodes; self-loops, duplicates, and dangling edges are automatically filtered.

name: NetworkVpnPopover
description: Live optical-glass Network & VPN selector popover housed inside a `prism-slab` surface for system trays and desktop control centers. Features responsive `flex-wrap` top radio controls for **Wi-Fi** (`role="switch"`, disabled while Airplane Mode is active) and **Airplane Mode** (`role="switch"`, immediately suspending Wi-Fi and active VPN tunnels while displaying a `--prism-warning-main` radio-suspension alert). Displays an **Available Wi-Fi Networks** list with 4-bar optical signal-strength SVG graphics tinted exclusively via `--prism-success-main` / `--prism-info-main` / `--prism-warning-main`, security lock/warning badges (`WPA3`, `WPA2`, and `--prism-warning-main` `Open`), frequency band pills (`6 GHz`, `5 GHz`, `2.4 GHz`), and accessible `Connect` / `Disconnect` buttons (`aria-pressed`), alongside a **VPN Profiles** section with mutually exclusive `role="switch"` tunnel toggles and an `aria-live="polite"` connection status summary bar.

bestPractices.description: Use `NetworkVpnPopover` inside desktop-style menu bars, control center flyouts, and edge workstation dashboards where operators switch Wi-Fi SSIDs, toggle WireGuard VPN tunnels, or suspend wireless radios in one glance.
Connect `onConnectNetwork`, `onToggleVpn`, and `onAirplaneModeChange` callbacks to your network manager or OS daemon bridge to reflect real link and tunnel transitions.

Do not rely solely on signal bar color to convey reception strength or security risk; `NetworkVpnPopover` pairs every signal graphic with an accessible `role="img"` label and explicit `WPA3`, `WPA2`, or `Open` badges.

accessibility.name: Switch & Toggle Button Semantics
accessibility.requirement: Exposes `role="switch"` with `aria-checked` on Wi-Fi, Airplane Mode, and VPN profile toggles, `aria-pressed` on per-network Connect/Disconnect buttons, and `role="img"` signal-bar descriptions
accessibility.description: Ensures screen readers announce live radio, tunnel, and network connection states clearly and supports IME-safe keyboard activation via Enter and Space.

accessibility.name: Keyboard-Only Focus Rings, Warning Alerts & Live Status Summary
accessibility.requirement: Applies `.prism-focus-ring` (`:focus-visible`) across every interactive control, renders a semantic `role="alert"` notice when Airplane Mode suspends wireless radios, and maintains an `aria-live="polite"` status summary bar
accessibility.description: Keeps focus feedback crisp for keyboard navigation without pointer click rings while promptly announcing network, VPN, and radio transitions.

Set an explicit precision when formatting fixed-decimal quantities (such as currency ratios or temperatures) or omit precision to infer decimal places automatically from step.

Set decorative={true} when the hairline is purely visual spacing inside a layout that already exposes headings or landmarks, keeping assistive technology trees uncluttered.
Use orientation="vertical" inside flex toolbars, stat strips, or action bars so the divider stretches cleanly via self-stretch and min-h-[2rem].

Inject raw hex/rgb border colors via inline styles; override --prism-divider, --prism-primary-main, or --prism-secondary-main through xstyle or PrismThemeProvider so all five optical themes stay cohesive.

Leverage the built-in optical presets (Frosted Quartz, Diamond Prism, Smoked Obsidian, Amber Lens) or keyboard shortcuts (1–4, R) to give designers rapid starting points before fine-tuning IOR and dispersion.

Expect raw out-of-range or non-finite uniform values (NaN, Infinity, IOR < 1.0 or > 2.5) to propagate directly to downstream shaders; OpticalMaterialInspector sanitizes and clamps every parameter automatically.

accessibility.description: Supports full keyboard navigation across sliders, presets, surface tints, and Reset, plus IME-safe numeric preset (1–4) and reset (R) shortcuts that never hijack modifier combinations.

accessibility.description: Keeps assistive technologies informed of live parameter changes without visual pointer-focus clutter on optical-glass pills and slider thumbs.

name: OrderBookDepthChart
description: Optical-glass order book market depth visualizer built on a sculpted prism-slab card with instrument symbol badge, live Mid-Price and Spread pills, a responsive 460x200 cumulative bid/ask stepped-area SVG inside a recessed prism-well shaded purely with --prism-success-main and --prism-error-main tokens, interactive clickable and keyboard-navigable depth level markers, a 2-column Bid/Ask depth and Imbalance % summary strip, an aria-live="polite" level inspector, and a clean role="status" empty state.

bestPractices.description: Pass raw L2 order book snapshots directly via bids and asks; OrderBookDepthChart automatically sanitizes invalid entries, aggregates duplicate price levels, sorts bids descending and asks ascending from mid-price, and computes exact cumulative liquidity walls.
Bind onSelectLevel to prefill limit-order tickets or inspect exact slippage impact when traders click or step across depth markers with ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, Home, End, Enter, or Space.
Supply hardcoded hex/RGB fill colors or manually pre-sort cumulative arrays expecting mutated props; styling cascades exclusively from --prism-success-main, --prism-error-main, and surface tokens.

accessibility.name: Interactive Depth Level Markers & Left-to-Right Keyboard Navigation
accessibility.requirement: Every bid and ask depth marker exposes role="button", tabIndex={0}, aria-pressed, and a descriptive aria-label naming side, price, level size, and cumulative wall, supporting IME-safe Enter/Space activation and ArrowLeft/ArrowRight/Home/End traversal.
accessibility.description: Allows keyboard-only users to inspect buy and sell liquidity walls smoothly across the mid-price axis with keyboard-only prism-focus-ring indicators.

accessibility.name: Polite Level Inspector & Empty State Status Landmark
accessibility.requirement: Pairs a role="img" SVG depth chart and color-coded legend with an aria-live="polite" inspector announcing Side, Price, Level Size, and Cumulative Wall, plus a role="status" empty state when both bids and asks are empty.
accessibility.description: Ensures screen-reader and color-vision-deficient users receive full quantitative depth metrics without relying solely on green/red fills.

props.name: asks
props.description: Sell order levels ({ price, size }). Automatically sorted ascending from mid-price with cumulative ask walls computed.

props.description: Trading pair or instrument symbol displayed in the optical header badge.

props.description: Currency prefix prepended to formatted prices, mid-price, and spread values.

name: OtpCodeInput
description: Segmented optical-glass verification code input featuring recessed prism-well cells, controlled and uncontrolled state management, automatic focus progression, clipboard paste distribution with invalid-character stripping, Backspace rewind, arrow-key navigation, optional character masking, and accessible error alerts.

bestPractices.description: Use the default numeric 6-cell configuration for standard TOTP authenticator apps and SMS verification codes so mobile keyboards automatically present numeric keypads and one-time-code autofill.
Wire onComplete to validate or submit the verification code once all cells are populated, while keeping error feedback specific and actionable.
Enable masked={true} on SMS or authenticator OTP codes unless shoulder-surfing risk explicitly requires concealed entry, as visible digits reduce entry mistakes.

accessibility.criterion: 1.3.1 Info and Relationships & 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value
accessibility.requirement: role="group" with aria-labelledby and explicit per-cell aria-label readouts
accessibility.description: Groups all optical input wells under an accessible label and labels every cell individually as "Digit X of Y" (or "Character X of Y" when alphanumeric is enabled).

accessibility.name: Keyboard Navigation, IME Safety & Error Alerts
accessibility.requirement: ArrowLeft/ArrowRight/Backspace/Home/End navigation, isComposing guard, role="alert" errors
accessibility.description: Supports full keyboard traversal and deletion without trapping focus, guards keydown events during IME composition, and associates role="alert" validation errors via aria-describedby and aria-invalid.

name: Pagination

bestPractices.description: Use Pagination when datasets are divided into discrete indexed pages.
Disable previous/next buttons cleanly at the first and last pages.
Render hundreds of unbounded page buttons without summarizing ranges.

accessibility.description: Each page button has an explicit aria-label and sets aria-current="page" on the active page.

name: ParallelComparisonView
description: Optical-glass side-by-side candidate evaluator for parallel model or multi-agent runs, pairing a prism-slab header (title, candidate count, active winner pill, and resilient Copy Winner button with 1600ms emerald confirmation) with responsive prism-crystal candidate cards, tabular telemetry badges, literal prism-well output panels, and controlled or uncontrolled winner selection.

bestPractices.description: Provide stable candidate ids alongside finite latencyMs, tokens, and 0..100 score telemetry so operators can weigh quality against speed and token cost.
Use winnerId with onSelectWinner when synchronizing the chosen candidate to upstream workflow state, or defaultWinnerId for lightweight local evaluation.
Pre-escape HTML inside candidate output strings; ParallelComparisonView renders every candidate response strictly as literal text with whitespace-pre-wrap.

accessibility.name: Toggleable Winner Selection Semantics
accessibility.requirement: Native button controls with aria-pressed state and keyboard-only prism-focus-ring
accessibility.description: Communicates selected vs unselected candidate status via explicit aria-pressed attributes and clear Selected Winner / Select Winner copy rather than ring highlight color alone.

accessibility.name: Polite Winner & Clipboard Announcements
accessibility.requirement: role="status" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true" live region with disabled Copy Winner guard
accessibility.description: Announces both winner selection changes and clipboard copy confirmation politely while disabling Copy Winner until a valid candidate is selected.

props.description: Initial selected winner candidate id in uncontrolled mode (defaults to empty string).

props.description: Callback invoked with the chosen ComparisonCandidate when Select Winner is activated.

props.name: onCopyWinner
props.description: Callback invoked with the active winning ComparisonCandidate when Copy Winner is activated.

props.name: title
props.description: Header heading displayed in the optical comparison slab.

props.name: xstyle

name: ParallelCoordinatesPlot
description: Optical-glass high-dimensional parallel coordinates plot inside a sculpted prism-slab container with record/axis count badges, interactive group filter pills (All + unique groups), a responsive 480×230 multi-axis SVG inside a recessed prism-well featuring normalized vertical axis rails with top/midpoint/bottom ticks, interactive polylines shaded strictly via --prism-* tokens with active elevation (strokeWidth=3) and vertex dots, and a recessed aria-live="polite" dimension badge inspector.

bestPractices.description: Align each ParallelRecord.values array strictly by positional index to the axes array to guarantee prototype-safe multivariate rendering and clear cross-dimension comparisons.
Assign concise axis labels, explicit units (such as "%", "ms", "GB", "$/1M"), and record group names to activate interactive group filter pills and self-explanatory inspector badges.

Pass raw hex/rgb color values or pre-normalize metrics manually; ParallelCoordinatesPlot infers or respects explicit per-axis min/max bounds, handles constant/inverted domains safely, and maps every trajectory tone strictly to --prism-* semantic tokens.

accessibility.name: Focusable Trajectory Paths & Keyboard Traversal
accessibility.requirement: Every trajectory exposes role="button", tabIndex={0}, aria-pressed, and a complete dimension summary aria-label with IME-safe Enter/Space selection, ArrowUp/ArrowDown trajectory stepping, Escape clear, and keyboard-only prism-focus-ring outlines
accessibility.description: Keyboard and screen-reader users can step smoothly across visible model trajectories, elevating the active polyline with vertex dots while dimming sibling paths cleanly.

accessibility.name: Interactive Group Filtering & Live Dimension Inspector
accessibility.requirement: Group filter pills expose aria-pressed alongside an aria-live="polite" recessed prism-well inspector rendering the active Record Name and exact Axis: Value Unit badges across every dimension
accessibility.description: Communicates high-dimensional telemetry quantitatively without relying solely on polyline color or visual height estimation, and falls back gracefully to a role="status" empty notice when fewer than 2 axes or 0 valid records are supplied.

props.name: axes
props.defaultValue: 5 default ML benchmark axes (Accuracy %, Latency ms, VRAM GB, Throughput, Cost $/1M)
props.description: Vertical dimension axis specs ({ id, label, unit?, min?, max? }). Requires at least 2 axes; passing fewer renders a clean role="status" empty state.

props.name: records
props.defaultValue: 7 default ML benchmark models across Frontier, Balanced, and Edge groups
props.description: Multivariate records ({ id, label, group?, tone?, values }) whose values align by index to axes. Passing [] or non-finite-only records renders a role="status" empty state.

props.name: title
props.description: Heading rendered in the sculpted prism-slab header and linked via aria-labelledby.

props.name: onSelectRecord
props.description: Callback invoked with the original ParallelRecord when a trajectory is clicked, activated with Enter/Space, or stepped onto via ArrowUp/ArrowDown.

props.name: xstyle
props.description: Typed --prism-* CSS custom property and inline optical style overrides.

name: ParametricEqGraph
description: Optical-glass multi-band parametric equalizer inside a sculpted prism-slab card featuring quick-select numbered band pills, Flatten EQ reset, a responsive 420x190 logarithmic frequency-response SVG (20 Hz to 20 kHz, -18 dB to +18 dB) with summed multi-band Gaussian/shelf curve, translucent --prism-primary-main optical fill, numbered draggable and keyboard-nudgeable band nodes, a recessed Selected Band Inspector with Enable/Bypass, filter type selector, Frequency/Gain/Q sliders, and a clean role="status" empty state.

bestPractices.description: Bind controlled bands and onChange to Web Audio API BiquadFilterNode chains (lowshelf, peaking, highshelf) to synchronize visual frequency response sculpting with live audio processing.
Use Shift + Arrow keys on any focused band node for fine 0.5 dB gain nudging and semitone-scale logarithmic frequency adjustments during mastering precision passes.
Pass unclamped frequency, gain, or Q values directly to DSP nodes without validation; ParametricEqGraph safely clamps frequencyHz to [20..20000], gainDb to [-18..18], and q to [0.3..10].

accessibility.name: Keyboard Band Node Sliders & Fine Resolution Stepping
accessibility.requirement: Each EQ band node exposes role="slider" with aria-label="EQ Band N frequency and gain", aria-valuemin=-18, aria-valuemax=18, aria-valuenow, and rich aria-valuetext; ArrowLeft/ArrowRight shift logarithmic frequency, ArrowUp/ArrowDown adjust gain by +/-1 dB (+/-0.5 dB with Shift), and Home flattens the band to 0 dB.
accessibility.description: Delivers complete keyboard-only authoring of parametric EQ curves alongside pointer drag interaction.

accessibility.name: IME-Safe Keydown, Bypass Semantics & Global Pointer Cleanup
accessibility.criterion: 2.4.7 Focus Visible, 2.5.1 Pointer Gestures & 4.1.3 Status Messages
accessibility.requirement: Guards node keydown handlers with !e.nativeEvent.isComposing, applies keyboard-only .prism-focus-ring outlines, exposes aria-pressed on band pills, bypass toggles, and filter selectors, renders role="status" when empty, and removes window pointer listeners on pointerup, pointercancel, disable, and unmount.
accessibility.description: Prevents IME interception, maintains clear screen reader semantics, and guarantees zero leaked global event listeners.

name: PasswordStrengthMeter
description: Optical-glass password policy evaluation slab that performs a single linear O(n) character-code scan (zero regex backtracking) across five security criteria, renders a four-segment semantic progress bar with a polite live strength badge, and displays an optional recessed requirement checklist.

bestPractices.description: Keep minLength at 12 or higher for primary account credentials and pair PasswordStrengthMeter directly below a TextInput type="password" field.
Keep showChecklist={true} during account signup and password rotation so users immediately see which specific criteria remain unmet.
Block paste into password fields or impose low maximum lengths; PasswordStrengthMeter evaluates arbitrarily long passphrases in O(n) time without ReDoS risk.

accessibility.name: Progressbar Semantics & Live Announcements
accessibility.requirement: role="progressbar" with aria-valuemin/max/now/valuetext and aria-live="polite" strength badge
accessibility.description: Exposes the numeric 0–4 score through role="progressbar" bound to the visible heading and announces strength level transitions politely via aria-live="polite".

accessibility.name: Non-Color Requirement Indicators
accessibility.requirement: Distinct CheckCircle2/Circle icons paired with screen-reader Met/Unmet text
accessibility.description: Never relies on color alone; each checklist rule pairs a distinct icon with screen-reader status prefixes and data-passed attributes.

name: PaymentCardInput
description: Optical-glass payment card input slab with live Visa, Mastercard, Amex, and Discover brand detection, automatic 4-6-5 and 4-4-4-4 card number formatting, standard Luhn checksum validation with an emerald Valid badge and alert error hint, MM/YY expiry formatting with 01..12 month clamping, brand-aware 3/4-digit monospace CVC, optional cardholder name field, and gated submission.

bestPractices.description: Pass an onSubmit callback to render the gated refractive primary CTA that unlocks only once all fields are complete, the Luhn check passes, and the input is enabled.
Pair PaymentCardInput with your PCI-compliant tokenization flow on submit and avoid persisting raw card numbers or CVC values in browser storage or application logs.
Bypass server-side payment gateway validation solely because isValidLuhn is true; Luhn verification catches typographical errors client-side and complements processor checks.

accessibility.criterion: 1.3.1 Info and Relationships & 1.3.5 Identify Input Purpose
accessibility.requirement: Explicit htmlFor label linkage and standard cc-number, cc-exp, cc-csc, cc-name autocomplete attributes
accessibility.description: Every recessed prism-well input pairs a visible label via unique useId() identifiers with standard payment autocomplete tokens and numeric inputMode hints.

accessibility.name: Live Validation Status, Error Alerts & IME Safety
accessibility.requirement: aria-invalid, aria-describedby role="alert" Luhn error, polite Valid status badge, and isComposing Enter guard
accessibility.description: Announces valid checksum completion via a polite status badge, associates failed Luhn checksum errors with role="alert" and aria-invalid, displays keyboard-only prism-focus-ring outlines, and ignores Enter while IME composition is active.

name: PerAppAudioMixer
description: Optical-glass system sound mixer popover built inside a prism-slab shell featuring recessed prism-well output and input device selectors, a master volume bus with mute toggle, tabular effective readout, and 3-band segmented token-tinted level bar (<=70% --prism-success-main, 71–88% --prism-warning-main, >88% --prism-error-main), plus per-application channel strips that compute live effective output percentages with master mute propagation and Reset Mix recovery.

bestPractices.description: Bind controlled value and onChange to your desktop shell or OS audio daemon bridge so external hardware volume keys and tray popover adjustments remain synchronized.
Assign distinct semantic tones (primary, info, emerald, amber) across running application channels so users can quickly identify creative DAWs, browsers, voice comms, and system sounds at a glance.
Pass raw hex or rgb colors or non-normalized floating-point gains without clamping; rely on PerAppAudioMixer semantic --prism-* tokens and 0..100 volume sanitization.

accessibility.requirement: Exposes native <select aria-label="Audio output device"> and <select aria-label="Audio input device">, aria-pressed toggles on Mute master and Mute <appName> buttons, native <input type="range"> sliders with aria-valuetext, and role="meter" on the segmented master level bar
accessibility.description: Ensures complete keyboard operability with IME-safe M-key mute shortcuts, keyboard-only prism-focus-ring outlines, and unambiguous state announcements across screen readers.

accessibility.name: Empty Stream Fallback & Polite Live Announcements
accessibility.requirement: Renders a role="status" empty-channel fallback when channels is empty and publishes concise aria-live="polite" announcements for routing, volume, mute, and Reset Mix changes
accessibility.description: Keeps assistive technology users informed of effective output percentages and routing changes without stealing focus.

name: PermissionsSharingMatrix
description: Optical-glass POSIX permissions and cloud link-sharing control panel rendered inside a `prism-slab` surface. Features a live monospace octal and symbolic readout (`0754 · rwxr-xr--`), quick POSIX presets (`0644 Standard`, `0755 Executable`, `0600 Private`), editable `Owner` and `Group` inputs inside recessed `prism-well` bezels, a responsive 3×3 POSIX bit matrix (`Owner`, `Group`, `Public` × `Read (4)`, `Write (2)`, `Execute (1)`) with per-row octal digits inside `<div className="overflow-x-auto"><table>`, and a Cloud Link Sharing bar with semantic `--prism-*` access badges, conditional expiration controls, `sanitizeUrl`-guarded share URLs, and resilient clipboard copying with polite live announcements.

bestPractices.description: Use `onChange={(state, octal, symbolic) => ...}` to persist both POSIX mode changes (`0754`, `rwxr-xr--`) and cloud link sharing policies atomically.
Use the built-in quick presets (`0644 Standard`, `0755 Executable`, `0600 Private`) for common filesystem baselines before fine-tuning individual scope bits.
Pass unvalidated protocol URLs (`javascript:`, `vbscript:`, `data:`) expecting them to become copyable; `sanitizeUrl` blocks unsafe protocols and disables link copying automatically.

accessibility.name: Semantic Matrix Table & Accessible Checkbox Controls
accessibility.criterion: 1.3.1 Info and Relationships & 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value
accessibility.requirement: Matrix uses `<table>` with `<thead>` and `<tbody>` wrapped directly in `<div className="overflow-x-auto">`, scope headers (`scope="col"` / `scope="row"`), 9 `role="checkbox"` controls with explicit `aria-checked` and `<Scope> <Bit>` names, and keyboard-only `.prism-focus-ring` focus rings
accessibility.description: Allows screen reader and keyboard users to inspect and toggle every POSIX scope and bit reliably across desktop and mobile viewports.

accessibility.name: IME-Safe Ownership Inputs & Polite Status Announcements
accessibility.requirement: Owner (`aria-label="Resource owner"`) and Group (`aria-label="Resource group"`) inputs guard Enter keydowns with `!event.nativeEvent.isComposing`, while an `aria-live="polite"` region announces preset applications, bit toggles, sharing changes, and clipboard copy results
accessibility.description: Prevents CJK IME composition interruptions and delivers non-intrusive feedback for permission mutations and clipboard fallbacks.

name: PlayheadScrubRuler
description: Optical-glass prism-slab timeline scrub ruler with a live MM:SS:FF timecode readout pill, frame-snap badge, total duration display, evenly calibrated major/minor SVG graduation ticks with monospace timestamps, a sculpted --prism-primary-main playhead cap and full-height vertical hairline extending across the track lane stage, clickable semantic cue marker flags, and full pointer + IME-safe keyboard scrubbing.

bestPractices.description: Pass controlled timeSec and onTimeChange when synchronizing the playhead with TransportControlBar, audio/video playback engines, or keyframe lanes rendered inside children.
Keep snapToFrame enabled with the project fps (such as 24, 30, or 60) for frame-accurate NLE/motion-design editing, or set snapToFrame={false} for continuous sub-frame audio scrubbing.
Hardcode hex or rgb accent colors on markers or custom needles; assign semantic RulerMarker tones (primary, secondary, emerald, amber, rose) so flags inherit active --prism-* theme tokens.

accessibility.requirement: Ruler track exposes role="slider" with aria-label="Timeline playhead", aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax, aria-valuenow, and formatted MM:SS:FF aria-valuetext
accessibility.description: Supports ArrowLeft/ArrowRight/ArrowDown/ArrowUp (±1 frame when snapToFrame or ±0.1s when free), Shift+Arrow (±1s), PageUp/PageDown (±5s), and Home/End bounds while guarding IME composition, modifier chords, and disabled state.

accessibility.description: Keeps interactive marker buttons outside the role="slider" element to satisfy WAI-ARIA nested-interactive constraints while visually pinning flags directly to their timeline coordinates.

accessibility.requirement: Header timecode pill uses role="status" with aria-live="polite" and tabular-nums formatting
accessibility.description: Announces updated MM:SS:FF positions politely to assistive technologies during keyboard stepping and cue marker jumps.

name: PointClusterMap
description: Optical-glass equirectangular geospatial point cluster map (640×320 SVG projection) featuring prototype-safe spatial grid clustering that dynamically splits dense clusters into individual tone-tinted pins as you zoom (1×..4×), stylized continental landmasses and graticule grid rendered exclusively via --prism-* tokens, optional category filter pills, and a recessed prism-well aria-live inspector.

name: PullToRefresh

name: QuadrantMatrix
description: Optical-glass strategic 2×2 quadrant prioritization matrix plotting initiatives across customizable horizontal and vertical split thresholds (such as Implementation Effort vs. Strategic Impact), with four token-tinted quadrant zones, live quadrant filter pills with counts, weight-scaled interactive SVG bubbles, keyboard arrow navigation, and a recessed aria-live="polite" strategic inspector.

Use splitX and splitY (clamped to 10..90) to model asymmetric capacity thresholds or executive impact bars while pairing custom quadrantLabels that reflect your domain vocabulary.

accessibility.description: Keyboard users can filter initiatives by quadrant, tab directly to the active bubble, step across visible initiatives using ArrowLeft and ArrowRight, and activate selections without interfering with IME text composition.

accessibility.name: Token-Driven Contrast & Polite Strategic Inspector Readout
accessibility.requirement: Combines four semantic --prism-* tinted zones with corner watermark titles, dashed split axes, inline bubble labels, and a recessed prism-well aria-live="polite" inspector announcing Item, Quadrant Badge, X/Y Coordinates, and optional Summary

name: QuickLookPreviewer

accessibility.name: Accessible SVG Labeling & Non-Color Encoding

name: RadialContextMenu
description: Optical-glass radial pie context menu built on a prism-slab shell with a 280×280 interactive SVG circular action wheel that divides 360° into equal annular pie sectors shaded strictly with --prism-* semantic tokens around a central crystal hub displaying the hovered or focused action label and shortcut. Supports both pointer-blooming trigger mode (right-click, click, or Space/Enter) and persistent inline stage mode for effortless docs exploration, with full ArrowLeft/ArrowRight spin navigation skipping disabled slices, IME-safe Enter/Space activation, Escape dismissal, and an aria-live="polite" last-selected action status pill.

Use mode="inline" inside documentation playgrounds, toolbars, or inspector drawers where keeping the optical wheel immediately explorable improves discoverability, and mode="trigger" over canvas workspaces.
Rely exclusively on right-click discovery without keyboard parity; RadialContextMenu always supports Space/Enter surface activation, ArrowLeft/ArrowRight spin navigation, and Escape dismissal.

name: RichSelectionCards

Use RichSelectionCards for long lists of 10+ simple text choices; prefer DropdownSelect or RadioGroup instead.

Keep showPreview enabled for authoring flows so users can inspect rendered headings, lists, links, and embedded images in real time.
Render the emitted HTML with dangerouslySetInnerHTML without server-side validation; RichTextEditor always renders preview output as structured React elements.

name: RidgelinePlot
description: Optical-glass ridgeline (joy) distribution plot computing smooth Gaussian kernel density estimation (KDE) curves across a shared horizontal domain inside a sculpted prism-slab card with a cohort count badge, compact Tight / Balanced / Separated overlap preset toggle, stacked overlapping mountain profiles styled exclusively with --prism-* gradient tokens inside a recessed prism-well, keyboard-navigable ridge bands, and an aria-live="polite" statistical inspector.

bestPractices.description: Order cohorts chronologically or monotonically (such as months, latency buckets, or release cohorts) so horizontal distribution shifts across periods stand out immediately along the shared domain.
Use the Balanced (0.45) default overlap for 4–8 cohorts, switch to Tight (0.75) for dense multi-period timelines, or choose Separated (0) when exact tail boundaries must remain unobstructed.

Pre-strip NaN or Infinity values manually when uncertain; non-finite samples are filtered automatically, invalid empty cohorts are skipped cleanly, and passing rows={[]} renders an accessible role="status" empty state.

accessibility.name: Keyboard-Focusable Ridge Bands & IME-Safe Navigation
accessibility.requirement: Every SVG ridge cohort exposes role="button", tabIndex={0}, aria-pressed, and a complete statistical aria-label with IME-safe Enter/Space selection, ArrowUp/ArrowDown vertical traversal, and keyboard-only prism-focus-ring outlines
accessibility.description: Focusing or activating any ridge elevates its crest stroke and peak marker while gently dimming sibling cohorts and keeping every baseline legible.

accessibility.name: Overlap Preset Toggle & Live Statistical Inspector
accessibility.requirement: Overlap presets expose native <button> elements with aria-pressed inside a labeled group, paired with a role="img" SVG and an aria-live="polite" prism-well inspector reporting Cohort · Mode/Peak · Mean · Median · Samples
accessibility.description: Screen-reader and keyboard users receive complete density mode, mean, median, and sample count readouts across all light, dark, and custom Refractor themes.

props.description: Vertical overlap ratio clamped to [0, 0.75] controlling mountain stacking density (0 = Separated, 0.45 = Balanced, 0.75 = Tight).

name: RolePermissionsMatrix
description: Optical-glass role-based access control (RBAC) matrix table displaying role columns, locked-role badges, tabular grant counters, column-wide toggle controls, permission category badges, prototype-safe Map/Set grant lookups, and accessible checkbox buttons with polite live-region announcements.

bestPractices.description: Mark built-in super-admin or system roles with locked: true so administrators can audit their grants without risking accidental lockout.
Group related capabilities with concise category labels and descriptions so reviewers can scan high-impact permissions before granting column-wide access.
Rely solely on client-side disabled controls for authorization enforcement; always validate RBAC grant mutations on the server alongside onChange.

accessibility.name: Semantic Table Structure & Row/Column Headers
accessibility.requirement: Semantic <table> with <thead>, <tbody>, scope="col" role headers, and scope="row" permission headers
accessibility.description: Associates every permission checkbox cell with both its role column header and permission row header and labels the table via aria-labelledby.

accessibility.name: Accessible Checkbox Controls & Live Announcements
accessibility.requirement: role="checkbox" buttons with aria-checked, descriptive aria-label, keyboard-only focus rings, and aria-live="polite" status announcements
accessibility.description: Each matrix cell exposes role="checkbox", aria-checked, and "${role.name}: ${perm.label}" while announcing single and column-wide permission changes through a polite live region.

name: RotaryDial

Pair a concise label and clear unit suffix (such as "°", "dB", or "%") so tabular readouts remain immediately legible alongside the 270-degree sweep.
Use RotaryDial for wide numeric ranges that require typing arbitrary multi-digit numbers; prefer ScrubbableNumberField or NumericStepper instead.

accessibility.requirement: Exposes role="slider" with aria-label, aria-valuenow/min/max/valuetext, ArrowUp/Right (+step), ArrowDown/Left (-step), PageUp/PageDown (±10x step), Home (min), and End (max)
accessibility.description: Provides complete non-pointer precision control via standard slider key bindings, guards IME composition, and excludes disabled knobs from tab order.

accessibility.name: Pointer Capture & Keyboard-Only Focus Ring
accessibility.requirement: Uses prism-focus-ring (:focus-visible), pointer capture with pointerup/pointercancel cleanup, and double-click reset to defaultValue
accessibility.description: Supports smooth drag adjustments along horizontal and vertical axes without hijacking page scroll and cleanly resets pointer capture on release or cancel.

name: SankeyDiagram
description: Optical-glass multi-stage Sankey flow diagram that filters positive finite directed links via prototype-safe Maps, arranges nodes into sorted stage columns scaled proportionally to max(inflow, outflow), renders translucent cubic-bezier flow ribbons and rounded node bars using semantic --prism-* CSS tokens, and provides interactive link and node inspection inside a recessed prism-well strip.

bestPractices.description: Assign sequential integer stage numbers (0, 1, 2, ...) and semantic node tones (primary, secondary, emerald, amber, rose) so multi-hop flows trace cleanly from left to right across all Refractor themes.
Supply valueUnit (such as "k", "MW", or " users") so header throughput badges, flow ribbon aria-labels, and recessed prism-well inspector readouts stay compact and immediately scannable.

Expect zero, negative, non-finite, or self-referencing links to render; SankeyDiagram sanitizes invalid edges automatically and renders an accessible role="status" empty notice when no valid positive flow remains.

accessibility.description: Activating a ribbon highlights that path (0.85 opacity vs 0.25 dimmed siblings), fires onSelectLink, and announces "{source} → {target}: {value}{unit}" in an aria-live="polite" prism-well region; activating a node highlights all incident links and announces its inflow/outflow summary.

accessibility.description: Pairs semantic --prism-* stroke/fill tokens with legible adjacent node labels, stage guides, and exact numeric summaries in the inspector strip so flow volumes remain clear without relying on hue alone.

name: ScreenCaptureHud
description: Floating bottom optical-glass Screen Capture & Recording HUD toolbar housed inside a prism-slab shell. Pairs an IME-safe roving-tabindex Capture Target radiogroup (Full Screen, Window, Region), Screenshot / Record Video output switcher, countdown timer selector (No Delay, 3s, 5s, 10s), save destination picker (Desktop, Clipboard, Documents/Captures), recording-mode Microphone toggle, live countdown with mid-flight Cancel, pulsing --prism-error-main REC elapsed timer with Stop Recording, optional Close HUD dismiss control, and a polite aria-live status strip.

bestPractices.description: Wire onCaptureComplete to persist or preview captured screenshots and recorded video artifacts using the structured ScreenCaptureResult payload (target, output, delaySeconds, saveLocation, includeMic, durationSeconds).
Provide onDismiss when rendering ScreenCaptureHud as a floating bottom OS overlay so keyboard and pointer users can cleanly exit capture mode and cancel any active countdown or recording timer.

Expect microphone audio to be enabled during screenshot captures; ScreenCaptureHud restricts the Microphone toggle to Record Video mode and always emits includeMic: false and durationSeconds: 0 for screenshots.

accessibility.description: Allows full keyboard operation across target modes, output switching, delay/destination configuration, countdown cancellation, and recording stop without hijacking active IME composition.

accessibility.name: Polite Live Announcements & Keyboard-Only Focus Rings
accessibility.requirement: Publishes target switches, countdown ticks, cancellation, recording start/stop summaries, and saved capture telemetry in an aria-live="polite" status strip with :focus-visible .prism-focus-ring outlines
accessibility.description: Keeps assistive technology informed throughout countdowns and recordings while preventing pointer-click focus ring noise across floating HUD buttons.

name: ServiceTopologyMap
description: Optical-glass layered service dependency topology map built on a sculpted prism-slab shell with cluster health summary pills (Healthy, Degraded, Error), an Errors & Degraded Only highlight toggle, a responsive deterministic 540×280 architectural SVG inside a recessed prism-well arranging Gateway, Microservices, and Data/Async tiers left-to-right with curved directional arrows and live mid-edge latency + error-rate pills, keyboard-navigable upstream/downstream highlighting, and an aria-live="polite" telemetry inspector.

Wire onSelectNode and onSelectEdge to open distributed traces, service logs, or incident runbooks directly when operators click or keyboard-focus an unhealthy service or high-error link.

Hardcode status hex colors or rely on color alone for failure signals; ServiceTopologyMap derives all health accents from --prism-success-main, --prism-warning-main, and --prism-error-main paired with dashed degraded paths, thicker error strokes, and explicit textual status badges.

name: SessionPowerOverlay
description: Dimmed optical system power overlay housed inside a sculpted `prism-slab` surface, presenting four large tactile power action cards—Sleep (`--prism-info-main`), Restart (`--prism-warning-main`), Shut Down (`--prism-error-main`), and Log Out (`--prism-secondary-main`)—inside a WAI-ARIA `role="radiogroup"` with IME-safe arrow-key navigation. Pairs action selection with a contextual "Reopen windows when logging back in" checkbox (gracefully marked not applicable when Sleep is selected), an optional live 1-second `window.setInterval` auto-action countdown with `Start Timer`/`Stop Timer` controls and strict unmount/cancel/disable cleanup, `Confirm <Action>` and `Cancel` buttons, an `aria-live="polite"` status banner, and dual `inline` / `modal` (`role="dialog" aria-modal="true"` with backdrop & `Escape` dismissal) presentation modes.

bestPractices.description: Use `mode="modal"` paired with controlled `open`, `onConfirmAction`, and `onCancel` for full-viewport OS shutdown, restart, and log-out confirmation dialogs, and `mode="inline"` for embedded system settings or interactive previews.

Set `countdownSeconds={0}` when an immediate manual confirmation flow is desired without an auto-execution countdown timer, or configure a positive duration (e.g., `60`) with `autoStartCountdown` for unattended workstation shutdowns.
Use `SessionPowerOverlay` for generic confirmation prompts unrelated to workstation session or power transitions; use `ModalDialog` or `HoldToConfirmButton` for general destructive confirmations.

accessibility.name: WAI-ARIA Radiogroup & Modal Dialog Semantics
accessibility.criterion: 1.3.1 Info and Relationships & 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value
accessibility.requirement: Exposes the four power cards inside `role="radiogroup"` (`aria-label="Power and session actions"`) with `role="radio"` and `aria-checked`, provides an explicitly labeled checkbox (`aria-label="Reopen windows when logging back in"`), and wraps `mode="modal"` inside `role="dialog" aria-modal="true"`
accessibility.description: Ensures assistive technologies accurately convey the active power transition, window-reopen preference, and modal scope across both inline and overlay modes.

accessibility.name: IME-Safe Keyboard Navigation, Focus Visibility & Polite Announcements
accessibility.requirement: Supports IME-guarded `ArrowLeft`/`ArrowRight`/`ArrowUp`/`ArrowDown`/`Home`/`End` radio switching with roving `tabIndex`, IME-guarded `Escape` dismissal in modal mode, keyboard-only `.prism-focus-ring` (`:focus-visible`), and an `aria-live="polite"` status banner
accessibility.description: Prevents accidental dismissal or power switching during IME composition while keeping keyboard and screen-reader users informed of selection, timer, and confirmation changes.

name: ShortcutCheatSheet

accessibility.description: Ensures full keyboard control over Pause/Resume, Reset, and Escalate actions without triggering accidental activations during IME composition or displaying focus rings on pointer click.

name: SnapZoneOverlay
description: Translucent optical-glass snap-zone and desktop tiling overlay housed inside a sculpted `prism-slab` surface. Presents a wrap-safe header displaying the dragged window title (`Dragging: Optical Studio — main.tsx`), toggleable layout preset pills (`Halves`, `Thirds`, `Quarters`, `Priority Grid` with `aria-pressed`), and a `Clear Snap` action above an interactive `role="listbox"` desktop drop-zone stage. Each zone acts as a focusable, clickable, hoverable, and HTML5 drag-over/drop target (`role="option"`) with a luminous `--prism-primary-main` border and `color-mix(in srgb, var(--prism-primary-main) 18%, transparent)` fill when highlighted or snapped, complete with IME-safe keyboard navigation (`ArrowLeft`/`ArrowRight`/`ArrowUp`/`ArrowDown`/`Home`/`End`, `Enter`/`Space`, `Escape`) and a polite `aria-live="polite"` status strip.

bestPractices.description: Use `SnapZoneOverlay` for OS-grade desktop window managers, multi-pane studio shells, and split-screen layout pickers where users drag or keyboard-select proportional screen regions (`halves`, `thirds`, `quarters`, `priority-grid`).
Pair controlled `preset` / `onPresetChange` and `activeZoneId` / `onSnapZone` props when synchronizing snap zones with live floating window geometry or persistent workspace layouts.
Do not use `SnapZoneOverlay` for freeform single-pixel window edge resizing; use `WindowResizeFrame` for 8-way directional resize handles or `WindowSplitter` for continuous adjacent pane dividers.

accessibility.name: ARIA Listbox Snap-Zone Stage & IME-Safe Spatial Navigation
accessibility.requirement: Exposes the desktop tiling grid as `role="listbox" aria-label="Window snap zones"` with roving-tabindex `role="option"` targets carrying `aria-selected`, keyboard-only `.prism-focus-ring`, IME-safe `onKeyDown` (`!event.nativeEvent.isComposing`), `ArrowLeft`/`ArrowRight`/`ArrowUp`/`ArrowDown`/`Home`/`End` focus navigation, `Enter`/`Space` snapping, and `Escape` snap clearing
accessibility.description: Guarantees full parity for keyboard-only and assistive-technology users without requiring pointer drag-and-drop, while preventing IME composition commits from prematurely triggering snap actions.

accessibility.name: Preset Toggle Press State & Polite Dimension Announcements
accessibility.requirement: Applies `aria-pressed` to all 4 preset pill buttons, disables `Clear Snap` when no zone is snapped or `disabled` is true, and emits concise preset switch, snapped zone dimension, and clear announcements through an `aria-live="polite"` status strip
accessibility.description: Keeps screen-reader users informed of active layout presets and snapped zone proportions (`50% × 100%`, `70% × 100%`, etc.) without interrupting navigation.

Use the destructive crimson tone for non-destructive actions; reserve it exclusively for irreversible bulk deletions.
