name: SunburstChart
description: Zoomable optical-glass hierarchical sunburst chart rendering up to 3 concentric descendant SVG arc rings from the active focus node, with bounded recursion (max depth 6), full-360° single-child ring geometry, interactive breadcrumb pills, center zoom-out disc, and --prism-* semantic token coloring with progressively lighter ring opacity.

bestPractices.description: Assign distinct SunburstNode ids within each branch and place positive numeric values on leaf nodes so branch totals aggregate predictably across zoom levels.
Use semantic SunburstTone tokens (primary, secondary, emerald, amber, rose) on top-level branches so descendant rings automatically inherit cohesive optical families across themes.
Depend on cyclic object graphs or hierarchies deeper than 6 levels; traversal is safely capped at depth 6 and cyclic back-edges are ignored to prevent stack overflows.

accessibility.name: Keyboard-Navigable Arcs, Center Disc & Breadcrumbs
accessibility.requirement: Every SVG arc exposes role="button", tabIndex={0}, descriptive aria-label, and IME-safe Enter/Space zoom activation alongside breadcrumb buttons and a Reset Zoom control
accessibility.description: Keyboard and screen-reader users can drill into any visible ring arc, inspect values via the polite live readout, and return up the hierarchy through the center disc, breadcrumb pills, or Reset Zoom button.

accessibility.name: Accessible SVG Labeling & Empty State Status
accessibility.requirement: SVG sunburst declares role="img" reflecting active focus context and renders a polite status block when total hierarchy value is zero
accessibility.description: Maintains clear structural semantics without hardcoded color literals so contrast adapts cleanly to light, dark, and custom Refractor themes.

name: SurfaceMesh3DPlot
description: Interactive optical-glass 3D surface and wireframe mesh visualizer inside a sculpted prism-slab card. Projects any 2D elevation grid (defaulting to a smooth 9×9 damped-sinc optical ripple) through exact 3D yaw and pitch rotation matrices with painter-algorithm back-to-front depth sorting, --prism-* semantic elevation shading (--prism-info-main valleys -> --prism-secondary-main mid -> --prism-primary-main peaks), Shaded/Wireframe switching, 0.7×..1.6× zoom controls, pointer-drag and IME-safe keyboard orbit, clickable facet inspection, and a recessed aria-live="polite" telemetry footer.

bestPractices.description: Provide rectangular 2D numeric grids of at least 2×2 samples so each quad facet projects smoothly with deterministic elevation ranges and accurate cell telemetry.
Use Shaded mode to reveal macro peak/valley topography via semantic --prism-* optical depth tokens, and switch to Wireframe mode when inspecting steep occluding ridges or subtle saddle points.
Pass grids smaller than 2×2 expecting empty SVG frames — SurfaceMesh3DPlot renders a clear role="status" empty state whenever fewer than 2 rows or 2 columns are supplied.

accessibility.name: Keyboard 3D Camera Orbit & Facet Selection
accessibility.requirement: Focusable role="application" stage supports IME-safe ArrowLeft/ArrowRight (±10° yaw), ArrowUp/ArrowDown (±5° pitch), and 0 (reset view); each quad facet exposes role="button", aria-pressed, descriptive row/col/elevation aria-label, IME-safe Enter/Space selection, and keyboard-only .prism-focus-ring outlines.
accessibility.description: Ensures full 3D camera orbiting, zoom control, render-style toggling, and individual quad inspection without requiring pointer gestures.

accessibility.name: Polite 3D Camera & Elevation Telemetry
accessibility.requirement: A recessed prism-well footer with role="status" and aria-live="polite" announces Yaw, Pitch, Zoom, Z Range (min..max), and Active Cell (r, c, z).
accessibility.description: Communicates orbit angle adjustments, zoom magnification, and selected cell elevations to assistive technologies without stealing focus.

name: SwipeableActionRow
description: Optical-glass swipeable list row featuring a draggable crystal foreground card over recessed left and right semantic action trays, smooth clamped travel, threshold snapping, compact reveal toggle buttons, and full keyboard navigation.

bestPractices.description: Limit each tray to 1-3 concise actions (such as Pin, Archive, or Delete) so revealed capsules fit comfortably on narrow mobile viewports.
Use semantic tones (emerald for confirm/complete, amber for snooze/archive, rose for destructive delete) so action intent is recognizable at a glance.
Hide critical workflows solely behind touch swipes; SwipeableActionRow automatically provides compact reveal toggles and ArrowLeft/ArrowRight/Escape shortcuts for desktop and keyboard users.

accessibility.name: Keyboard & Non-Touch Parity
accessibility.requirement: ArrowRight/ArrowLeft reveal or dismiss trays, Escape closes open trays, and compact reveal toggle buttons expose aria-expanded state
accessibility.description: Guarantees every swipe action can be reached and triggered using standard keyboard controls or single-pointer clicks without requiring drag gestures.

accessibility.name: Focus Management & IME Safety
accessibility.requirement: Hidden tray buttons are removed from tab order until revealed; all interactive controls use keyboard-only prism-focus-ring and IME-safe key handlers
accessibility.description: Prevents offscreen tray actions from trapping focus while closed and ignores keyboard shortcuts during active IME composition.

name: SystemAboutCard
description: Classic OS identity card and frosted-glass modal dialog (`prism-slab` inline or frosted backdrop modal) displaying a pure geometric refractive Prism SVG emblem, OS name, codename, monospace version/build pill (`v15.4 · Build 24E218`), tabular live uptime readout (`14d 06h 22m 08s`) with optional 1000ms interval ticking, structured `<dl>` hardware specifications with default-masked sensitive fields (`••••-••••-PRSM`) and accessible `Reveal`/`Hide` toggles, an optional semantic storage capacity progress bar (`--prism-primary-main` / `--prism-warning-main` >= 75% / `--prism-error-main` >= 90%), resilient clipboard `Copy Diagnostics` with `document.execCommand("copy")` fallback, `Software Update…` status feedback, and URL-sanitized documentation/license links.

bestPractices.description: Mark hardware serial numbers, device UUIDs, or license keys with `sensitive: true` so they stay masked by default during screen shares and remain redacted in copied diagnostics until explicitly revealed.
Use `mode="modal"` paired with controlled `open` and `onClose` when launching from an application menu bar (`About This Workstation`), or keep `mode="inline"` inside a System Settings overview pane.

Do not rely on raw unvalidated URLs or non-finite telemetry; `SystemAboutCard` sanitizes every link through `sanitizeUrl(href, false)` (blocking `javascript:`, `data:`, and `vbscript:` protocols) and clamps `NaN`/`Infinity`/negative uptime and storage figures safely.

accessibility.name: Semantic Landmarks, Hardware Definition List & Storage Progressbar
accessibility.criterion: 1.3.1 Info and Relationships & 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value
accessibility.requirement: Renders `role="region"` in inline mode or a frosted `role="dialog" aria-modal="true"` overlay in modal mode linked via `aria-labelledby`, semantic `<dl>/<dt>/<dd>` hardware rows with `aria-pressed` Reveal/Hide toggles, and a `role="progressbar"` storage bar with `aria-valuemin`/`aria-valuemax`/`aria-valuenow`/`aria-valuetext`
accessibility.description: Exposes OS identity, masked/revealed serial status, and storage utilization cleanly to assistive technologies.

accessibility.name: IME-Safe Controls, Keyboard-Only Focus Rings & Polite Status Region
accessibility.requirement: Guards modal `Escape` dismissal and button keydowns against active IME composition (`isComposing`), applies keyboard-only `.prism-focus-ring`, strips unsafe URLs into inert non-clickable text, and announces copy, reveal, and update-check states inside an `aria-live="polite"` status region
accessibility.description: Preserves CJK/IME input sessions, prevents protocol XSS in footer links, and communicates transient diagnostic and software update feedback without stealing focus.

name: SystemFileDialog
description: Standardized OS Open / Save As dialog rendered as an embedded optical `prism-slab` (`mode="inline"`) or centered frosted-glass modal backdrop (`mode="modal"`). Combines a window header with an optional uncontrolled `Open` / `Save` mode switcher, a responsive navigation toolbar (`Back`, `Up`, clickable directory breadcrumbs, linear-time substring search filter, and inline validated `New Folder` creation), a two-pane places sidebar and WAI-ARIA `role="listbox"` directory browser (folders always listed first with keyboard `ArrowUp`/`ArrowDown`/`Home`/`End`/`Space`/`Enter`, double-click navigation/confirmation, and optional multi-select in `open` mode), and a footer strip featuring strict path-traversal filename validation, automatic format extension appending, file-format `<select>` filtering, `Cancel` (`Escape` in modal mode), and primary `Open` / `Save` actions.

bestPractices.description: Use `mode="modal"` paired with controlled `open`, `dialogKind`, `onConfirm`, and `onCancel` when presenting a native-style Open or Save As flow over an active application canvas, and keep the default `mode="inline"` for embedded file pickers or interactive workbenches.

Supply domain-specific `formats` (such as `JSON (.json)` or `TypeScript (.ts, .tsx)`) in `save` mode so `SystemFileDialog` filters visible files while keeping folders navigable and automatically appends the primary format extension when users omit an extension.

Do not rely solely on client-side filename validation for server-side file writes; while `SystemFileDialog` strictly blocks `/`, `\`, `..`, dots-only names, trailing dots, and null/control characters with `role="alert"` feedback, always re-validate paths on the backend.

accessibility.name: Modal Dialog, Places Navigation & Directory Listbox Semantics
accessibility.criterion: 1.3.1 Info and Relationships & 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value
accessibility.requirement: Exposes `role="dialog" aria-modal="true"` in modal mode (or `role="region"` inline) linked via `aria-labelledby`/`aria-describedby`, `<nav aria-label="Places">` and `<nav aria-label="Current directory path">` landmarks with `aria-current="location"`, and a `role="listbox"` directory browser with `aria-multiselectable`, `aria-activedescendant`, and `role="option"` rows
accessibility.description: Communicates dialog modality, current folder hierarchy, and single or multi-file selection reliably to screen readers and assistive technologies.

accessibility.name: IME-Safe Keyboard Navigation, Validation Alerts & Polite Live Status
accessibility.criterion: 2.1.1 Keyboard, 2.4.7 Focus Visible, 3.3.1 Error Identification & 4.1.3 Status Messages
accessibility.requirement: Guards listbox `ArrowUp`/`ArrowDown`/`Home`/`End`/`Space`/`Enter`, input `Enter`/`Escape`, and modal `Escape` handlers against IME composition (`isComposing`), applies keyboard-only `.prism-focus-ring`, reports invalid filenames/folder names via `role="alert"` + `aria-invalid`/`aria-describedby`, and announces directory and confirmation changes via `role="status" aria-live="polite"`
accessibility.description: Prevents accidental commits during CJK/IME composition while keeping keyboard users informed of validation errors and navigation state.

name: SystemPreferencesShell
description: Two-pane optical-glass OS configuration shell (`prism-slab`) pairing a searchable icon category sidebar (`<nav aria-label="System preference categories">`) on the left with grouped `prism-crystal` preference cards on the right. Stacks cleanly on narrow mobile viewports (`flex-col md:flex-row` with `min-w-0`) and ships with a rich 6-section default catalog (`General`, `Appearance & Glass`, `Displays`, `Sound`, `Network`, `Privacy & Security`) spanning `toggle`, `select`, `slider`, and `segmented` controls. Performs linear-time, zero-regex literal search across section headers and individual setting labels, descriptions, and groups with `splitLiteralHighlight` match highlighting, roving keyboard navigation (`ArrowUp`/`ArrowDown`/`Home`/`End`), prototype-safe `Map` value storage, clamped numeric sliders, per-section modified tracking with `Reset Section Defaults`, and a polite `aria-live="polite"` status banner.

bestPractices.description: Pass controlled `values` as a `ReadonlyMap<string, PreferenceValue>` (or entry tuples) paired with `onSettingChange` and `onResetSection` when syncing preferences with a backend profile or OS daemon.
Group related settings via `setting.group` so each category automatically partitions into scannable `prism-crystal` cards with clear visual hierarchy across desktop and mobile viewports.

Store setting overrides in plain JavaScript objects indexed by arbitrary keys; `SystemPreferencesShell` uses prototype-safe `Map` storage internally and clamps slider bounds against `NaN`/`Infinity` values automatically.

accessibility.name: Searchable Category Navigation & Roving Keyboard Focus
accessibility.criterion: 2.1.1 Keyboard, 2.4.7 Focus Visible & 1.3.1 Info and Relationships
accessibility.requirement: Renders the category sidebar as `<nav aria-label="System preference categories">` with an explicitly labeled `<input type="search" aria-label="Search settings">`, IME-safe `Escape` clearing, roving `ArrowUp`/`ArrowDown`/`Home`/`End` navigation across visible category buttons with `aria-current="page"`, and keyboard-only `.prism-focus-ring` indicators
accessibility.description: Enables rapid keyboard traversal through system preference categories without disrupting CJK/IME composition or displaying distracting focus rings on pointer clicks.

accessibility.name: Accessible Preference Controls & Polite Live Announcements
accessibility.requirement: Uses `role="switch"` + `aria-checked` for toggles, `aria-pressed` button groups for segmented selectors, labeled native `<select>` and `<input type="range">` controls linked via `htmlFor`/`aria-describedby`, and announces preference edits and section resets inside an `aria-live="polite"` status banner
accessibility.description: Communicates control semantics, descriptions, modified counts, and live update confirmations clearly to assistive technologies.

name: SystemSpotlightLauncher
description: Centered floating OS Spotlight and Run Launcher housed inside a sculpted prism-slab with a pure, zero-eval recursive-descent arithmetic and deterministic unit conversion engine (evaluateSpotlightExpression) paired with a split two-column results listbox and right-hand optical preview pane. Supports quick example query chips, linear-time case-insensitive substring matching across apps, files, and system commands, live Calculation hits with large tabular-nums output and resilient clipboard copy fallback, IME-safe ArrowDown/ArrowUp/Home/End/Enter/Escape navigation, role="status" empty states, and polite aria-live announcements.

bestPractices.description: Provide rich literal previewBody strings and concise meta label/value pills for every catalog item so users can verify files, commands, and applications in the split right-hand pane before executing.

Use the exported pure evaluateSpotlightExpression() helper whenever you need identical zero-eval arithmetic and unit conversions (px/rem, km/mi, kg/lb, C/F, GB/MB) in external search bars or telemetry previews.

Inject unescaped HTML into previewBody or pass untrusted expressions to eval()/Function(); SystemSpotlightLauncher renders previewBody strictly as literal React text and evaluates math via a bounded recursive-descent parser (max length 120, max depth 32).

accessibility.name: WAI-ARIA Combobox & Listbox Keyboard Navigation
accessibility.requirement: Combines role="combobox" (aria-expanded="true", aria-autocomplete="list", aria-controls, aria-activedescendant) with role="listbox" options, IME-safe ArrowDown/ArrowUp/Home/End/Enter/Escape handling, and keyboard-only prism-focus-ring outlines
accessibility.description: Keeps focus anchored in the Spotlight search input while moving active selection across calculation hits and catalog matches, guarding every keydown action with !e.nativeEvent.isComposing.

accessibility.name: Polite Live Announcements & Empty-State Feedback
accessibility.requirement: Provides an aria-live="polite" announcement region for calculation hits, selection changes, clipboard copies, launches, and query resets, alongside a clear role="status" empty state when zero items match
accessibility.description: Ensures screen-reader users receive immediate confirmation of evaluated math results, copied outputs, and zero-result queries without interrupting typing.

name: SystemTrayCluster
description: Compact right-aligned optical OS menu-bar status cluster inside a `prism-slab` shell with 6 live hardware and system indicators (**Wi-Fi**, **Bluetooth**, **Battery** with tabular `%`, **Volume**, **Keyboard Layout** code, and **Clock**). Each indicator acts as a tactile `role="toolbar"` button exposing `aria-haspopup="dialog"`, `aria-expanded`, `.prism-focus-ring`, semantic `--prism-*` status tinting, and IME-safe roving `ArrowLeft`/`ArrowRight`/`Home`/`End` keyboard navigation. Activating any indicator opens a dedicated viewport-clamped (`w-[min(19rem,calc(100vw-2rem))]`) `role="dialog"` popover with live switches, a `NaN`-safe clamped battery `role="progressbar"` and charging badge, mute toggle and volume range slider, `US`/`UK`/`DE`/`JP` layout switchers, or a large tabular clock with formatted date and UTC readout, plus outside `pointerdown` and IME-safe `Escape` dismissal restoring focus to the active trigger and a polite `aria-live="polite"` status strip.

bestPractices.description: Place `SystemTrayCluster` on the trailing edge of desktop-class OS bars, studio shells, and kiosk control headers to surface live hardware telemetry and quick-toggle popovers without cluttering the workspace.
Use controlled `value` / `onChange` and `openIndicator` / `onOpenIndicatorChange` when synchronizing Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, power, audio, or input-source settings with external system state.
Do not clip `SystemTrayCluster` inside an ancestor with `overflow: hidden` because the anchored `role="dialog"` popover extends beneath the right-aligned indicator bar.

accessibility.name: WAI-ARIA Toolbar Roving Navigation & Indicator Dialog Triggers
accessibility.requirement: Exposes `role="toolbar" aria-label="System tray indicators"` with roving `tabIndex`, IME-safe `ArrowLeft`/`ArrowRight`/`Home`/`End` focus movement, and `aria-haspopup="dialog"`, `aria-expanded`, and `aria-controls` on all 6 indicator triggers
accessibility.description: Lets keyboard and assistive-technology users traverse all six hardware indicators with a single Tab stop and inspect expanded popover state clearly.

accessibility.name: Interactive Popover Controls, Escape Focus Restoration & Polite Live Strip
accessibility.requirement: Provides semantic `role="switch"` toggles, clamped `role="progressbar"` battery readout, `aria-pressed` mute and keyboard layout buttons, `aria-label="System tray volume"` range input, IME-safe `Escape` dismissal restoring trigger focus, keyboard-only `.prism-focus-ring`, and an `aria-live="polite"` status strip
accessibility.description: Ensures every hardware setting is operable via keyboard without IME hijacking and announces popover transitions and setting toggles politely.

name: TagChip
description: Compact interactive filter capsule used to toggle category selections or dismiss active filters, transitioning smoothly between clear crystal and emerald active glass.

bestPractices.description: Provide onSelect for toggleable filter chips so assistive technology receives aria-pressed state.
Supply onDismiss only when the user can meaningfully remove the tag from the current view.
Use TagChip for primary page actions; use PrimaryButton or SecondaryButton instead.

name: TaskManagerDialog
description: Compact optical-glass system Task Manager and Force Quit utility inside a prism-slab container. Displays aggregate CPU % and Memory GB summary pills with NaN/negative sanitization, linear-time substring search across process name and PID with IME-safe Escape clear, an Unresponsive Only toggle, CPU/Memory/Name sorting, a horizontally scrollable optical process table with semantic --prism-* status badges and progress meters, row selection, Force Quit termination, polite aria-live announcements, and a clean role="status" empty state.

bestPractices.description: Connect controlled processes and onForceQuit to your desktop shell or OS supervisor daemon so terminated PIDs and live CPU/memory telemetry stay synchronized.
Surface unresponsive applications with status="unresponsive" so operators can immediately isolate hung tasks via Unresponsive Only and terminate them with Force Quit.

Pass raw unsanitized NaN or negative CPU/memory metrics expecting broken layout widths or NaN% pills; TaskManagerDialog clamps CPU percentages to [0..100] and negative memory values to 0 MB automatically.

accessibility.name: Semantic Process Table, Meters, and Selection Controls
accessibility.criterion: 1.3.1 Info and Relationships & 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value
accessibility.requirement: Renders a hydration-safe <table> with <thead> and <tbody> wrapped directly in <div className="overflow-x-auto">, role="meter" CPU and memory bars, aria-selected rows, and aria-pressed Select and Unresponsive Only toggles
accessibility.description: Ensures full keyboard navigation with keyboard-only prism-focus-ring focus indicators, labeled search and sort controls, and IME-safe Escape clearing inside the filter input.

accessibility.name: Empty State Status & Polite Force Quit Announcements
accessibility.requirement: Displays a role="status" empty state when all processes are terminated or zero rows match active filters, and announces selection, filter, sort, and Force Quit actions inside an aria-live="polite" region
accessibility.description: Communicates process termination and filter changes immediately to assistive technologies without stealing keyboard focus.

name: TearOffMenu
description: Optical-glass dropdown menu featuring a perforated dashed --prism-border top grip that lets power users click, press Enter/Space, or drag by at least 24px to tear the menu away from its parent menu bar and pin it as a persistent elevated prism-slab floating tool palette. Supports shared toggleable checkable state across docked and detached states, Dock Back and Close palette titlebar controls, IME-safe ArrowDown/ArrowUp/Home/End/Escape keyboard traversal skipping disabled items, strict window pointer listener cleanup, and polite aria-live status announcements.

bestPractices.description: Use TearOffMenu for frequently repeated creative or inspection actions (such as grid snapping, specular guides, alignment, and viewport reset) where power users benefit from pinning a dropdown into a persistent floating palette.
Provide a boolean checked property on toggleable tool items so users can see and preserve active guide/snap states seamlessly when tearing off or docking back.
Use TearOffMenu for single-shot navigational links or destructive confirmations; use AppMenuBar, ContextMenuDropdown, or ModalDialog instead.

accessibility.name: Dual Docked Menu & Floating Palette ARIA Semantics
accessibility.requirement: Trigger exposes aria-haspopup="menu" and aria-expanded={isOpen && !isDetached}; docked panel exposes role="menu" with role="menuitem" / role="menuitemcheckbox" and aria-checked; torn-off palette exposes role="region" with aria-label="<menuLabel> floating palette", Dock Back / Close buttons, and aria-pressed toggle controls
accessibility.description: Transitions cleanly between transient WAI-ARIA menu semantics while docked and persistent landmark region semantics while detached as a floating tool palette.

accessibility.name: IME-Safe Keyboard Navigation, Perforated Grip Parity & Polite Announcements
accessibility.requirement: Perforated Tear-Off Grip detaches on click, IME-safe Enter/Space, or >=24px drag; ArrowDown/ArrowUp/Home/End skip disabled items; Escape closes the docked dropdown and restores focus; keyboard-only .prism-focus-ring outlines; polite aria-live="polite" status updates
accessibility.description: Ensures full keyboard parity for tearing off without requiring pointer dragging, guards all keydown handlers against IME composition, and announces state transitions politely.

name: TerminalEmulator
description: Optical glass terminal emulator slab featuring a crystal window header with live line-count badge and Clear action, a recessed scrollable monospace ANSI log rendering linear-time parsed SGR spans strictly via --prism-* tokens, and an IME-safe interactive shell prompt with ArrowUp/ArrowDown history and Ctrl+L clear.

bestPractices.description: Return structured TerminalLine[] objects from onExecute when commands produce stderr diagnostics, timestamps, or ANSI-colored output.
Set readOnly={true} when streaming build logs or read-only audit output where command execution should be hidden.
Render ANSI output via dangerouslySetInnerHTML; TerminalEmulator parses SGR sequences in O(n) time into safe React spans.

accessibility.name: Polite Log Region & Output Announcements
accessibility.requirement: role="log", aria-live="polite", and aria-relevant="additions text" on the output viewport
accessibility.description: Announces appended terminal output politely to screen readers without interrupting command typing.

accessibility.name: IME-Safe Shell Input & Keyboard Navigation
accessibility.requirement: Guards Enter with !e.nativeEvent.isComposing and supports ArrowUp/ArrowDown history and Ctrl+L clear
accessibility.description: Protects CJK/IME composition sessions while providing full keyboard ergonomics and keyboard-only prism-focus-ring outlines.

bestPractices.description: Wire onCommand to execute CLI actions or route inputs to a backend runner and return synchronous output strings to append directly into the target pane.
Use layout="split" when operators need to monitor concurrent build, test, and server sessions side by side.
Exceed maxPanes without giving users a way to close idle tabs; maxPanes is clamped safely to 1..12 and disables the New Session button at capacity.

accessibility.description: Prevents IME composition commits from prematurely executing shell commands and labels every pane input and run trigger with its session title.

name: ThermostatDial
description: Radial touch-and-drag and keyboard optical-glass climate control thermostat dial inside a sculpted prism-slab card. Features a canonical Fahrenheit internal scale with zero-drift °F/°C conversion, semantic optical color states (cooling in --prism-info-main, heating in --prism-primary-main, eco in --prism-success-main, off in --prism-text-muted), a responsive 240x240 SVG 270-degree circular arc sweep (135deg to 405deg) with fine radial ticks, ambient temperature reference indicator, glowing draggable thumb handle, central prism-crystal bezel readout, fine -/+ stepper buttons, mode selector pills, °F/°C unit toggle, and an aria-live="polite" climate summary.

bestPractices.description: Store and persist climate setpoints in canonical Fahrenheit via onTargetChange so switching between °F and °C in the UI never introduces rounding drift across toggles.
Provide live ambientTempF sensor telemetry alongside targetTempF so users can immediately see whether the system is actively cooling, heating, or in standby.
Use ThermostatDial for arbitrary unipolar parameters like audio gain or percentages; prefer RotaryDial for generic knobs and reserve ThermostatDial for HVAC and thermal setpoint control.

accessibility.name: WAI-ARIA Slider Semantics & IME-Safe Keyboard Controls
accessibility.requirement: Exposes role="slider" with aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax, aria-valuenow, descriptive aria-valuetext, ArrowUp/ArrowRight (+1), ArrowDown/ArrowLeft (-1), PageUp/PageDown (±5), Home (min), and End (max)
accessibility.description: Guards keyboard adjustments against IME composition (!e.nativeEvent.isComposing) and modifier chords, disables dial focus/interaction when disabled or mode is off, and pairs the dial with labeled -/+ steppers, aria-pressed mode pills, and °F/°C unit toggles.

accessibility.criterion: 2.4.7 Focus Visible, 2.5.1 Pointer Gestures & 4.1.3 Status Messages
accessibility.requirement: Detaches window pointermove/pointerup/pointercancel listeners on pointer release, pointer cancel, mode === off, disabled, or unmount; restricts focus outlines to prism-focus-ring (:focus-visible); and announces live setpoint and ambient status in an aria-live="polite" region
accessibility.description: Prevents leaked window listeners during interrupted drags or unmounts while delivering clear, non-intrusive screen reader feedback whenever target temperature, mode, or unit changes.

Provide concise step titles paired with monospace toolName identifiers and durationMs timings so engineers can audit multi-tool latency at a glance.
Place raw unsanitized HTML inside step details; ThinkingAccordion renders all step text strictly as literal copy.

name: ThreeWayColorWheels
description: Optical-glass 3-way color grading panel built on a sculpted prism-slab shell with Lift (Shadows), Gamma (Midtones), and Gain (Highlights) circular chromaticity wheels (140x140 SVG with concentric reference rings, crosshair axes, semantic --prism-* cardinal chroma markers, active vector line, and unit-circle-clamped puck), paired -100..100 master luminance sliders, tabular X/Y/Lum readouts, live active zone summary, double-click chroma reset, and individual/global reset actions.

bestPractices.description: Use Lift (Shadows), Gamma (Midtones), and Gain (Highlights) together with onChange(grade, changedZone) to drive WebGL/LUT color pipelines or real-time preview shaders without recomputing untouched tonal ranges.

Double-click any color wheel or press Home while focused to snap chromaticity back to (0, 0) while preserving that zone master luminance, or click the card Reset button to zero both chroma and luminance.
Rely on unvalidated external vectors outside the unit circle; ThreeWayColorWheels automatically projects (x, y) onto x^2 + y^2 <= 1 and clamps luminance strictly inside [-100..100].

accessibility.requirement: Each chromaticity wheel exposes role="slider" ("Lift color balance", "Gamma color balance", "Gain color balance") supporting Arrow keys (±0.05), Shift+Arrow (±0.2), and Home center reset, paired with labeled range sliders ("Lift luminance", etc.)

Bind frame and onFrameChange in controlled mode to synchronize playhead transport across sibling waveform, timeline, and viewport panels while letting users freely toggle SMPTE or BBT views.

name: WaterfallChart
description: Financial and variance bridge optical-glass waterfall chart plotting start anchors, floating positive/negative deltas, and cumulative total columns linked by dashed horizontal connectors across positive and negative trajectories using semantic --prism-* CSS custom properties.

bestPractices.description: Anchor your bridge with kind: 'start' and conclude subtotals or final outcomes with kind: 'total' so WaterfallChart computes cumulative totals automatically without manual arithmetic drift.
Pair valuePrefix (e.g. '$') and valueSuffix (e.g. 'k' or 'M') so signed deltas (+$45k / -$18k) and running totals stay compact across axis ticks, bar annotations, and the recessed prism-well readout.
Rely on manual total overrides after prior cumulative steps; once prior steps establish a running trajectory, total bars intentionally reflect the true cumulative running total.

accessibility.name: Interactive Waterfall Bars & Live Trajectory Readout
accessibility.requirement: Keyboard-focusable SVG step bars with IME-safe Enter/Space activation and polite live readout announcing step label, signed delta, and running total
accessibility.description: Every waterfall bar declares role="button", tabIndex={0}, a full descriptive aria-label including step kind, signed delta, and running total, and keyboard-only prism-focus-ring outlines.

accessibility.name: Accessible SVG Labeling & Zero Baseline Clarity
accessibility.requirement: role="img" SVG paired with semantic legend pills, zero baseline rule, and empty status region
accessibility.description: Combines explicit color-coded legend pills, a high-contrast zero baseline rule for negative crossings, and a clean role="status" empty notice when steps is empty.

props.description: Optional unit suffix appended to formatted axis ticks, bar annotations, and selection readouts.

name: WaveformSpectrogramView
description: Optical-glass audio waveform and 6-band frequency spectrogram workstation inside a sculpted prism-slab surface. Supports Waveform, Spectrogram, and Split views, 1×/2×/4× horizontal zoom inside a scrollable prism-well, mirrored positive/negative amplitude bars with >0.82 transient peak markers, pointer-drag and keyboard range selection, destructive Silence/Cut/Reset sample editing, and a recessed aria-live="polite" telemetry footer showing duration, selection span, sample count, and peak dB.

bestPractices.description: Use defaultMode="split" in primary mastering or vocal cleanup views so engineers can inspect time-domain transients directly above frequency-domain harmonic bands.
Bind selection and onSelectionChange in controlled mode when synchronizing active range edits with external transport markers or undo stacks.

Pass raw unnormalized dB values or NaN arrays expecting exceptions — WaveformSpectrogramView clamps sample amplitudes into [0..1], clamps durationSec >= 0.5, and renders a safe empty state when all samples are removed.

accessibility.name: WAI-ARIA Roving Tablist & Accessible Range Selection Handles
accessibility.requirement: View mode buttons implement a roving tablist (ArrowLeft/ArrowRight/Home/End); Selection Start and Selection End handles expose role="slider" with ArrowLeft/ArrowRight ±2% adjustments, PageUp/PageDown ±10%, Home/End bounds, and Escape to clear selection.
accessibility.description: Enables full keyboard-only range selection, view switching, zoom toggling, and destructive editing without requiring pointer drags, paired with IME-safe handlers and keyboard-only .prism-focus-ring outlines.

accessibility.name: Polite Audio Telemetry Live Region
accessibility.requirement: A recessed prism-well footer with role="status" and aria-live="polite" reports clip duration, active selection time span, sample count, and peak dB.
accessibility.description: Continuously conveys selection spans and post-edit peak level changes to assistive technologies without stealing focus.

name: WindowAttachedSheet
description: Window-attached modal sheet sliding down directly from a specific window titlebar inside a sculpted `prism-slab` workspace. Anchors a flat-top, rounded-bottom `role="dialog" aria-modal="false"` sheet with a semantic top accent stripe (`info`, `warning`, `critical`) directly below the target window titlebar, dimming and blocking ONLY that window body (`pointer-events-none`, `aria-hidden`, disabled buttons) while keeping an optional `Reference Notes` sibling window 100% interactive. Supports controlled and uncontrolled open states, custom sheet `children`, `Confirm` and `Cancel` actions, IME-safe `Escape` dismissal, and a polite `aria-live="polite"` status strip.

bestPractices.description: Use `WindowAttachedSheet` for document-scoped confirmations (such as saving unsaved changes, export settings, or destructive sheet actions) so users can continue referencing or working in sibling workspace windows without an application-wide modal lock.
Match `tone` (`info`, `warning`, `critical`) to the severity of the decision and pair `open` with `onOpenChange` when synchronizing sheet visibility with external window close or tab-switch handlers.
Use `WindowAttachedSheet` for system-wide blocking alerts that must halt every open window simultaneously; use `ModalDialog` for full-application modality.

accessibility.name: Window-Scoped Dialog Semantics & Body Suppression
accessibility.criterion: 1.3.1 Info and Relationships & 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value
accessibility.requirement: Renders the attached sheet as `role="dialog" aria-modal="false"` linked via `aria-labelledby` and optional `aria-describedby`, while setting `aria-hidden="true"`, `pointer-events-none`, `tabIndex={-1}`, and `disabled` exclusively on the occluded target window body
accessibility.description: Ensures assistive technologies and keyboard users understand that only the owning window is blocked while sibling windows remain fully reachable and operable.

accessibility.name: IME-Safe Escape Dismissal, Keyboard-Only Focus Rings & Polite Status Strip
accessibility.requirement: Guards sheet `Escape` dismissal with `!event.nativeEvent.isComposing` and `!disabled`, applies `.prism-focus-ring` (`:focus-visible`) to all controls, restores focus between the titlebar trigger and dialog, and announces sheet open, confirm, cancel, and sibling interactions in an `aria-live="polite"` status region
accessibility.description: Protects active IME composition sessions, avoids pointer focus-ring clutter, and keeps screen-reader users informed of state transitions across both windows.

name: WindowExposeGrid
description: Zoomed-out Mission Control / Exposé spatial window grid inside an optical `prism-slab` that spreads every open desktop window across a responsive non-overlapping grid (`grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4`) with miniature chrome dots, procedural `--prism-*` glass previews, linear-time search filtering, dynamic `Set`-backed application filter pills, prototype-safe `Map`-backed `Group by App` mode, keyboard-accessible window focusing, and per-window close controls.

bestPractices.description: Use `WindowExposeGrid` for desktop-class workspaces, multi-window web IDEs, and spatial window switchers where users need to scan, filter, group by application, focus, or close open windows without visual overlap.
Provide controlled `windows` alongside `onFocusWindow` and `onCloseWindow` when window lifecycle and active focus state are coordinated with an external desktop window manager store.
Do not use `WindowExposeGrid` for splitting two adjacent live panes inside a single window frame; use `WindowSplitter` or `SplitArtifactCanvas` for side-by-side live editors.

accessibility.name: Non-Nested Interactive Controls & IME-Safe Keyboard Focus
accessibility.requirement: Each window card separates its focusable thumbnail button (`aria-pressed`, IME-safe `Enter`/`Space`) from its sibling `Close <title>` button (`aria-label`), applies keyboard-only `.prism-focus-ring`, and guards search `Escape` clearing with `!event.nativeEvent.isComposing`.
accessibility.description: Prevents invalid nested interactive buttons while ensuring full keyboard operability and IME safety across focus, close, search, and filter controls.

accessibility.name: Polite Live Announcements & Empty-State Status
accessibility.requirement: Exposes `role="region"` linked via `aria-labelledby`, `aria-pressed` states on app pills, `Group by App`, and focused window cards, a `role="status"` empty state when zero windows remain or match, and an `aria-live="polite"` status line announcing focus, close, filter, and grouping updates.
accessibility.description: Keeps screen-reader users informed of spatial grid updates without interrupting active keyboard navigation.

name: WindowLayoutPopover
description: Hover/click tiling template popover anchored to a window maximize control inside a `prism-slab` optical shell. Features a responsive `flex-wrap` window header bar showing the window title, an active layout badge when snapped, and a Maximize / Layout Presets trigger opening a viewport-clamped (`w-[min(21rem,calc(100vw-2rem))]`) `role="menu"` popover with 4 miniature interactive tiling schematics (**50 / 50 Split**, **70 / 30 Main & Stack**, **3-Column Studio**, and **2×2 Quad Grid**). Every individual pane is an accessible `role="menuitem"` button tinted with `--prism-primary-main` on hover, keyboard focus, and active selection, with polite `aria-live` status feedback, outside `pointerdown` dismissal, clean hover-leave timer teardown, and IME-safe `Escape` dismissal restoring focus to the trigger.

bestPractices.description: Use `WindowLayoutPopover` on desktop-class web application windows, floating tool panels, and multi-pane studio frames so users can snap windows into split, main-stack, 3-column, or quad zones without manual drag resizing.
Pair `selectedSelection` with `onSelectLayout` and optional controlled `open` / `onOpenChange` when coordinating window tile geometry across a workspace window manager.
Do not wrap the root `prism-slab` inside an ancestor with `overflow: hidden` that clips the anchored `role="menu"` popover below the window header.

accessibility.name: Menu Trigger & Interactive Schematic Pane Semantics
accessibility.requirement: Exposes `aria-haspopup="menu"`, `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls`, and `aria-label="Window layout presets"` on the Maximize trigger button, groups each schematic with `role="group"` inside `role="menu"`, and renders every pane as a `role="menuitem"` button labeled `"<templateLabel>: <slotLabel>"`
accessibility.description: Allows keyboard and screen-reader users to open the tiling presets menu, identify the exact template and pane slot for every miniature schematic region, and activate any zone with Enter or Space.

accessibility.name: IME-Safe Escape Focus Restoration, Keyboard-Only Focus Rings & Live Status
accessibility.requirement: Guards keyboard activation and `Escape` dismissal against IME composition (`isComposing`), restores focus to the Maximize trigger on `Escape`, applies `.prism-focus-ring` (`:focus-visible`) to all controls, and announces slot selection in an `aria-live="polite"` status region
accessibility.description: Prevents accidental dismissal during IME text entry, keeps keyboard focus predictable, and provides concise screen-reader confirmation when a tiling slot is applied.

name: WindowResizeFrame
description: Directional 8-way optical window resize frame (`n`, `s`, `e`, `w`, `ne`, `nw`, `se`, `sw`) housed inside a `prism-slab` workbench with a responsive `overflow-x-auto` bounded stage, live telemetry bar (`width × height px`, toggleable `Grid Snap (16px)` alignment, and `Reset Frame`), and a luminous translucent dashed ghost preview outline (`--prism-primary-main`) that tracks snapped target dimensions before committing on `pointerup` or cancelling cleanly on `pointercancel` / `Escape`.

bestPractices.description: Use `WindowResizeFrame` for desktop-class floating window managers, responsive viewport simulators, and spatial layout editors where users benefit from previewing snapped bounds before committing an expensive re-layout.
Configure `minWidth`, `minHeight`, `maxWidth`, `maxHeight`, and `snapGridPx` to match your application grid system; pass `snapGridPx={0}` when free single-pixel precision is required by default.
Do not use `WindowResizeFrame` for splitting adjacent side-by-side panes inside a single container; use `WindowSplitter` for multi-pane proportional dividers.

accessibility.name: IME-Safe 8-Way Keyboard Resizing & Focus Visibility
accessibility.requirement: Every edge and corner resize hitbox is a native focusable button with an explicit directional `aria-label`, keyboard-only `.prism-focus-ring`, IME-safe `onKeyDown` (`!e.nativeEvent.isComposing`), directional Arrow key stepping (default grid or 16px, `Shift` fine 4px), and `Escape` drag cancellation
accessibility.description: Ensures keyboard-only users can resize along every valid axis of an edge or corner handle without relying on pointer gestures, while preventing IME composition commits from hijacking resize keys.

accessibility.name: Polite Dimension & Snap Alignment Telemetry
accessibility.requirement: Landmark region linked via `aria-labelledby`, `aria-pressed` state on the `Grid Snap` toggle, and a polite `aria-live="polite"` status strip announcing committed dimensions, cancellations, resets, and grid snap state
accessibility.description: Keeps screen-reader users informed of live frame dimensions, snap granularity, and cancellation events without interrupting active navigation.

Use orientation="horizontal" for side-by-side workspace panes and orientation="vertical" for stacked editor/console layouts.
Pass negative or NaN percentage bounds without expecting automatic clamping to safe 0-100 proportions.

name: WindowSwitcherOverlay
description: Centered Alt+Tab / Cmd+Tab floating optical window switcher strip housed inside a sculpted `prism-slab` surface. Renders a horizontally scrollable `role="listbox"` (`aria-label="Active windows"`) of miniature optical window preview thumbnails—complete with miniature traffic-light dots, tone-tinted `--prism-*` headers, skeleton viewport lines, app name, window title, workspace pill, and quick `Close <title>` button. Supports both `inline` and modal `overlay` presentation (`role="dialog" aria-modal="true"` with frosted backdrop click and `Escape` dismissal), full IME-safe keyboard cycling (`ArrowRight`/`Tab`, `ArrowLeft`/`Shift+Tab`, `Home`/`End`, `Enter`/`Space`, `Delete`/`Backspace`, `Escape`), a responsive `flex-wrap` footer telemetry bar with `Previous`/`Next`/`Focus Window` tactile controls and `aria-live="polite"` status text, plus a clean `role="status"` empty state.

bestPractices.description: Use `mode="overlay"` paired with controlled `open` and `onDismiss` for full-viewport desktop Alt+Tab / Cmd+Tab task switching, and `mode="inline"` for embedded workspace strips, interactive docs demos, or split-screen control centers.
Provide distinct `tone` values (`primary`, `info`, `emerald`, `amber`, `rose`) and `workspaceLabel` metadata per window item so users can recognize virtual desktops and app categories at a glance.
Use `WindowSwitcherOverlay` for static document navigation tabs inside a single window titlebar; use `MergedWindowTabBar` or `PrismTabs` for persistent in-window tabs.

accessibility.name: WAI-ARIA Horizontal Listbox & Modal Dialog Semantics

accessibility.description: Ensures screen readers announce the active window preview, total window count, and modal overlay scope accurately across both inline and floating overlay modes.

accessibility.name: IME-Safe Alt+Tab Keyboard Cycling & Polite Telemetry
accessibility.requirement: Guards all keyboard shortcuts (`ArrowRight`/`Tab`, `ArrowLeft`/`Shift+Tab`, `Home`/`End`, `Enter`/`Space`, `Delete`/`Backspace`, `Escape`) with `!event.nativeEvent.isComposing` and `!disabled`, applies keyboard-only `.prism-focus-ring` (`:focus-visible`), and broadcasts highlight, focus, close, and dismiss updates through an `aria-live="polite"` status readout
accessibility.description: Prevents active IME compositions from triggering window switches or closures while keeping pointer and keyboard users synchronized with polite status feedback.

Supports macOS left-aligned semantic traffic lights (`--prism-error-main`, `--prism-warning-main`, `--prism-success-main`) and Windows right-aligned Minimize, Maximize/Restore, and Close icon controls, unsaved document indicator dot, double-click Maximize/Restore toggling, pointer-drag delta telemetry (`onDragMove`, `data-dragging`) with automatic window listener cleanup, active/unfocused specular sheen dimming, collapsible window body on minimize, trailing toolbar slot, and polite screen-reader state announcements.

bestPractices.description: Use `WindowTitlebar` for desktop-class workspace surfaces, floating IDE panes, terminal shells, and interactive preview windows that benefit from native OS windowing affordances.
Match `chromeStyle` (`macos` or `windows`) to the target desktop metaphor and wire `onDragMove` to translate floating window containers cleanly via incremental `(dx, dy)` pixel deltas.
Do not nest blocking confirmation alerts inside a minimized `WindowTitlebar`; use `ModalDialog` for modal confirmations that require an immediate decision.

name: WindowUtilityControls
description: Compact optical-glass titlebar utility cluster inside a `prism-slab` shell providing Always-on-Top Pin toggling (`--prism-primary-main` elevation ring & status pill), Window Shade roll-up (`--prism-info-main` status pill collapsing the sample body to a floating titlebar), live Background Opacity translucency slider (`[30..100]`, step `2`), quick presets (`50%`, `75%`, `100%`), Reset action, and polite `aria-live` status announcements.

bestPractices.description: Use `WindowUtilityControls` on floating inspector panes, shader monitors, HUDs, and companion desktop tools where users need Always-on-Top pinning, instant window-shade roll-up, or live translucency blending.
Pass controlled `value` and `onChange` when syncing pin z-layer elevation, shaded height collapse, and window surface opacity with a multi-window desktop shell manager.
Do not rely on `opacityPct` below `30%` for critical readable controls; `WindowUtilityControls` sanitizes `NaN`, `Infinity`, and out-of-range inputs cleanly into `[30..100]` to preserve legibility.

accessibility.name: Toggle Press State, Shade Expansion & Range Slider Semantics
accessibility.requirement: Exposes `aria-pressed` on Pin, Shade, and Opacity preset buttons, `aria-expanded` / `aria-controls` on the Window Shade roll-up toggle, and a labeled `<input type="range" min={30} max={100} step={2}>` with `aria-valuetext`
accessibility.description: Allows keyboard and assistive technology users to inspect and adjust Always-on-Top, Window Shade collapse, opacity translucency, and Reset controls with IME-safe key handling.

accessibility.name: Polite Live Status Updates & Keyboard-Only Focus Rings
accessibility.requirement: Announces pin, shade, opacity, and reset changes in an `aria-live="polite"` status region and uses `:focus-visible` (`prism-focus-ring`) for keyboard focus indication
accessibility.description: Ensures screen-reader users receive concise, non-intrusive feedback on every titlebar utility change while avoiding pointer focus clutter.

props.name: title
props.description: Window title displayed inside the optical titlebar and linked to the region landmark via `aria-labelledby`.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled utility state `{ pinned, shaded, opacityPct }`. Out-of-bounds or non-finite `opacityPct` values are sanitized into `[30..100]`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial uncontrolled utility state overrides (`pinned`, `shaded`, `opacityPct`).

props.name: showSampleBody
props.description: Displays the translucent sample window body below the titlebar whenever `shaded` is `false`.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Callback invoked whenever Pin, Window Shade, Opacity slider/presets, or Reset updates the utility state.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables Pin, Shade, Opacity range slider, quick presets, and Reset button.

props.name: xstyle
props.description: Typed `--prism-*` CSS custom property and optical style overrides.

name: WipeCompareOverlay
description: Optical-glass color grading wipe comparison surface inside a prism-slab card with Vertical and Horizontal split-wipe orientations, a 50 / 50 quick center action, a signature press-and-hold "Hold to Compare Original" bypass button with a live BYPASSED · ORIGINAL indicator, a draggable and keyboard-accessible crystal wipe puck, rich token-driven Log-C vs. Prism LUT default frames, and a recessed aria-live="polite" telemetry status bar.

bestPractices.description: Use WipeCompareOverlay in photo editors, color grading suites, and LUT preview studios where colorists need both split-screen wipe inspection and momentary full-frame original bypass.
Bind positionPct, orientation, and onHoldCompareChange when coordinating external scopes (waveform, vectorscope, histogram) with live wipe or bypass states.
Mutate the saved wipe split position when Hold to Compare Original is active; WipeCompareOverlay preserves the split percentage and snaps back automatically upon release.

accessibility.name: Dual-Axis WAI-ARIA Wipe Slider & Stepped Keyboard Navigation
accessibility.requirement: Exposes role="slider" ("Compare split wipe position") with aria-orientation, aria-valuemin=0, aria-valuemax=100, aria-valuenow, ArrowLeft/ArrowRight (vertical mode) or ArrowUp/ArrowDown (horizontal mode) at ±2% (Shift ±10%), and Home/End shortcuts
accessibility.description: Provides full keyboard precision across both wipe orientations while guarding against active IME composition and disabling tab focus when disabled.

accessibility.name: Press-and-Hold Safety Bypass & Polite Live Telemetry
accessibility.requirement: Hold to Compare Original supports pointer down plus Space/Enter hold with cleanup on pointerup, pointercancel, blur, disable, and unmount; status bar announces live split percentage or "Holding Original Bypass" via aria-live="polite"
accessibility.description: Ensures assistive technologies receive real-time feedback during wipe adjustments and bypass comparisons without leaked window listeners or sticky bypass states.

props.description: Controlled wipe split percentage clamped to [0..100].

props.name: defaultPositionPct
props.description: Initial wipe split percentage in [0..100] for uncontrolled usage.

props.name: onPositionChange
props.description: Callback invoked with the normalized split percentage whenever dragged, stepped via keyboard, or centered.

props.description: Controlled wipe axis orientation.

props.name: afterContent
props.description: Custom React node rendered in the full-bleed graded layer (renders a rich Prism LUT optical frame if omitted).

props.description: Callback invoked with true when Hold to Compare Original engages and false upon release or cleanup.

props.description: Disables wipe dragging, keyboard adjustments, orientation toggle, 50 / 50 reset, and hold-to-compare bypass.

name: WorkspaceStatusBar
description: Slim bottom-edge optical-glass IDE telemetry strip built on a prism-slab shell with tactile clickable segments for Git branch, --prism-* token-colored sync state, error/warning diagnostics, optional background task progressbar, cursor line/column coordinates, file encoding, language mode, and extensible left/right custom segments.

bestPractices.description: Wire onSelectSegment to open contextual pickers or panels (for example branch switcher for "branch", Problems drawer for "diagnostics", Go to Line for "cursor", or encoding/language selectors).
Use backgroundTaskLabel together with backgroundTaskProgressPct (0..100) for long-running indexers, typecheckers, or builds so users see live inline progress without modal interruption.
Overload extraItems with verbose prose or raw color strings; keep custom telemetry segments concise and select semantic StatusBarTone values so every theme cascades cleanly.

accessibility.name: Status Landmark & Keyboard-Accessible Segments
accessibility.requirement: Root role="status" with aria-label; interactive segments rendered as native <button type="button"> elements with keyboard-only prism-focus-ring and descriptive aria-labels
accessibility.description: Screen readers announce workspace telemetry updates politely while keyboard users can tab across and activate branch, sync, diagnostics, task, cursor, encoding, language, and custom interactive controls.

accessibility.name: Inline Background Progressbar Semantics
accessibility.criterion: 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value & 1.4.1 Use of Color
accessibility.requirement: Compact progressbar exposes role="progressbar", aria-valuemin={0}, aria-valuemax={100}, aria-valuenow, aria-valuetext, and visible percentage text alongside semantic --prism-* shading
accessibility.description: Ensures background indexing or compilation progress is conveyed numerically and programmatically rather than solely via visual bar width or color.

name: PrismaticCursorHalo
description: Cursor-tracking radial spotlight surface that softly illuminates underlying glass borders, bevels, and content as the pointer moves across the workspace. Updates `--prism-halo-x`/`--prism-halo-y` via a requestAnimationFrame-coalesced DOM ref for zero React re-renders during pointer movement.

bestPractices.description: Wrap dashboard cards, toolbar decks, or glass bento grids to provide tactile spatial lighting feedback without triggering React reconciliation on every pointermove.
Avoid stacking multiple large radius halos directly inside one another; prefer a single workspace halo or per-card spotlight.

accessibility.name: Decorative Lighting & Keyboard Focus Parity
accessibility.requirement: Spotlight layers carry `aria-hidden="true"` and `pointer-events-none`, and keyboard focus inside the surface gracefully centers the halo without altering text contrast.
accessibility.description: Ensures screen readers and keyboard-only users experience clear semantic focus without pointer-only lockouts.

props.name: intensity
props.description: Spotlight peak opacity from 0 to 1.

props.name: spectrum

props.name: borderGlow
props.description: Illuminates the outer glass border perimeter near the cursor.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables pointer tracking and spotlight lighting.

name: AiFocusRing
description: Rotating conic-gradient perimeter that wraps active prompt fields, agent cards, or selected panels with a fluid multi-hue glow when focused, active, or processing. Powered by compositor-only `transform: rotate()` keyframes with automatic `prefers-reduced-motion` and `performanceMode="max"` pauses.

bestPractices.description: Enable `processing` while an AI agent is reasoning or streaming to increase orbital cadence and glow intensity without shifting layout geometry.
Do not remove native keyboard `:focus-visible` indicators on interactive children; `AiFocusRing` complements semantic focus states.

accessibility.name: Non-Obstructive Focus Wrapper & Reduced-Motion Compliance
accessibility.requirement: Orbiting border layers carry `aria-hidden="true"` and `pointer-events-none` and automatically pause under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`.
accessibility.description: Protects vestibular-sensitive users while clearly indicating active AI prompt or panel focus.

props.name: processing
props.description: Accelerates orbital rotation and intensifies ambient outer glow.

props.name: palette
props.description: Conic-gradient spectrum preset.

props.name: disabled

name: FluidMeshCanvas
description: Live, slowly morphing multi-point color mesh ambient backdrop positioned behind translucent glass panels. Powered by a DPR-capped, visibility-aware WebGL fragment shader with seamless token-driven CSS fallback, reacting to pointer hover, typing cadence, and semantic system moods (`calm`, `creative`, `thinking`, `alert`).

bestPractices.description: Feed live prompt typing cadence (`0..1`) or agent state mood into `FluidMeshCanvas` to provide ambient visual feedback without triggering expensive DOM layout passes.
Keep `intensity` subtle (`0.6–0.9`) behind text surfaces to guarantee strict WCAG 2.2 AA foreground legibility.

accessibility.name: Reduced-Motion, Visibility Pause & Non-Interactive Backdrop
accessibility.criterion: 2.2.2 Pause, Stop, Hide & 2.3.3 Animation from Interactions
accessibility.requirement: Canvas and CSS mesh layers are marked `aria-hidden="true"` and automatically pause offscreen, in hidden tabs, under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`, and in `performanceMode="max"`.
accessibility.description: Prevents distraction and unnecessary GPU utilization while preserving foreground contrast.

name: GradientTextSelection
description: Custom-styled spectrum blinking caret and gradient text-selection highlight supporting both interactive editable inputs (`mode="editable"`) and selectable prose surfaces (`mode="prose"`). Features IME-safe Enter submission and zero raw color literals.

bestPractices.description: Use in AI prompt inputs or editorial callouts where tactile spectrum selection reinforces active focus while preserving native clipboard copy/paste and screen-reader semantics.
Do not override the underlying native `<input>` semantics; the visual gradient caret layer stays strictly `aria-hidden="true"` and synchronized to `selectionStart`/`selectionEnd`.

accessibility.name: Native Input & IME-Safe Keyboard Semantics
accessibility.requirement: Uses a real labelled `<input type="text">` with keyboard-only `.prism-focus-ring` and guards Enter submission with `!e.nativeEvent.isComposing`.
accessibility.description: Guarantees full screen-reader, clipboard, mobile touch-selection, and CJK IME compatibility.

description: Soft floating light bloom anchored beneath elevated optical cards or active AI controls that gently drifts and breathes to reinforce weightlessness and physical depth.

bestPractices.description: Anchor beneath hero AI command palettes, elevated floating docks, or featured KPI cards to create tactile depth separation.
Avoid placing `AmbientAuraBleed` on every item inside dense 100-row tables; reserve ambient floor blooms for focal elevated surfaces.

accessibility.name: Decorative Floor Glow & Reduced-Motion Safety
accessibility.requirement: Bloom layers carry `aria-hidden="true"` and `pointer-events-none`, and pause breathing automatically under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` and `performanceMode="max"`.

bestPractices.description: Provide domain-specific `suggestions` to pair tactile autocomplete feedback with a subtle one-shot optical sweep.
Do not trigger continuous infinite sweeps on idle inputs; one-shot event-driven sweeps preserve calm focus and zero idle GPU draw.

accessibility.name: IME-Safe Submission & Accessible Prompt Semantics
accessibility.requirement: Pairs a screen-reader `<label>`, keyboard-only `.prism-focus-ring`, `!e.nativeEvent.isComposing` Enter guard, and reduced-motion pause.

bestPractices.description: Use on featured tier cards, hardware modules, or focal media panels to create dichroic rim-light feedback without heavy WebGL overhead.
Enable `enableTilt` selectively on mobile/tablet hero cards rather than dozens of simultaneous list rows.

accessibility.name: Decorative Specular Rim & Passive Orientation Listener
accessibility.requirement: Rim overlays are `aria-hidden="true"` and `pointer-events-none`; `deviceorientation` is purely visual, registered `{ passive: true }`, and cleaned up cleanly on unmount.

description: Slim animated optical gradient hairline anchored to the top or bottom edge of a window, toolbar, or prompt card that dynamically shifts speed and token hue to communicate `idle`, `listening`, `thinking`, `streaming`, `success`, or `error` states.

bestPractices.description: Anchor with `position="top"` or `position="bottom"` inside relative toolbars, window titlebars, or chat headers to communicate real-time agent status without consuming vertical height.
Avoid relying on ribbon color alone for critical errors; enable `showLabel` or pair with accessible text status.

accessibility.name: Polite Live Status Announcements & Motion Pause
accessibility.requirement: Exposes `role="status"` with `aria-live="polite"` and descriptive `aria-label` (plus optional visible `showLabel`), and pauses animation cleanly under `paused`, `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`, and `performanceMode="max"`.

bestPractices.description: Use around focal media cards, hero instrumentation tiles, or floating dock surfaces with realistic `ior` values (`1.33` liquid, `1.49` acrylic, `1.65` crystal).
Avoid excessive `magnification` above `1.08` on text-heavy panels so glyphs remain sharp and never clip horizontally.

accessibility.name: Non-Destructive Optical Layer & Context-Loss Cleanup
accessibility.requirement: Shader canvas and Fresnel rim carry `aria-hidden="true"` and `pointer-events-none`, automatically pause offscreen or in `performanceMode="max"`, and dispose GPU buffers cleanly on unmount.
accessibility.description: Preserves sharp DOM text accessibility and prevents WebGL memory leaks.

accessibility.name: Reduced-Motion & Offscreen GPU Pause

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Called on Escape press or vignette veil click while active.

name: RefractiveSkeleton
description: Layout-matching frosted glass placeholder swept by an angled prismatic light wave across `card`, `profile`, `article`, `media`, and `metrics` presets, transitioning seamlessly to real children once `loading` completes.

bestPractices.description: Match `preset` and `lines` closely to the resolved content layout to prevent Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS) when data arrives.
Avoid displaying raw empty containers while fetching; provide a descriptive `label` for assistive technology.

accessibility.name: ARIA Busy Status & Reduced-Motion Wave
accessibility.requirement: Announces loading via `role="status"`, `aria-busy="true"`, and `aria-label`, while decorative shimmer blocks remain `aria-hidden="true"` and pause automatically under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`.
accessibility.description: Communicates pending load state cleanly without flooding screen readers with empty nodes.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows frosted skeleton placeholder when true, or renders children when false.

props.name: preset
props.description: Structural placeholder geometry preset.

props.name: lines
props.description: Number of placeholder text lines (clamped 1–8).

props.name: animated
props.description: Enables angled prismatic shimmer wave.

props.name: speedSeconds
props.description: Light wave sweep duration in seconds (0.8–5).

name: OrbitalRingSpinner
description: Sleek variable-stroke circular SVG loader with a trailing multi-hue token gradient tail and luminous leading orbital bead for indeterminate waits. Uses compositor-only rotation and pauses under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` and `performanceMode="max"`.

bestPractices.description: Pair with a concise `label` (and `showLabel` for section loaders) so users know what operation is in progress.
For determinate operations with known completion percentage, prefer `SegmentedGlassProgress` instead of an indeterminate spinner.

accessibility.name: Polite Status Region & Contained SVG
accessibility.requirement: Exposes `role="status"` and `aria-label`, marks the spinning `<svg>` `aria-hidden="true"` with `viewBox="0 0 64 64"` and `prism-contain-box`, and pauses smoothly when `paused` or reduced motion is enabled.
accessibility.description: Ensures assistive technology announces indeterminate activity reliably across devices.

props.name: size
props.description: Spinner diameter preset (24px–76px).

props.name: strokeWidth
props.description: Ring stroke width in SVG units (clamped 2–8).

props.name: speedSeconds
props.description: Rotation duration in seconds (clamped 0.5–4).

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible loading message.

props.name: showLabel
props.description: Renders visible label text beside the orbital ring.

props.name: paused
props.description: Pauses orbital spin.

name: AiThinkingOrb
description: Smooth organic liquid morphing sphere powered by a WebGL metaball/harmonic orb shader with optical CSS fallback that pulses, stretches, and shifts semantic hue across `idle`, `listening`, `thinking`, `generating`, and `complete` agent states.

bestPractices.description: Bind directly to live AI turn status so users can distinguish listening, reasoning, streaming generation, and completion at a glance.
Keep `showLabel` enabled or pair with clear live status text so meaning is never conveyed by motion or hue alone.

accessibility.name: Polite Live Agent State & Reduced-Motion Support
accessibility.requirement: Uses `role="status"`, `aria-live="polite"`, descriptive `aria-label`, and halts organic morphing automatically on `state="complete"`, `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`, and `performanceMode="max"`.
accessibility.description: Keeps agent presence accessible, calm, and battery-friendly across desktop and mobile.

props.name: state
props.description: Agent lifecycle state modulating orb energy and hue.

props.name: sizePx
props.description: Orb diameter in pixels (clamped 36–160).

props.name: label
props.description: Custom accessible status message.

props.name: showLabel
props.description: Displays status caption and state pill beneath the orb.

props.name: disableWebGL
props.description: Renders using pure CSS optical sphere fallback.

name: SegmentedGlassProgress
description: Recessed frosted glass pill track filling with a glowing internal liquid gradient across discrete or continuous (`segments={1}`) glass capsules, complete with specular top highlights, optional percentage readouts, and an indeterminate prismatic sweep mode.

bestPractices.description: Use `segments={8–12}` for multi-phase uploads, shader builds, or quota gauges, or `segments={1}` for a sleek continuous liquid bar.
Avoid passing unclamped values outside `0..max`; values are automatically normalized for ARIA accuracy.

accessibility.name: ARIA Progressbar Contract
accessibility.requirement: Emits `role="progressbar"` with `aria-label`, `aria-valuemin`, `aria-valuemax`, `aria-valuenow` (omitted in `indeterminate` mode), and human-readable `aria-valuetext`.
accessibility.description: Gives screen readers exact determinate progress or indeterminate status semantics.

props.name: value
props.description: Current completion value (0..max).

props.name: max
props.description: Maximum value representing 100%.

props.name: segments
props.description: Number of pill segments (clamped 1–20).

props.name: tone
props.description: Liquid fill gradient palette.

props.name: showPercentage
props.description: Displays tabular percentage readout.

props.name: indeterminate
props.description: Switches to indeterminate sweeping liquid mode.

name: StreamingTokenReveal
description: Progressive text-rendering wrapper that fades in newly streamed tokens or markdown blocks with a soft leading prismatic caret edge instead of jarring block jumps. Supports incremental stream appending, tab-visibility pause, instant `skipAnimation` / `prefers-reduced-motion`, and completion callbacks.

bestPractices.description: Append incoming SSE/WebSocket chunks directly to the `text` prop while keeping `streaming={true}` until the stream terminates.
Never inject raw unescaped HTML into `text`; `StreamingTokenReveal` renders plain text tokens safely inside React text nodes.

accessibility.name: Polite Live Region & Instant Reduced-Motion Reveal
accessibility.requirement: Wraps output in `role="region"` with `aria-live="polite"` and `aria-busy`, and reveals full text immediately without flicker when `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` or `skipAnimation` is set.
accessibility.description: Prevents disorienting live-region churn while keeping streaming responses smooth and accessible.

props.name: text
props.description: Text content or incrementally growing stream buffer.

props.name: streaming
props.description: Keeps the soft leading edge caret visible while waiting for more tokens.

props.name: revealRateMs
props.description: Milliseconds per token chunk reveal (clamped 16–300).

props.name: chunkSize
props.description: Words revealed per tick (clamped 1–6).

props.name: skipAnimation
props.description: Reveals all text immediately.

props.name: onRevealComplete
props.description: Fired once buffered tokens finish revealing.

name: DataGridRowShimmer
description: Table-specific optical skeleton animating placeholder rows in a staggered top-to-bottom prismatic wave inside a mobile-safe `overflow-x-auto` container with automatic `content-visibility: auto` on `tbody > tr`, cross-fading cleanly into real table content once `loading` completes.

bestPractices.description: Pass the same `columns` array used by your production `DataTable` or `AdvancedDataGrid` to eliminate header shift when data resolves.
Keep `rows` aligned with the visible viewport fold (typically `5–10`) rather than rendering hundreds of skeleton rows.

accessibility.name: Semantic Table Sections, Scroll Wrapper & ARIA Busy
accessibility.requirement: Wraps `<table>` with explicit `<thead>`/`<tbody>` sections inside `overflow-x-auto`, announces loading via `role="status"` and `aria-busy="true"`, and marks shimmer bars `aria-hidden="true"`.
accessibility.description: Preserves zero-overflow mobile responsiveness and clean screen-reader structure.

props.name: loading
props.description: Displays staggered skeleton rows when true, or renders children when false.

props.name: rows
props.description: Number of placeholder rows (clamped 1–20).

props.name: columns
props.description: Header labels matching target table columns.

props.name: staggerMs
props.description: Top-to-bottom stagger cascade delay per row in ms (0–240).

props.name: animated
props.description: Enables angled prismatic row wave.

name: AcousticActivityBar
description: Compact row of animated vertical optical glass bars bouncing smoothly to indicate voice input, audio DSP processing, or live streaming telemetry. Supports autonomous animation or real-time normalized `levels` array binding.

bestPractices.description: Pass live Web Audio FFT buckets (`0..1`) via `levels` for real voice metering, or omit `levels` for zero-JS compositor-animated voice activity.
Set `active={false}` when microphone capture or audio streaming stops so bars rest cleanly with zero animation overhead.

accessibility.name: Polite Activity Status & Reduced-Motion Safety
accessibility.requirement: Exposes `role="status"` and descriptive `aria-label`, hides decorative bars with `aria-hidden="true"`, and halts animations cleanly when `active={false}`, `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`, or `performanceMode="max"`.
accessibility.description: Provides non-intrusive audio activity state for all users.

props.name: active
props.description: Enables bouncing bar motion.

props.name: barCount
props.description: Number of glass bars (clamped 3–24).

props.name: levels
props.description: Optional live normalized bar amplitudes [0..1].

props.name: heightPx
props.description: Maximum bar height in pixels (clamped 16–84).

props.name: tone
props.description: Bar gradient palette.

props.name: showLabel
props.description: Displays status label alongside the bars.

name: PipelinePulseLoader
description: Connected node-and-track multi-stage loader where a glowing optical light packet travels smoothly from stage to stage, visually tracking multi-step API calls, shader builds, deployments, or background jobs.

bestPractices.description: Provide concise `label` and `detail` timing/status strings on each stage and optionally bind `onStageSelect` to inspect step logs.
Avoid crowding more than 6–7 horizontal stages inside narrow mobile cards; keep stage labels concise for clean horizontal scrolling.

accessibility.name: Ordered Step Semantics & Polite Status Updates
accessibility.requirement: Renders stages inside a semantic `<ol>` with `aria-current="step"` on the active node, `role="status"` + `aria-live="polite"`, and automatic light-packet pause under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`.
accessibility.description: Communicates multi-stage job progress reliably to assistive technologies.

props.name: stages
props.description: Ordered pipeline stages with `pending | active | completed | error` status.

props.name: pulseSpeedSeconds
props.description: Packet travel duration in seconds (clamped 0.6–4).

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible region description.

props.name: onStageSelect
props.description: Optional handler invoked when clicking a stage node.

name: ScanlineRadarSweep
description: Thin luminous optical beam sweeping across a preview canvas, image, or code block in `vertical`, `horizontal`, or `radar` modes to signal active analysis, indexing, or security scanning. Powered purely by compositor-thread transform animations with automatic reduced-motion and `performanceMode="max"` pauses.

bestPractices.description: Wrap code blocks, uploaded media, or visual diffs with `active={isScanning}` so users clearly see live analysis progress without obscuring the underlying artifact.
Avoid leaving `active={true}` once indexing or scanning finishes; toggle `active={false}` to remove the overlay cleanly.

accessibility.name: ARIA Busy Region & Polite Scan Status
accessibility.requirement: Marks the scanned region `aria-busy={active}`, announces status via `role="status" aria-live="polite"`, marks the beam `aria-hidden="true"`, and disables sweep animation under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`.
accessibility.description: Keeps background analysis clearly communicated without blocking interaction or violating motion preferences.

props.name: active
props.description: Toggles the active scanning beam and status pill.

props.name: mode
props.description: Beam trajectory geometry.

props.name: tone
props.description: Semantic optical beam hue.

props.name: speedSeconds
props.description: Beam sweep cycle duration in seconds (0.8–8).

props.name: statusLabel
props.description: Polite status caption displayed while active.
